subclassFeature.name: Addicted Approach
entries: For some, the consumption of substances is the entirety of their life. For berserkers of the Addicted Approach, substances cause their fury to burn stronger and deeper, granting significant benefits.

subclassFeature.name: Slythmonger Savvy
entries: You gain proficiency in your choice of brewer's kit or spicer's kit. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid the low or addiction to substances. Lastly, you can consume substances as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, and when you do so, you can also enter a rage as a part of this same {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

subclassFeature.name: Freedom Through Slavery
entries: While you are raging or experiencing the high of a substance, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} that would force you to act against your will, be {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened}, or prevent you from attacking a creature. If you are both raging and experiencing the high of a substance, you are instead immune to effects that would force you to act against your will or would prevent you from attacking a creature.

subclassFeature.name: Release the Beast
entries: While you are raging or experiencing the high of a substance, when you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can expend a Hit Die to deal additional damage to the target. Roll the Hit Die, adding the result of the die to the damage roll. If you are both raging and experiencing the high of a substance, you also add your Constitution modifier to the damage roll.

subclassFeature.name: Seeing Sound
entries: While you are raging or experiencing the high of a substance, you have {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight} with a range of 10 feet. If you are both raging and experiencing the high of a substance, you instead have {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight} with a range of 30 feet. If you would already have {@sense Blindsight|sw5e-phb|blindsight}, it instead increases by 5 feet or 15 feet, respectively.

subclassFeature.name: Fuel the Rampage
entries: While you are both raging and experiencing the high of a substance, having 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} doesn't knock you {@condition Unconscious|sw5e-phb|unconscious}. You still must make {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throws}, and you suffer the normal effects of taking damage while at 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}. However, if you would die due to failing {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throws}, you don't die until your rage ends, and you die then only if you still have 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.

subclassFeature.name: Adept Specialist
entries: Those fighters who choose to become Adept Specialists tap into a latent Force-sensitivity to augment their martial prowess, blending the two to accelerate their bodies and blows. An adept speeds across the battlefield, attacking opponents in a flurry of blows before dashing off again.

subclassFeature.name: Forcecasting
entries: You have learned powers, fragments of knowledge that imbue you with an abiding force ability. See {@book chapter 10|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} for the general rules of {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} and {@book chapter 11|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} for the {@book force powers list|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Force Powers Known
entries: You learn 4 {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of your choice, and you learn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Force Powers Known|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} column of the Adept {@feat Specialist|sw5e-phb} {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table. You may not learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of a level higher than your Max Power Level, and you may learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at the same time you learn its prerequisite.

entries.name: Force Points
entries: You have a number of force points equal to your fighter level, as shown in the Force Points column of the Adept {@feat Specialist|sw5e-phb} {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table, + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice). You use these force points to cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. You regain all expended force points when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Max Power Level
entries: Many {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} can be overpowered, consuming more force points to create a greater effect. You can overpower these abilities to a maximum level, which increases at higher levels, as shown in the Max Power Level column of the Adept {@feat Specialist|sw5e-phb} {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table.
You may only cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at 4th-level once. You regain the ability to do so after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Forcecasting Ability
entries: Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} varies based on the alignment of the powers you cast. You use your Wisdom for {@book light side powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, Charisma for {@book dark side powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, and Wisdom or Charisma for {@book universal powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} (your choice). You use this ability whenever a power refers to your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability}. Additionally, you use this ability modifier when setting the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC for a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you cast and when making an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with one.
{@b Force save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier
{@b Force attack modifier} = your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier

subclassFeature.name: Growing Momentum
entries: You can cast the {@i burst of speed} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} targeting yourself at 1st-level without expending force points. At 10th level, when you do so, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by an additional 10 feet. At 18th level, when you do so, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by an additional 10 feet.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain any expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Whirling Weapons
entries: Your constant blur of motion and attacks becomes an unending barrage as you build momentum. Once on your turn when you miss with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} you can make another {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, no action required.

subclassFeature.name: Focused Breathing
entries: You learn to recover some of your expended power quickly. When you use your Second Wind you also regain a number of force points equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, a minimum of one).

subclassFeature.name: Unstoppable Force
entries: You learn to completely ignore many of the most devastating impediments of combat. You can expend a use of Indomitable to gain the effect of the {@i freedom of movement} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} until the end of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Instant Acceleration
entries: You reach the pinnacle of your training, moving faster than eyes or most sensors can track. When you use Action Surge feature, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. You can teleport before or after the additional action.

entries: Monks of the Aing-Tii Order blend an attunement to the Force with their supreme focus to become a blur of motion in the heat of battle.

subclassFeature.name: Flow-Walking
entries: You can cast the {@i phasestrike} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} without expending force points. When you reach 11th level, the damage bonus of the special attack made during {@i phasestrike} increases to 2d8, and at 17th level it increases to 3d8.

entries.name: Aing-Tii Order Forcecasting
entries: Additionally, when you use your action to cast an at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can use your Martial Arts or Focus features.
You can use these features a combined three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain any expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Prismatic Step
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, you can teleport up to 10 feet before each attack to an unoccupied space you can see.
If you attack at least two different creatures with the action, you can make one additional attack against a third creature (no action required).

subclassFeature.name: Iridescent Strikes
entries: When you use your action to cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can spend 2 focus points to teleport to a space within 5 feet of a creature affected by the power and make two {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} against that creature as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

subclassFeature.name: Aqinos Form
entries: {@optfeature Aqinos Form|sw5e-phb}, also know as Adaptation Form, is named after a Jedi Master who sought to merge technology with Force use. Those guardians who focus on {@optfeature Aqinos Form|sw5e-phb} adopt these tenets to employ clever exploits using technology and the aid of a droid companion.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements} and the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill.

subclassFeature.name: Form Basics
entries: You gain the Aqinos {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}, detailed in the {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb} Forms section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content. If you already know this form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

subclassFeature.name: Techcasting Secrets
entries: You have learned to blend your technological aptitude with the Force. Choose two {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of no higher level than your Max Power Level, as shown in the guardian table. The chosen powers count as both universal {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} for you, but are not included in the number in the Powers Known column of the guardian table.

You learn two additional powers at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you know and replace it with another {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of no higher level than your Max Power Level.

subclassFeature.name: Droid Companion
entries: You learn to employ all the knowledge you've accumulated to create, customize, and bond with your own droid companion.

Create your droid companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content. You must have {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements} in order to create your droid.

If your companion is irreparably destroyed, or you want a companion, you must first break the bond with your current companion. Bonding with a new companion takes 8 hours spent in an appropriate location. You may only have one companion at a time.
In addition to its traits and features, your droid companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

items: Your companion is a valid target of the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

Your companion gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each companion trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your force point maximum is reduced by 2. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can replace or remove a number of companion traits equal to half your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).

entries: Lastly, while bonded and within 10 feet of you, your companion can cast the {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you know without expending tech points. If your companion casts an at-will power in this way, it does not scale normally at higher levels. Instead, if it would scale at 5th level, it instead scales at 11th level, and if it would scale at 11th level, it instead scales at 17th level. If your companion casts a power of 2nd-level or higher, it consumes a number of uses of this feature equal to that power's level. At 11th level, your droid companion must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, your droid companion must be within 60 feet. You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Droid Companion
entries: You learn to employ all the knowledge you've accumulated to create, customize, and bond with your own droid companion.

Create your droid companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content. You must have {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements} in order to create your droid.

If your companion is irreparably destroyed, or you want a companion, you must first break the bond with your current companion. Bonding with a new companion takes 8 hours spent in an appropriate location. You may only have one companion at a time.
In addition to its traits and features, your droid companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

items: Your companion is a valid target of the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

Your companion gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each companion trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your force point maximum is reduced by 2. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can replace or remove a number of companion traits equal to half your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).

entries: Lastly, while bonded and within 10 feet of you, your companion can cast the {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you know without expending tech points. If your companion casts an at-will power in this way, it does not scale normally at higher levels. Instead, if it would scale at 5th level, it instead scales at 11th level, and if it would scale at 11th level, it instead scales at 17th level. If your companion casts a power of 2nd-level or higher, it consumes a number of uses of this feature equal to that power's level. At 11th level, your droid companion must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, your droid companion must be within 60 feet. You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Channel the Force
entries: You learn your choice of the Cause Harm or Lend Aid Channel the Force options, and when you use either of these options, you gain additional benefits.

entries.name: Cause Harm
entries: You can choose to deal ion damage instead of necrotic.

entries.name: Lend Aid
entries: Droids and constructs are now valid targets.

subclassFeature.name: Adaptive Calibration
entries: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, or you restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a friendly creature that is at 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you regain an expended use of your Channel the Force, and you gain temporary force points equal to the power's level.

subclassFeature.name: Master of Adaptation
entries: Your masteries of the Force and technology have achieved equilibrium. Your Constitution and Wisdom or Charisma (your choice) scores increase by 2. Your maximum for those scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to ion damage, and you can't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against ion or lightning damage.

You can't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} you make as a part of a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, and enemies can't have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.
You add your governing ability modifier (minimum of +1) to any damage or healing you do with {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast that don't already include that modifier.

entries: While you are conscious and your droid is within 60 feet of you and conscious, it also gains these benefits.

This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Archaeologist Pursuit
entries: Archaeologists are those who study the remnants of historical civilizations. Those scholars who choose the Archaeologist Pursuit are driven by a desire to uncover the past, forming a connection to the lives of those that came before, and unlocking within themselves a connection not just to history, but to the Force itself.

subclassFeature.name: Studious Excavator
entries: You gain proficiency with archaeologist kits and in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} skill. Additionally, you can't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on checks you make with them.

subclassFeature.name: Forcecasting
entries: You have learned powers from your studies of civilizations that were also once close to the Force. See {@book chapter 10|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} for the general rules of {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} and {@book chapter 11|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} for the {@book force powers list|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Force Powers Known
entries: You learn 4 {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of your choice, and you learn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Force Powers Known|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} column of the Archaeologist Pursuit {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table. You may not learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of a level higher than your Max Power Level, and you may learn a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at the same time you learn its prerequisite.

entries.name: Force Points
entries: You have a number of force points equal to your scholar level, as shown in the Force Points column of the Archaeologist Pursuit {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table, + your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier (your choice). You use these force points to cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}. You regain all expended force points when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Max Power Level
entries: Many {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} can be overpowered, consuming more force points to create a greater effect. You can overpower these abilities to a maximum level, which increases at higher levels, as shown in the Max Power Level column of the Archaeologist Pursuit {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} table.
You may only cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at 4th-level once. You regain the ability to do so after a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Forcecasting Ability
entries: Your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} varies based on the alignment of the powers you cast. You use your Intelligence or Wisdom for {@book light side powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} (your choice), Intelligence or Charisma for {@book dark side powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} (your choice), and Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for {@book universal powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} (your choice). You use this ability whenever a power refers to your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability}. Additionally, you use this ability modifier when setting the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC for a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you cast and when making an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with one.
{@b Force save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier
{@b Force attack modifier} = your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier

subclassFeature.name: Archaic Diagnostics
entries: When you {@spell Analyze|sw5e-phb|analyze} a hostile creature, you can use {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} that require a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} when you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that requires a force attack and you can use {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} that require a hit with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} when a creature fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you cast.

subclassFeature.name: Force Carving
entries: You have unlocked more control over the Force, allowing you to choose wisely who it affects. When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that affects other creatures that you can see, you can choose a number of them equal to 1 + the power's level. The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against the power, and they take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.

subclassFeature.name: Psychometric Analysis
entries: Your strength in the Force and your ability to read the objects around you intensifies. You can use your Critical Analysis to {@spell Analyze|sw5e-phb|analyze} an object of Huge size or smaller that you can see within range. When you do so, you learn whether or not the object is enhanced, cursed, and how old it is.

Additionally, you can end your Critical Analysis on the object (no action required) to ask it a single question and receive an answer, usually in the form of an auditory or visual {@spell Hallucination|sw5e-phb|hallucination}. For example, touching the rusted, broken remains of a {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} and asking how it got there may result in a brief vision of a disgruntled Jedi Knight casting it to the ground on that spot. An object —questioned— in this way can only provide information relating to its past. The GM has the final say on what objects can be questioned, and to what extent.
You can use this feature four times. You gain an additional use at 13th and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Knowledge is Power
entries: You gain the ability to steal the knowledge of how to cast a power from another forcecaster. When a hostile creature casts a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that affects a friendly creature within range of your Critical Analysis feature, and you use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} target that friendly creature with your Critical Analysis feature, you can force the creature casting the power to make a Wisdom or Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (your choice) against your universal force save DC. On a successful save, the power is cast as normal.

On a failed save, you negate the power's effects, and you steal the knowledge of that power if it is at least 1st level and of a level you can cast. For the next 8 hours, you know the power and can cast it using your force points. The creature cannot cast that power again until the 8 hours have passed.
Once you've used this feature, you cannot use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Archaeologist Discoveries
entries: When you select this pursuit, you gain access to new discoveries which reflect your studies into historical civilations. Whenever you learn a new discovery, you can choose from any of the following as well. The discoveries are listed in alphabetical order.

entries.name: Archive Research
entries: Your expeditions have turned up a bevy of knowledge on the force. You learn three at-will {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of your choice, which don't count against your number of {@book Force Powers Known|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Force Combat Knowledge
entries: Your research into Jedi and Sith combat techniques has allowed you to gain proficiency in {@filter simple lightweapons|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}. Additionally, you gain knowledge of one {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms} of your choice.

entries.name: It Belongs in a Museum
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} Your knowledge of antiquities is unparalleled. When you make an Intelligence ({@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}) check or an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} with your archaeologist kit, you may treat any roll of a 9 or lower as a 10.

entries.name: Localized Survey
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level} Your affinity for the force allows you to key in to the recent past of an area you enter. When you would expend a use of your Psychometric Analysis, you can instead choose to target your immediate vicinity (up to a 50-foot cube) and {@optfeature Investigate|sw5e-phb|investigate} for at least 1 minute. For each minute you {@optfeature Investigate|sw5e-phb|investigate}, you see visions of recent events in the area going back a number of days equal to your scholar level, you learn about one significant event, beginning with the most recent.

You can {@optfeature Investigate|sw5e-phb|investigate} in this way for a number of minutes equal to your scholar level and must maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} during that time, as if you were concentrating on a power.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Making This Up As You Go
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 17th level} You may now cast {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at 4th-level twice between rests.

entries.name: Telekinetic Ministrations
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} You can cast the {@i telekinesis} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at 5th level without spending force points.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: The Years and the Mileage
entries: Your archaeological studies have taken you all across the galaxy. While you are the target of your Critical Analysis feature, you can use your universal {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} instead of Wisdom when making {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} checks.

entries.name: Tomb of the Ancients
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} As a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} when you take damage, you can entomb yourself in the Force until the end of your next turn. For the duration, you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to the triggering damage, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to 1d10 + your universal {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier + your scholar level to potentially absorb the attack, and your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is reduced to 0.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Armored Approach
entries: Many berserkers forgo armor and rely on their own fortitude. Berserkers of the Armored Approach, however, embrace the use of armor. Each one customizes their own suit of armor to be used both defensively and offensively, so that the suit becomes an extension of the berserker's own might and fury.

subclassFeature.name: Spiked Armor
entries: You gain proficiency in {@item Armormech's implements|sw5e-phb|armormech's implements}. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can customize a suit of light or {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor} into spiked armor. You must have the armor and {@item Armormech's implements|sw5e-phb|armormech's implements} in order to perform this modification. You can only have one suit of spiked armor at a time.

This armor gains the barbed (1d4) property. If the armor already has the barbed property, the barbed damage increases by one step (from {@dice d4} to {@dice d6}, or from {@dice d6} to {@dice d8}). Additionally, while raging, you add your rage damage bonus to your barbed damage when you successfully initiate or maintain a grapple.
While wearing your spiked armor, you can use your Constitution modifier instead of your Dexterity modifier when determining your AC.

Additionally, while wearing your spiked armor, you can use your spiked armor as an improvised weapon. When you do so, you are considered proficient with it, and if your armor's barbed damage would be higher than your damage with improvised weapons, you use the barbed damage instead. If you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action on your turn and make at least one attack with your spiked armor, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to make an additional attack with your spiked armor against the same target.

subclassFeature.name: Environmental Shielding
entries: You customize your spiked armor to better protect you. Choose one of the following damage types: acid, cold, fire, lightning, or sonic. While wearing your spiked armor, you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to damage of the chosen type. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can select a different damage type, provided you have the armor and {@item Armormech's implements|sw5e-phb|armormech's implements} with you.

Additionally, while wearing your spiked armor, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} due to extreme heat or cold.

subclassFeature.name: Customized Armor
entries: You learn new ways to customize your spiked armor. Choose one of the following options. While wearing your spiked armor, you gain the effects of the chosen option. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can select a different option, provided you have the armor and {@item Armormech's implements|sw5e-phb|armormech's implements} with you.

entries.name: Defensive Field
entries: On your turn, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to 1d12 + your berserker level. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Deflective Layer
entries: Your {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} increases by 1.

entries.name: Grappling Line
entries: You can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to launch a grappling line at one creature of your choice that you can see within 15 feet. The target must succeed on a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Strength modifier) or be pulled up to 10 feet in a straight line towards you. If it ends this movement within 5 feet of you, it takes kinetic damage from your armor spikes equal to your Strength modifier.

entries.name: Integrated Sonar
entries: You can use an action to give yourself the benefits of the {@i true sight} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} for 1 hour. Once you use this feature, you must finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Neural Interface
entries: You are immune to all effects that would cause you to be {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} or {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened}.

subclassFeature.name: Spiked Retribution
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, the attacker takes kinetic damage equal to your Strength modifier, as long as you are wearing your spiked armor and you aren't {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}.
If you are raging, you add your rage damage bonus to this damage.

subclassFeature.name: Artificer Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Artificer Engineering discipline focus on building and modifying lightsabers, while tapping into the latent presence of the Force in these {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} crystals.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in {@item Artificer's implements|sw5e-phb|artificer's implements}, and with the {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} simple {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with {@item Artificer's implements|sw5e-phb|artificer's implements}, the rate at which you craft doubles.

subclassFeature.name: Modified Lightsaber
entries: You learn to modify an unenhanced {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} utilizing your artificer knowledge. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can modify your {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}. You must have the {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} and {@item Artificer's implements|sw5e-phb|artificer's implements} in order to perform this modification.

Your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} is enhanced, requires attunement, can only be used by you, and counts as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while you are attuned to it. Your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} has 4 modification slots, and it gains more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. For each modification installed in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
Some modification effects require {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your tech save DC.
At 9th level, you can maintain two different modified lightsabers. The total modification slots are split across the two items.

subclassFeature.name: Modified Lightsaber
entries: You learn to modify an unenhanced {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} utilizing your artificer knowledge. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can modify your {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}. You must have the {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} and {@item Artificer's implements|sw5e-phb|artificer's implements} in order to perform this modification.

Your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} is enhanced, requires attunement, can only be used by you, and counts as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while you are attuned to it. Your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} has 4 modification slots, and it gains more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. For each modification installed in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
Some modification effects require {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your tech save DC.
At 9th level, you can maintain two different modified lightsabers. The total modification slots are split across the two items.

subclassFeature.name: Force Resonance
entries: Once per round, when you hit a creature with your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}, you can expend one use of your Potent Aptitude to deal an extra 2d6 damage to that target. The damage is the same type as your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}'s damage.
The damage increases when you reach certain levels in this class, increasing to 3d6 at 5th level, 5d6 at 11th level, and 8d6 at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Forcecasting Secrets
entries: Your study of kyber crystals has awakened a latent force sensitivity. Choose two {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st level. The chosen powers count as {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} for you, but are not included in the number in the Powers Known column of the engineer table.

At 7th level, you learn two additional {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st or 2nd level. At 13th level, you learn two {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st-3rd level, and at 17th level, you learn two {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st-4th level. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you know and replace it with another {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of the same level.

subclassFeature.name: Forcecasting Secrets
entries: Your study of kyber crystals has awakened a latent force sensitivity. Choose two {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st level. The chosen powers count as {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} for you, but are not included in the number in the Powers Known column of the engineer table.

At 7th level, you learn two additional {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st or 2nd level. At 13th level, you learn two {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st-3rd level, and at 17th level, you learn two {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st-4th level. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you know and replace it with another {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of the same level.

subclassFeature.name: Forcecasting Secrets
entries: Your study of kyber crystals has awakened a latent force sensitivity. Choose two {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st level. The chosen powers count as {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} for you, but are not included in the number in the Powers Known column of the engineer table.

At 7th level, you learn two additional {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st or 2nd level. At 13th level, you learn two {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st-3rd level, and at 17th level, you learn two {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st-4th level. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you know and replace it with another {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of the same level.

subclassFeature.name: Forcecasting Secrets
entries: Your study of kyber crystals has awakened a latent force sensitivity. Choose two {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st level. The chosen powers count as {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} for you, but are not included in the number in the Powers Known column of the engineer table.

At 7th level, you learn two additional {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st or 2nd level. At 13th level, you learn two {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st-3rd level, and at 17th level, you learn two {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st-4th level. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you know and replace it with another {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of the same level.

subclassFeature.name: Disruptive Resonance
entries: When you hit a creature that is concentrating on a power with your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}, the creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}. Additionally, on a failed save, the creature immediately takes psychic damage equal to your engineer level + your Intelligence modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Resonating Recovery
entries: Once per turn, when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you regain a use of your Potent Aptitude. Your number of Potent Aptitude uses can not exceed your Intelligence modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Artificer Modifications
entries: If a modification has prerequisites, you must meet them to install it. You can install the modification at the same time that you meet its prerequisites.

entries.name: Additonal Beam Port
entries: You install a second beam port into your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}. Your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} gains the double (1d8) property. You can only benefit from this property while wielding your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} with two hands.

entries.name: Adegan Crystal
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to damage rolls made with this weapon. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Advanced Blastsaber
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Blastsaber} You further fine tune your blastsaber. As an action, you can disable a single electronic device not being worn or held by another creature within 5 feet of you. The device is then disabled until it is rebooted.

Additionally, when you activate this conversion to alter the properties of your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, you create a projected barrier of ion energy in a 10-foot-radius sphere around you until the start of your next turn. Hostile creatures treat this area as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}. When a hostile creature enters the shielded area or starts its turn there, that creature takes 3d4 ion damage. Any electronics not being worn or held within the barrier's radius are disabled until rebooted.

entries.name: Advanced Brightsaber
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Brightsaber} You further fine tune your brightsaber. While activated, your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}'s bright light now automatically dispels illusions and can {@spell Detect Invisibility|sw5e-phb|detect invisibility}, as with {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight}.

Additionally, when you activate this conversion to alter the properties of your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} and use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to attempt to blind your target, it makes the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Advanced Disruptorsaber
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Disruptorsaber} You further fine tune your disruptorsaber. While activated, your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} lightly obscures the area within 5 feet of it.

Additionally, when you activate this conversion to alter the properties of your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} and use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to attempt to knock your target prone, the next {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} you make before the end of your next turn has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

entries.name: Barrier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} On your turn, when you make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}, you can choose to forgo your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}. If you do, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to erect a temporary barrier that lasts until the start of your next turn. While the barrier is activated, you have a bonus to AC against the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} made against you equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

entries.name: Beam Gem Lens
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} made with this weapon. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Biometric Safety Measures
entries: A security system is installed into the hilt of your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}. When a creature other than you attempts to activate your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, the activation fails. Additionally, the creature attempting to activate must make on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or take lightning damage equal to engineer level, and become {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} until the start of its next turn. On a successful save the creature takes half damage and is not {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked}. Regardless of success or failure, the creature drops your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}.

entries.name: Blastsaber Conversion
entries: {@i Incompatible with other conversions} You heavily modify your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} to allow you to make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}. With this modification, you can make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a range of 30/60. On a hit, it deals 1d6 energy damage.

Additionally, when you make your first attack on your turn, you can alter the properties of your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}. Until the start of your next turn, the damage type of your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} is changed to ion.

You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Brightsaber Conversion
entries: {@i Incompatible with other conversions} You modify your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, giving it a brighter glow. While activated, your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} sheds bright light in a 20-foot radius and dim light for an additional 20 feet.

Additionally, when you make your first attack on your turn, you can alter the properties of your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}. Until the start of your next turn, the damage type of your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} is changed to fire.

You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Burn Through
entries: When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} you make against that creature.

entries.name: Comfortable Handle
entries: You make minor modifications to the ergonomics of your modified saber's hilt. Your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} gains {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

entries.name: Crossguard
entries: You add an energy guard at the base of your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}'s blade. While wielding your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}, you gain a +1 bonus to your {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} against melee weapon attacks.

entries.name: Disruptorsaber Conversion
entries: {@i Incompatible with other conversions} You modify your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, causing it to eminate a sickly green light. Your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} loses the luminous property.

Additionally, when you make your first attack on your turn, you can alter the properties of your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}. Until the start of your next turn, the damage type of your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} is changed to acid.

You can use this trait a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Extended Beam
entries: You install a series of beam focusing amplifiers into your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}. Your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} gains the reach property.

entries.name: Greatsaber Array
entries: You augment the configuration of your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}. Your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} gains the two-handed property, and it's damage die increases to 1d12.

entries.name: Intense Beam
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level, Burn Through} Your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}'s {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} range increases by 1.

entries.name: Magnetic-Lock Grip
entries: You insert a series of magnetically charged grips into your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}'s hilt. While wielding your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to disarm or avoid being disarmed.

entries.name: Prototype Blastsaber
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Blastsaber Conversion} You fine tune your blastsaber. When you activate this conversion to alter the properties of your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to cause your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} to let loose a burst of energy. Creatures other than yourself within 5 feet of the target creature must succeed on a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, they take ion damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

entries.name: Prototype Brightsaber
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Brightsaber Conversion} You fine tune your brightsaber. When you activate this conversion to alter the properties of your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to attempt to blind the target of the attack. The creature must succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded}.

entries.name: Prototype Disruptorsaber
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Disruptorsaber Conversion} You fine tune your disruptorsaber. When you activate this conversion to alter the properties of your {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to attempt to knock the target of your attack prone. The creature must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.

entries.name: Returning Weapon
entries: You install a retractible chain in the hilt of your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber}. Your modified {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb|lightsaber} gains the thrown property with a range of 20/60, and when you throw the weapon, it immediately returns to your hand.

subclassFeature.name: Artillerist Technique
entries: Some scouts choose to navigate around defenses, while others choose to go through them. Followers of the Artillerist Technique learn to exert greater control of their {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, causing delayed—and often empowered—effects.

subclassFeature.name: Modular Munitions
entries: When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, rather than having it take effect instantly, you can choose to delay the effect to occur on {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} count 20 (losing all {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} ties). When you do so, any creature that leaves the affected area of your {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} is unaffected when the {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} occurs. If the power would only target one creature, and that creature moves from the space it was in when you cast the power, the {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} automatically misses if it would call for an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, as if you had rolled a 1 on the attack, and the creature automatically succeeds on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against the power if it calls for a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, as if it had rolled a 20 on the save.

Additionally, when you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and choose to delay it in this way, and that {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} would deal damage, you can apply one of the following additional empowerment effects:

items: {@b Flashbang}: Each creature damaged by this power must succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} and {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened} until the start of your next turn.

{@b Mire:} Each creature damaged by this power must succeed on a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or gain one {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level until the start of your next turn.

{@b Psyche:} Each creature damaged by this power must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or become {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} until the start of your next turn.

entries: If an empowerment effect calls for a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the DC equals your tech save DC.

You can use these features a combined number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, as shown in the scout table. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

While you have no remaining uses of this feature, you can instead expend 1 tech point to use it. When you do so, your maximum tech points are reduced by 1 until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Mark of the Artillerist
entries: You can now use your Ranger's Quarry feature on a 10-foot cube area within 60 feet of you that you can see. You can treat any creatures inside this cube as if they are the target of your Ranger's Quarry feature, and when a creature is hit by a tech attack or fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast that deals damage, you can apply your Ranger's Quarry damage to that creature.
At 11th level, you can now use your Ranger's Quarry feature on a 15-foot cube area, instead of a 10-foot cube.

subclassFeature.name: Mark of the Artillerist
entries: You can now use your Ranger's Quarry feature on a 10-foot cube area within 60 feet of you that you can see. You can treat any creatures inside this cube as if they are the target of your Ranger's Quarry feature, and when a creature is hit by a tech attack or fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast that deals damage, you can apply your Ranger's Quarry damage to that creature.
At 11th level, you can now use your Ranger's Quarry feature on a 15-foot cube area, instead of a 10-foot cube.

subclassFeature.name: Sundered Defenses
entries: Your precise bombardments make even the most hardened defenses crumble. When you cast a power that calls for a tech attack or a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, it reduces partial {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} by one step (from three-quarters to half or half to one-quarter) against creatures affected by it. If an affected creature has one-quarter {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}, your power ignores it entirely.

subclassFeature.name: Target Masking
entries: You are familiar with various turrets and defensive emplacements, and their operation.

As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can activate a masking effect to confuse the targeting of constructs for 1 minute. Any construct who targets you with an attack, a harmful power, or a hostile action must first make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC. On a failed save, the construct must choose a new target or lose the attack or power. This power doesn't protect you from area effects.

You can use this feature a combined number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, as shown in the scout table. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Master of Ordnance
entries: You can now expend two uses of your Modular Munitions feature when you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} to apply two empowerment effects, instead of only one. Additionally, you gain three additional empowerment effects:

items: {@b Confusion:} Each creature damaged by this power must make a Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failure, on its next turn, a creature must use its action to make a melee attack against a randomly determined creature within its reach. If there is no creature within its reach, the creature does nothing this turn.
{@b Knockout:} Each creature damaged by this power must succeed on a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.

{@b Static:} Each creature damaged by this power must succeed on an Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or become {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} until the start of your next turn.

entries: Additionally, when you would spend 1 tech point to apply an empowerment effect, it no longer reduces your maximum tech points.

subclassFeature.name: Artillerist Technique (Companion)
entries: While some scouts choose to foray alone, others like to have support. Followers of the Artillerist Technique master control of militant constructs, laying waste to the battlefield with their {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in artillerist's implements.

subclassFeature.name: Turret Companion
entries: You learn to apply your knowledge to construct and bond with your own portable turret.
Create your turret companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content. You must have artillerist's implements in order to create your turret.
In addition to its traits and features, your turret companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

items: Your turret is a valid target of the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

Your turret gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each turret trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of turret traits equal to half your Intelligence modifier (rounded up, minimum of one).
When you would make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can let your turret make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} instead.

entries: Lastly, while your turret is bonded, within 10 feet of you, and the target of your {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, when you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} with a range of 5 feet or greater, you can cast it as if you were in your turret's space, and the range increases to 10 feet if it isn't greater.
Both the range and radius increase to 30 feet at 11th level, and 60 feet at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Turret Companion
entries: You learn to apply your knowledge to construct and bond with your own portable turret.
Create your turret companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content. You must have artillerist's implements in order to create your turret.
In addition to its traits and features, your turret companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

items: Your turret is a valid target of the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

When you would make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can let your turret make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} instead.

Both the range and radius increase to 30 feet at 11th level, and 60 feet at 17th level.

entries: You learn to apply your knowledge to construct and bond with your own portable turret.
Create your turret companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content. You must have artillerist's implements in order to create your turret.
In addition to its traits and features, your turret companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

items: Your turret is a valid target of the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

Your turret gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each turret trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of turret traits equal to half your Intelligence modifier (rounded up, minimum of one).
When you would make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can let your turret make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} instead.

Both the range and radius increase to 30 feet at 11th level, and 60 feet at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Mark of the Artillerist
entries: Once per round, when your turret deals damage to the target of your Ranger's Quarry, you can roll your Ranger's Quarry die and add it to the damage roll.

subclassFeature.name: Crisis Management
entries: While you can see your turret, it can add half its {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to any {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} it makes that doesn't already include it.

subclassFeature.name: Double Up
entries: When you deal damage to a creature with a weapon or {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, your turret has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} it makes against the creature or it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the first {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} it makes against an effect your turret controls before the start of your next turn. When your turret deals damage to a creature, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on your next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against the creature or it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the first {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} it makes against an effect you control before the start of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Battlefront
entries: When you use your Combat Tech feature, both you and your turret can each make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} as part of the same {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

subclassFeature.name: Astrotech Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Astrotech Engineering discipline focus on utilizing their vast knowledge of droid technology to confuse, confound, and destroy enemy tech, droids and constructs.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements}. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements}, the rate at which you craft doubles.

subclassFeature.name: Electronic Warfare Platform
entries: You learn to modify your {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements} into a {@feat Mobile|sw5e-phb|mobile} electronic warfare platform. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can modify your {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements}. You must have {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements} in order to perform this modification.

Your electronic warfare platform is enhanced, requires attunement, can only be used by you, and counts as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while you are attuned to it. Your electronic warfare platform has 4 modification slots, and it gains more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. For each modification installed in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
Some modification effects require {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your tech save DC.

Your electronic warfare platform comes equipped with electromagnetic projection and sensing systems, enabling three fields: ionizing, jamming, and targeting. entries.name: Jamming Field
entries: Whenever you or a friendly creature within 10 feet of you are forced to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} by a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, the creature gains a bonus to the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

entries.name: Targeting Field
entries: You and friendly creatures within 5 feet of you gain a bonus to the first ranged weapon damage rolls you make each round equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

subclassFeature.name: Electronic Warfare Platform
entries: You learn to modify your {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements} into a {@feat Mobile|sw5e-phb|mobile} electronic warfare platform. subclassFeature.name: Potent Electromagnetism
entries: Once per round, when you deal damage to a droid or construct, you can expend one use of your Potent Aptitude to deal an extra 2d6 damage to that target. The damage is the same type as the source of the damage.
The damage increases when you reach certain levels in this class, increasing to 3d6 at 5th level, 5d6 at 10th level, and 8d6 at 15th level.

subclassFeature.name: Direct Controller
entries: Your mastery of droids improves your ability to manipulate them. When you cast a power that could affect only droids or constructs, and you only affect droids with the power, you can choose to treat the power as if cast at your Max Power Level.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
