You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Systems Hijack
entries: All droids, constructs, and creatures wearing or holding a {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} focus within 120 feet are viable targets for any {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} which you cast with a range of touch.

subclassFeature.name: Electromagnetic Burst
entries: As an action, you can end your field in a electromagnetic burst of power with an effect determined by the field you were generating.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Ionizing Burst
entries: Choose up to 10 creatures of your choice that are within 60 feet. Each must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a target takes 14d6 ion damage and is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the start of your next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and isn't {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned}.

entries.name: Jamming Burst
entries: Choose up to 10 creatures of your choice that are within 60 feet. Once in the next minute, when a chosen creature fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} caused by a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or is hit by an attack power, the creature can choose to succeed on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or have the attack miss instead.

entries.name: Targeting Burst
entries: Choose up to 10 creatures of your choice that are within 60 feet. Each creature must succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC or be {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} for 1d4+1 turns.

subclassFeature.name: Astrotech Modifications
entries: If a modification has prerequisites, you must meet them to install it. You can install the modification at the same time that you meet its prerequisites.

entries.name: AI Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to melee tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: AI Rangefinder
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to ranged tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Advanced Hardening
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Hardening} You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to ion damage.

entries.name: Advanced Grounding System
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Grounding System} You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to lightning damage.

entries.name: Advanced Jamming Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Jamming Phased Array} While your jamming field is active, any hostile creature within the field must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} at the end of each of its turns to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on the power.

entries.name: Advanced Ionizing Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Pulsating Phased Array} While your ionizing field is active, your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and class features ignore {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to ion damage, and immunity to ion damage is instead treated as {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} from any creature within range of your field.
Additionally, when you use your Ionizing Phased Array feature, you create a fourth blast.

entries.name: Advanced Targeting Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Targeting Phased Array} While your targeting field is active, as an action, you can allow a number of allies within the field up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one) to use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against a single target you can see.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Droid Restraints
entries: When you would install a {@item Restraining bolt|sw5e-phb|restraining bolt}, you can do so in half the time. Additionally, when determining the save DC of a {@item Restraining bolt|sw5e-phb|restraining bolt} you control, you can use your tech save DC, if it would be higher than the item's DC.

entries.name: Flashlight Attachment
entries: You affix a targeted light to your electronic warfare platform. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can toggle the light on or off. While on, your electronic warfare platform sheds bright light in a 60-foot cone.

entries.name: Fadecasting Controller
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Strength or Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Grounding System
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against lightning damage.

entries.name: Hacked Communications
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you may choose any number of creatures that you can see within 60 feet of you that have commlinks, headcomms, or other such communications devices. Each creature must succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or take sonic damage equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one). Additionally, on a failed save, their communication devices are disabled until rebooted.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Hardening
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against ion damage.

entries.name: Intelligence Core Override
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} You can cast the {@i override interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} at 5th level without spending tech points.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Ionizing Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While your ionizing field is active, as an action, you can send forth blasts of directed ionic energy. Make two ranged tech attacks against targets within the field. These attacks can target the same creature or different ones. Make separate {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} for each blast. The attack deals 1d6 ion damage on a hit.

entries.name: Jamming Phased Array
entries: While your jamming field is active, as an action, you can choose a number of creatures concentrating on a power equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of one) within your field, and force them to make a {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb} {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If you cause at least one creature to lose {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on a power using this feature, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make all creatures that lost {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} take ion damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

entries.name: Miniaturized Repulsor Coils
entries: Your electronic warfare platform can store 20 lb., not exceeding 1 cubic foot, which does not count towards your encumbrance.

entries.name: Prototype Transmitter
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level} You further tweak your transmitter design, extending the area of your fields.  When you activate a field you may choose to double the radius of your field.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Prototype Grounding System
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Grounding System} You have immunity to the {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} condition.

entries.name: Prototype Jamming Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Jamming Phased Array} While your jamming field is active, when a creature within your field attempts to cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to cast the {@i tech override} power at 3rd level without spending tech points. When you cast this power using this feature and you make the {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} check as a part of this casting, you add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to the check.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Prototype Ionizing Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Ionizing Phased Array} While your ionizing field is active, when you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or use a class feature that affects other creatures within the radius of your field, you can choose a number of them equal to 1 + the power's level. The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against the power, and they take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.
Additionally, when you use your Ionizing Phased Array feature, you create a third blast.

entries.name: Prototype Targeting Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Target Marking Phased Array} While your targeting field is active, as an action, you can cast the {@i scramble interface} power at 3rd level without spending tech points.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Redundant Circuits
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level} You can have two fields active at a time.

entries.name: Rendcasting Controller
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Dexterity or Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Sensor Scramblers
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} All creatures within 10 feet of you become undetectable to electronic sensors and cameras for the next 10 minutes. Anything these creatures are wearing or carrying is also undetectable, so long as it's on the creature's person. The creatures are still visible to regular vision.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Stealth Field Generator
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level} You integrate a portable, personal cloaking device into your electronic warfare platform. Activating or deactivating the generator requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} that rely on sight. The generator lasts for 1 minute. This effect ends early if you make an attack or cast a force or {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.
Once the generator has been activated, it can't be activated again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Targeting Phased Array
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While your targeting field is active, as an action, you can choose a number of creatures equal to your Intelligence modifier you can see within 60 feet (a minimum of one creaeture), and force them to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, all ranged weapon attacks made by allies within your field against the target have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} until the beginning of your next turn.

entries.name: Truelight Attachment
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level, Flashlight Attachment} You modify your electronic warfare platform with a toggle allowing you to briefly gain enhanced sight. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can activate the {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight} feature of your electronic warfare platform. When toggled on, for the next minute your electronic warfare platform now automatically dispel illusions and can {@spell Detect Invisibility|sw5e-phb|detect invisibility}, as with {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight}.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Withercasting Controller
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Wisdom or Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: X-Ray Targeting
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You tweak your sensors to find weak points in thick armor. Your weapon attacks and {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} deal double damage against constructs.

subclassFeature.name: Astrotech Engineering (Companion)
entries: Those engineers who choose the Astrotech Engineering discipline focus on crafting and upgrading their droid companions.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements}. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements}, the rate at which you craft doubles.

subclassFeature.name: Droid Companion
entries: You employ all the knowledge you've accumulated to create and bond with your own droid companion.

Create your droid companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content. You must have {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements} in order to create your droid.
In addition to its traits and features, your droid companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

items: Your droid is a valid target of the {@i tracker droid interface} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

Your droid gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each droid trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of droid traits equal to half your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).

entries: Lastly, while bonded and within 10 feet of you, when you would use your action to cast a 1st-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you can instead have your droid companion cast it. You still expend tech points as normal, and if the power requires {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}, it still uses your {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}. Your droid companion must use its action, and it uses its tech attack modifier and tech save DC instead of your own. At 5th level, your droid can cast 2nd-level {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} in this way. This increases to 3rd-level powers at 9th level, 4th-level powers at 13th level, and 5th-level powers at 17th level. When you cast a power, you consume a number of uses of this feature equal to that power's level.
At 11th level, your droid companion must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, your droid companion must be within 60 feet.

You can use this feature four times, and you gain more uses at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. Each time you use this feature in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1 until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

At 11th level, your droid companion must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, your droid companion must be within 60 feet.

You can use this feature four times, and you gain more uses at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. Each time you use this feature in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1 until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Potent Integration
entries: When your droid makes an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to expend one use of your Potent Aptitude to give it a boost. Roll the die and add it to both the attack and damage rolls, if the attack hits.

subclassFeature.name: Direct Controller
entries: Your mastery of droids improves your ability to manipulate them. When you cast a power that could affect only droids or constructs, and you only affect droids with the power, you can choose to treat the power as if cast at your Max Power Level.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Direct Controller
entries: Your mastery of droids improves your ability to manipulate them. When you cast a power that could affect only droids or constructs, and you only affect droids with the power, you can choose to treat the power as if cast at your Max Power Level.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Direct Controller
entries: Your mastery of droids improves your ability to manipulate them. When you cast a power that could affect only droids or constructs, and you only affect droids with the power, you can choose to treat the power as if cast at your Max Power Level.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Direct Controller
entries: Your mastery of droids improves your ability to manipulate them. When you cast a power that could affect only droids or constructs, and you only affect droids with the power, you can choose to treat the power as if cast at your Max Power Level.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Coordinated Attack
entries: When you are the source of an effect that would force other creatures to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and your droid is one of those creatures, you can have your droid automatically succeed on the save. When your droid is the source of an effect that would force other creatures to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and you are one of those creatures, you can choose to automatically succeed on the save.

subclassFeature.name: Droid Defense
entries: While your droid can see you, it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on all {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.

subclassFeature.name: Ataru Form
entries: {@optfeature Ataru Form|sw5e-phb}, also know as Aggression Form, is a kinetically active form that relies on {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, acrobatics, and power. Those guardians who focus on {@optfeature Ataru Form|sw5e-phb} utilize high energy tactics to confuse and distract their opponents, quickly moving about the battlefield.

subclassFeature.name: Form Basics
entries: You gain the Ataru {@book lightsaber form, detailed in chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms} of the Player's Handbook. If you already know this form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

subclassFeature.name: The Way of the Hawk-Bat
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can take an aggressive stance, leaping around the battlefield for 1 minute. As a part of this {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each of your turns, you can cast the {@i force jump} power at 1st-level without expending force points. Additionally, when you cast {@i force jump}, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} you make against each creature within 5 feet of where you land.

This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Channel the Force
entries: You gain the following Channel the Force option.

entries.name: Retreating Leap
entries: When a creature makes a melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against you, you can expend a use of your Channel the Force and your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to jump 10 feet in a direction of your choice, imposing {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the roll. This movement does not provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}. You can wait until after the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} is made, but before the DM determines whether the attack hits.

subclassFeature.name: Hawk-Bat Swoop
entries: You gain the ability to move along vertical surfaces without falIing during the move. If you end your turn in the air, you fall immediately to the ground.
Additionally, you no longer take damage when falling from a distance no greater than your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.

subclassFeature.name: Whirlwind Attack
entries: You can use your action to make melee attacks against any number of creatures within 5 feet of you, with a separate {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} for each target.

subclassFeature.name: Master of Aggression
entries: Your presence on the field of battle is as a graceful blur of deadly blades and daring acrobatics. Your Dexterity and Wisdom or Charisma scores (your choice) increase by 2. Your maximum for those scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to kinetic, energy, and ion damage from weapons.
When an ally within 30 feet of you takes the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, they can make one additional attack as a part of that same action.
When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can move up to 10 feet. This movement does not provoke {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Audiotech Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Audiotech Engineering discipline focus on using a specially modified instrument to use music to {@optfeature Assist|sw5e-phb|assist} their allies and disrupt their enemies.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in three musical instruments and audiotech's implements. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with audiotech's implements, the rate at which you craft doubles.

subclassFeature.name: Modified Instrument
entries: You learn to modify an instrument utilizing your audiotech knowledge. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can modify an instrument. You must have the instrument and audiotech's implements in order to perform this modification.

Your modified instrument is enhanced, requires attunement, can only be used by you, and counts as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while you are attuned to it. Your modified instrument has 4 modification slots, and it gains more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. For each modification installed in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
Some modification effects require {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your tech save DC.

subclassFeature.name: Potent Amplitude
entries: As an action while wielding your modified instrument, you can begin performing an enhanced song, which lasts for 1 minute. While playing a song, you gain access to a new use for your Potent Aptitude, as determined by the song, listed below. You can end your song at any time, no action required.

Whenever you take damage while playing your song, you must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to continue playing. The DC equals 10 or half the damage you take, which number is higher. If you take damage from multiple sources, you must make a separate {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} for each source of damage.

When you cast a damage dealing {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while playing your song that requires an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can cause that power to instead deal sonic damage. If you do so, instead of an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the power instead requires a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.
Your song ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die, or if you are no longer holding your modified instrument.
You can initiate playing an enhanced song twice. You regain all expended songs when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Song of Battle
entries: When an ally within 60 feet of you that can hear you deals damage to a creature, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to expend one use of your Potent Aptitude, adding the result of the die to the damage dealt.

entries.name: Song of Support
entries: When an ally within 60 feet of you that can hear you makes a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a harmful effect, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to expend one use of your Potent Aptitude, adding the result of the die to their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

entries.name: Song of Disruption
entries: When an enemy within 60 feet of you that can hear you makes a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to expend one use of your Potent Aptitude, subtracting the result of the die from their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

subclassFeature.name: Concussive Blast
entries: You add your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of +1) to any damage you deal with {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and class features that deal sonic damage.

subclassFeature.name: Smooth Rhythm
entries: Whenever you use your Potent Aptitude while your playing an enhanced song, you can roll a {@dice d6} and use it instead of expending a Potent Aptitude Dice.

subclassFeature.name: Legendary Coda
entries: You've gained mastery over your modified instrument. As an action, you can end your enhanced song in a triumphant blast of power with an effect determined by the song you are playing.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Battle Crescendo
entries: Choose up to 10 creatures of your choice that you can see and that can hear your song. Each must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a target takes 14d6 sonic damage and is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} for 1d4+1 turns. On a success, it takes half damage and isn't {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned}. If a creature is killed by this power, its head explodes.

entries.name: Support Crescendo
entries: Choose up to 10 creatures of your choice that you can see and that can hear your song. Once in the next minute, each creature can, as a free action in response to taking damage, choose to halve that damage. Additionally, if the damage would reduce them to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, they are instead reduced to 1.

entries.name: Disruption Crescendo
entries: Choose up to 10 creatures of your choice that you can see and that can hear your song. Each creature must succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be {@condition Paralyzed|sw5e-phb|paralyzed} for 1d4+1 turns. If a creature affected by this feature is damaged in any way, the effect ends for that creature.

subclassFeature.name: Audiotech Modifications
entries: If a modification has prerequisites, you must meet them to install it. You can install the modification at the same time that you meet its prerequisites.

entries.name: Advanced Battle Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Battle Enhancement} While playing your Song of Battle, your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} and class features ignore {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to sonic damage, and immunity to sonic damage is instead treated as {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} from any creature within range of your song that can hear you.
Additionally, when you use your Battle Song Enhancement feature, you create a fourth burst.

entries.name: Advanced Disruption Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Disruption Enhancement} While playing your Song of Disruption, any hostile creature within range of your song that can hear you must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} at the end of each of its turns to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on the power.

entries.name: Advanced Support Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level, Prototype Support Enhancement} While playing your Song of Support, allies add your Intelligence modifier to their {@variantrule Death Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|death saving throws} (minimum of +1). If this amount would increase the roll of the {@dice d20} to 20 or greater, the creature regains 1 hit point.

entries.name: Battle Song Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While playing your Song of Battle, as an action, you can send forth busts of directed sonic energy, make two ranged power attacks. These attacks can target the same creature different ones. Make separate {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} for each burst. The attack has a range equal to the radius of your song, and deals 1d8 sonic damage on a hit.

entries.name: Disruption Song Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While playing your Song of Disruption, as an action, you can choose a number of creatures concentrating on a power equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of one) within range of your song that can hear you, and force them to make a {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb} {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If you cause at least one creature to lose {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on a power using this feature, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make all creatures that lost {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} take damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

entries.name: Enthralling Performance
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level, Hypnotic Melody} For the duration of an enhanced song you play, whenever any creature that can hear your song tries to attack you for the first time on a turn, the attacker must make a Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it can't attack you on this turn, and it must choose a new target for its attack or the attack is wasted. On a successful save, it can attack you on this turn, but it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on any {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} it makes against your powers or features on your next turn.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Finding My Way
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} Rush} While you are playing an enhanced song, when a creature would make a melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to move 5 feet without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}, imposing {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the roll.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Hypnotic Melody
entries: As an action while wielding your modified instrument, you can begin to play a song woven with subtle hypnotic influence. Choose a number of creature up to your Intelligence modifier. If those creatures listen to this song for a full minute, they must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or become {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} by you for 1 minute. Creatures that succeed the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} are not aware that you attempted to influence them, nor are creatures that failed their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} once the power ends.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Inaudible Casting
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Simple Melodies} When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or make use of a feature that requires playing your modified instrument, you can choose to do so quietly. Creatures have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) and Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sound to determine you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}.

entries.name: Long Range Noise
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level} The radius of your songs increases to 120 feet. Additionally, any {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast with your modified instrument that deals sonic damage and has a range of 10 feet or greater gains a range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Magnifying Device
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your instrument as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Overwhelming Soundwaves
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level} While playing, creatures of your choice treat a 15-foot-radius sphere around you as {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}. Additionally, as an action, you can cause each affected creature to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, taking 3d8 sonic damage on a failed save.

entries.name: Prototype Battle Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Battle Song Enhancement} While playing your Song of Battle, when you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or use a class feature that affects other creatures within the radius of your song, you can choose a number of them equal to 1 + the power's level. The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against the power, and they take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save.
Additionally, when you use your Battle Song Enhancement feature, you create a third burst.

entries.name: Prototype Disruption Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Disruption Song Enhancement} While playing your Song of Disruption, when a creature you can see that can hear you attempts to cast a power, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to cast the {@i tech override} power at 3rd level. When you cast this power using this feature, the power works against both tech and {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, and when you make the {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} check as a part of this casting, you your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to the check.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Prototype Support Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Support Song Enhancement} While playing your Song of Support, when you use your Song of Support's Potent Amplitude feature, the target instead takes no damage if they succeed on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if they fail.

entries.name: Restful Melody
entries: Over the course of a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, you can play a rejuvenating song to {@optfeature Assist|sw5e-phb|assist} in the recovery of your allies. If you or any friendly creatures who can hear your performance regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} at the end of the {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, each of those creatures regains an extra 1d6 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.
The extra {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} increase when you reach certain levels in this class: to 1d8 at 9th level, to 1d 10 at 13th level, and to 1d12 at 17th level.

entries.name: Rush
entries: While you are playing an enhanced song, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 10 feet, and {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} made against you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

entries.name: Sharp Noise
entries: As an action while wielding your modified instrument, choose a creature you can see. If it can hear you, it must succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or take 1d4 sonic damage and have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on its next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} before the end of its next turn.
This feature's damage increases by 1d4 when you reach 5th level (2d4), 11th level (3d4), and 17th level (4d4).

entries.name: Shock Mount
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your instrument as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to your tech save DC. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Simple Melodies
entries: When you are holding your modified instrument, and not actively playing a song, any {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that you could cast that could have its damage type altered by your Potent Amplitude feature can be cast as if used with Potent Amplitude.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Sonar Pulse
entries: As an action while wielding your modified instrument, you can {@spell Release|sw5e-phb|release} a wave of sound that provides {@spell Feedback|sw5e-phb|feedback} on your surroundings. For the next minute, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) checks to search for hidden doors, traps, or {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} creatures.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Song Flow
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level} While playing an enhanced song, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to change from one song to another.

entries.name: Support Song Enhancement
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While playing your Song of Support, when you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that restores {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} or grants temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, the amount restored or granted is increased by an amount equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of +1).

entries.name: Weapon Integration
entries: You can integrate a single weapon that weighs no more than 8 lb. into your instrument. While integrated, that weapon gains the hidden property.

subclassFeature.name: Beastmaster Approach
entries: Many berserkers feel a primal attunement to nature. For berserkers of the Beastmaster Approach, that attunement manifests itself in bestial marks and manifestations that grant the berserker newfound abilities.

subclassFeature.name: Bestial Fury
entries: While raging, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on any Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) or Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) checks.

Additionally, once on each of your turns while raging, you can mark a creature you can see as your prey for the duration of your rage (no action required). When you do so, once per turn when you deal damage to the creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you deal an additional 1d4 damage of the same type. Once per turn when the creature deals damage to you with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you take an additional 1d4 damage of the same type. This die increases to {@dice d6} at 5th level, {@dice d8} at 9th level, {@dice d10} at 13th level, and {@dice d12} at 17th level. You can only have one creature marked in this way at a time.

subclassFeature.name: Pack Tactics
entries: When you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against a creature, another enemy of the creature is within 5 feet of it, that enemy isn't {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}, you can reroll one of the dice once.

subclassFeature.name: Animalistic Momentum
entries: You gain a your choice of a climbing or swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. Additionally, you gain an effect while raging based on your choice of {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}:

items: If you chose a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, you can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}.
If you chose a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to Dash or Disengage while in water.

subclassFeature.name: Lick Wounds
entries: Whenever you reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} while raging, you gain a number of temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your berserker level, which last for the duration of your rage.

subclassFeature.name: Hunter's Call
entries: When you enter your rage, you can choose up to 5 allies that you can see within 30 feet of you. You gain 5 temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} for each creature. For the duration of your rage, once on each of their turns, an affected ally can add your rage damage bonus to a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}'s damage roll.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Hunter's Call
entries: When you enter your rage, you can choose up to 5 allies that you can see within 30 feet of you. You gain 5 temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} for each creature. For the duration of your rage, once on each of their turns, an affected ally can add your rage damage bonus to a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}'s damage roll.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Beastmaster Approach (Companion)
entries: Many berserkers feel a primal attunement to nature. For berserkers of the Beastmaster Approach, that attunement manifests itself in a bond with a beast companion that accompanies a berserker on his journey.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in {@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb}.

subclassFeature.name: Beast Companion
entries: You learn to capitalize on a primal attunement to nature to forge a powerful bond with your own beast companion.
Create your beast companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content.
In addition to its traits and features, your beast companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

items: Your beast gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each beast trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your number of available Hit Dice that can be spend to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} is reduced by 1.

entries: Lastly, while bonded and within 10 feet of you, your beast companion gains the benefits of one of your chosen instincts. If that instinct relies on raging, your beast companion gains the benefits of that instinct while you are raging.
At 11th level, your companion must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, your companion must be within 60 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Beast Companion
entries: You learn to capitalize on a primal attunement to nature to forge a powerful bond with your own beast companion.
Create your beast companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content.
In addition to its traits and features, your beast companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

items: Your beast gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each beast trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your number of available Hit Dice that can be spend to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} is reduced by 1.

entries: Lastly, while bonded and within 10 feet of you, your beast companion gains the benefits of one of your chosen instincts. If that instinct relies on raging, your beast companion gains the benefits of that instinct while you are raging.
At 11th level, your companion must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, your companion must be within 60 feet.

Create your beast companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content.
In addition to its traits and features, your beast companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

items: Your beast gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each beast trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your number of available Hit Dice that can be spend to restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} is reduced by 1.

entries: Lastly, while bonded and within 10 feet of you, your beast companion gains the benefits of one of your chosen instincts. If that instinct relies on raging, your beast companion gains the benefits of that instinct while you are raging.
At 11th level, your companion must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, your companion must be within 60 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Pack Tactics
entries: When you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against a creature your companion has dealt damage since the start of your last turn, you can reroll one of the dice once. When your companion has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against a creature you've dealt damage since the start of your last turn, it can reroll one of the dice once.

subclassFeature.name: Animalistic Momentum
entries: Your bond with your beast companion strengthens, granting the following benefits while your beast companion is within 10 feet of you:

items: If you or your beast have a climbing or swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} and the other doesn't, the other gains it with the same {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. If you both have the a climbing or swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, you both use the larger {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of the two, which then increases by 5 feet.
Whenever your beast deals damage to a hostile creature you can see on your turn, it counts as you taking a hostile action for the purposes of maintaining your rage.

Whenever your beast deals damage to a hostile creature you can see on your turn, it counts as you taking a hostile action for the purposes of maintaining your rage.

If you both have the a climbing or swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, you both use the larger {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of the two, which then increases by 5 feet.
Whenever your beast deals damage to a hostile creature you can see on your turn, it counts as you taking a hostile action for the purposes of maintaining your rage.
