subclassFeature.name: Lick Wounds
entries: Whenever your companion reduces a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} while you are raging, it gains a number of temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your berserker level, which last for the duration of your rage.

subclassFeature.name: Hunter's Call
entries: When you enter your rage, you can choose up to 5 allies that you can see within 30 feet of you. You gain 5 temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} for each creature. For the duration of your rage, once on each of their turns, an affected ally can add your rage damage bonus to a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}'s damage roll.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Hunter's Call
entries: When you enter your rage, you can choose up to 5 allies that you can see within 30 feet of you. You gain 5 temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} for each creature. For the duration of your rage, once on each of their turns, an affected ally can add your rage damage bonus to a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}'s damage roll.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Biochem Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Biochem Engineering discipline focus on utilizing their vast knowledge of medicine and chemistry to supply allies with potent healing and enemies with debilitating poisons and acids.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb} skill, biochemist's kits, and poisoner's kits. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with biochemist's kits and poisoner's kits, the rate at which you craft doubles.

subclassFeature.name: Modified Biochemist's Pack
entries: You learn to modify and combine your {@item Biochemist's kit|sw5e-phb|biochemist's kit} and {@item Poisoner's kit|sw5e-phb|poisoner's kit}, creating a {@feat Mobile|sw5e-phb|mobile} laboratory using your chemistry {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise}. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can create your modified biochemist's pack. You must have a {@item Biochemist's kit|sw5e-phb|biochemist's kit}, a {@item Poisoner's kit|sw5e-phb|poisoner's kit}, and materials in order to perform this modification.

Your biochemist's pack is enhanced, requires attunement, can only be used by you, and counts as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} while you are attuned to it. Your modified biochemist's pack has 4 modification slots, and it gains more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. For each modification installed in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
Some modification effects require {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your tech save DC.

Your modified biochemist's pack comes equipped with a chemical distribution system, complete with three chemical mixtures: corrosive, invigorating, and noxious. As an action, you can activate your distributor and target a creature within 30 feet, with an effect determined by the mixture.

entries.name: Corrosive Mixture
entries: Your distributor emits a burst of acid. The target must make a Dexterity sav-ing throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d6 + your Intelligence modifier acid damage. This mixture's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

entries.name: Invigorating Mixture
entries: Your distributor emits a bolt of kolto. The target gains 1d6 + your Intelligence modifier temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, which last until the end of your next turn. The temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} granted by this mixture increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

entries.name: Noxious Mixture
entries: Your distributor emits a cloud of {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}. The target must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature takes 1d6 + your Intelligence modifier {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage. This mixture's damage increases by 1d6 when you reach 5th level (2d6), 11th level (3d6), and 17th level (4d6).

subclassFeature.name: Biochemist's Touch
entries: Whenever you grant temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, or deal acid or {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage using a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature, you may expend one use of your Potent Aptitude to increase the potency. When you do so, the amount of temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} you grant or damage you deal is increased by the amount rolled on the die. The damage is the same type as the original damage.

subclassFeature.name: Potent Mixtures
entries: When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 1st-level or higher that grants temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, or deals acid or {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage, you add your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of +1) to the roll.

subclassFeature.name: Epicenter
entries: As a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} when you take damage from a creature within 15 feet of you that you can see, you can use one of your mixtures. The effects of the mixture {@spell Release|sw5e-phb|release} in a 15-foot-radius sphere centered on you, and if the mixture requires a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you automatically succeed on it. Additionally, the affected area is {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain} to creatures other than you until the end of your next turn.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Masterful Mixtures
entries: When you deal acid or {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage using a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature, you ignore {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} and treat immunity as {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance}.

subclassFeature.name: Biochem Modifications
entries: If a modification has prerequisites, you must meet them to install it. You can install the modification at the same time that you meet its prerequisites.

entries.name: Biochemist's Amplifer
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your biochemist's pack as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Biochemist's Inhibitor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your biochemist's pack as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to your tech save DC. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Chemical Counteragents
entries: You may choose one type of damage that benefits from your Biochemist's Touch and Potent Mixtures features. While wearing your modified biochemist's pack you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to that type of damage.
You can select this modification multiple times. Each time you do so, you must choose a different damage type.

entries.name: Countertoxin
entries: When you or an ally within 30 feet of you is suffering from the {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} condition, you may use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} on your turn to end the {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} condition on that creature. The creature also gains immunity to the {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} condition for one minute.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Detachable Distribution System
entries: You upgrade your distributor with a secondary, detachable distributor. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can throw your detachable distributor at a point within range. Your detachable distributor has a range equal to 30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5. Your detachable distributor works for 1 minute before coming inert. Once it does so, you can't use it again until you recover it as an action.

Additionally, while your detachable distributor is within 100 feet of you, when you use your action to activate your distributor, you can choose to affect each creature within 5 feet of your detachable distributor. You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Drone Distribution System
entries: You upgrade your distributor, interfacing it with the target of your {@i tracker droid interface} power. When you use your action to activate your distributor, while your tracker droid is within 100 feet of you, you can choose to have your tracker droid deliver the mixture. Your tracker droid must use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to deliver the mixture.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Expanded Chemicals: Combustibles
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You add additional chemicals to your modified biochemist's pack. When you deal fire damage with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature, you can use your Biochemist's Touch and Potent Mixture features.

Additionally, when a creature fails their Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your Corrosive Mixtures feature, you can choose to instead deal fire damage. If you do so, each creature within 5 feet of the target takes fire damage equal to your Intelligence modifier. You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Expanded Chemicals: Cryogenics
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You add additional chemicals to your modified biochemist's pack. When you deal cold damage with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature, you can use your Biochemist's Touch and Potent Mixture features.

Additionally, when a creature fails their Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your Noxious Mixtures feature, you can choose to instead deal cold damage. If you do so, it gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level until the start of your next turn. You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Expanded Chemicals: Restorative
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You add additional chemicals to your modified biochemist's pack. When you restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature, you can use your Biochemist's Touch and Potent Mixture features.

Additionally, when you use your Invigorating Mixture to grant temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a creature, you can choose to restore that many {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to the same creature. You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Expanded Mixtures: Adhesive
entries: You've created a new mixture from your chemicals that you can use when you activate your distributor. When you do so, the target creature must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If the creature is Large or larger, it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature gains 4 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} levels until the start of your next turn. As an action on their turn, an affected creature can repeat this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Expanded Mixtures: Blinding
entries: You've created a new mixture from your chemicals that you can use when you activate your distributor. When you do so, the target creature must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature is {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Expanded Mixtures: Hallucinogenic
entries: You've created a new mixture from your chemicals that you can use when you activate your distributor. When you do so, the target creature must make an Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the target loses the ability to distinguish friend from foe, regarding all creatures it can see as enemies until the end of your next turn. Each time the target takes damage, it can repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, ending the effect on itself on a success.

Whenever the affected creature chooses another creature as a target, it must choose the target at random from among the creatures it can see within range of the attack, power, or other ability it's using. If an enemy provokes an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} from the affected creature, the creature must make that attack if it is able to.
This feature has no effect on droids or constructs.

entries.name: Explosive Distribution System
entries: You upgrade your distributor, granting it the ability to create a volley. When you use your action to activate your distributor, you can choose to affect each creature in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see within 30 feet.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Injection Apparatus
entries: You install a wrist mounted injection apparatus into your modified biochemist's pack. It is a {@filter simple vibroweapon|items|type=martial weapon|weaponcategory=simple} with the finesse and light properties, and deals 1d4 kinetic damage on a hit. Your injection apparatus does not fill the hand slot, but you can't use it while the hand is full.

When you hit with the weapon, you can activate your distributor to deploy one of your mixtures. If you do so, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your mixture.

entries.name: Inoculation
entries: You gain immunity to the {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} and disease conditions.

entries.name: Integrated EVA Functionality
entries: You make several additions to your modified biochemist's pack, you are protected from hazardous conditions, as if wearing an EVA suit, for as long as you are wearing your modified biochemist's pack.

entries.name: Kolto Aerosol
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} You add a special dispersal system to your modified biochemist's pack. This system slowly disperses small amounts of kolto in the air. If creatures spend the entirety of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} within 30 feet of you, they regain all expended Hit Dice, instead of only half. Additionally, they are cured of any poisons or diseases that are suffering from.

entries.name: Long-Range Distribution System
entries: You upgrade your distributor, improving the range. When you use your action to activate your distributor, you can choose to increase the range to 60 feet.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Luminous Gel
entries: You've added a light-emitting gel to your modified biochemist's pack. As an action, you can coat an item, object, or location up to 5-foot-square with this gel. When you do so, the gel sheds bright light in a 10-foot radius and dim light for an additional 10 feet. The gel lasts for 1 hour before losing its potency. You can end this effect as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Oil Spill
entries: As an action, you can cast the {@i oil slick} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} without expending tech points. Casting the power in this way does not require {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}, and the oil will remain in place for the full duration of the power.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Persistent Chemicals
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level} Whenever you use your Biochemist's Touch feature, you may select one creature that was damaged. At the start of each of that creature's turns, it must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it takes damage of the triggering type equal to your Intelligence modifier and has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} until the start of its next turn. On a success, this feature ends, and the creature becomes immune to it for one day.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Piercing Gel
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level, Luminous Gel} Your luminous gel now automatically dispels illusions and can {@spell Detect Invisibility|sw5e-phb|detect invisibility}, as with {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight}.

entries.name: Self-Injection Module
entries: You install a special kolto injector into your modified biochemist's pack that can inject you with kolto in response to pain. When you take damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a Hit Die to regain health as long as the damage would not reduce your {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to 0.

entries.name: Smart Dispersal System
entries: When you activate your distributor, you can choose a number of creature equal to your Intelligence modifier. Those creature automatically succeed on their {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against your mixtures.

entries.name: Spray Distribution System
entries: You upgrade your distributor, granting it the ability to spray in a cone. When you use your action to activate your distributor, you can choose to affect each creature in a 15-foot cone.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Biotech Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Biotech Engineering discipline focus on the skill of modifying and upgrading the body through the use of cybernetic limbs and implants.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in {@item Biotech's implements|sw5e-phb|biotech's implements}. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with {@item Biotech's implements|sw5e-phb|biotech's implements}, the rate at which you craft doubles.

subclassFeature.name: Modified Self
entries: You've learned to make modifications to your body, cybernetically augmenting yourself. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can modify yourself with cybernetic augmentations. You must have {@item Biotech's implements|sw5e-phb|biotech's implements} in order to perform this modification.

While you have at least one cybernetic augmentation installed, your body counts as a tech focus for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. Additionally, you have 4 modification slots, and you gain more at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. For each modification installed in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of modifications up to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).
Some modification effects require {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. When you use such an effect from this class, the DC equals your tech save DC.

subclassFeature.name: Quick-Release Stimulant
entries: When you are dealt damage by an attack while you have at least one cybernetic augmentation installed, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend one use of your Potent Aptitude to reduce the damage you take. The damage is reduced by an amount equal to 1d10 + your Constitution modifier + your engineer level. If you reduce the damage to 0, you can gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the remaining damage reduction.

subclassFeature.name: Overclock Body
entries: You've learned to use your body as a conduit for your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you can choose to pay up to half the cost of the {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} using your {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} instead of your tech points. When you do so, your maximum {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} are reduced by the same amount until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: More Machine Than Man
entries: While you have temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, when you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to take only half damage, you instead take no damage if you succeed on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and only half damage if you fail.

subclassFeature.name: Focused Augmentation
entries: You add your Intelligence modifier to Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} you make to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}.
Additionally, when you cast a power that requires {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} and would affect only one target, you can target an additional creature with that power.

subclassFeature.name: Biotech Modifications
entries: If a modification has prerequisites, you must meet them to install it. You can install the modification at the same time that you meet its prerequisites.

entries.name: Active Camouflage Core
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level} As an action, you can activate this augmentation to cast the {@i infiltrate} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} targeting yourself. Intelligence is your tech casting ability for this power, and if you cast it using this augmentation, it does not require {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}.

entries.name: Anti-Dazzle Ocular Implant
entries: This augmentation replaces your eyes.

You are immune to the {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded} condition, and you can enable or disable your ability to see anytime. Additionally, your eyes are equipped with a {@item Holorecorder|sw5e-phb|holorecorder} device. You can perfectly recall anything you've seen in the last 7 days.

entries.name: Auto-Defibrillator
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, Hardy Torso Prothesis} The Constitution score of your Hardy Torso Prosthesis increases by 2. Additionally, when you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Brawny Arm Prosthesis
entries: This augmentation replaces an arm.

When you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength using only this arm, your Strength score is treated as 15. When you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} using Strength using more than just this arm, you take the average of the arm's Strength score and your own.
You can choose this modification multiple times.

entries.name: Celerity Leg Prosthesis
entries: This augmentation replaces both legs.

When determining your bonus to AC and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} from Dexterity, your Dexterity score is treated as 15. If your Dexterity score is already equal to or greater than 15, it has no effect on you.

Additionally, you can substitute this score for your own whenever you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} that uses your legs.

entries.name: Detachable Eye
entries: This augmentation replaces an eye.

As an action, you can remove or replace this eye. While removed, the eye sprouts eight small legs, has a {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 15 feet, an AC of 10, and 1 hit point. If it dies, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. As an action on each of your turns, you can move the eye up to its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} as long as it is within 30 feet of you. You can see through both the detached eye and your remaining eye at the same time, or you can use your action to see through only one eye or the other.
You can choose this modification multiple times.

entries.name: Detachable Hand
entries: This augmentation replaces a hand.

As an action, you can attach or detach this hand. While detached, the hand has a {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 15 feet, an AC of 10, and 1 hit point. If it dies, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. As an action on each of your turns, you can control the hand as long as it is within 30 feet of you. You can use the hand to manipulate an object, open an unlocked door or container, stow or retrieve an item from an open container, or pour the contents out of a container. You can move the hand up to its {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} each time you use it.
You can choose this modification multiple times.

entries.name: Fadecasting Inhibitor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your body as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Strength or Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Hardy Torso Prosthesis
entries: This augmentation replaces your torso.
Your Constitution score becomes 13. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}.

entries.name: Harpoon Hand
entries: This augmentation replaces a hand.

You modify your hand, granting it the ability to transform into a harpoon. With this hand, you can make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a range of 30/60. On a hit, it deals 1d6 kinetic damage. This attack can target a surface, object, or creature.

A creature struck by this attack is impaled by the harpoon. As an action, a creature can attempt to remove the harpoon. Removing the harpoon requires a Strength check. While the harpoon is stuck in the target, you are connected to the target by a 60 foot cable.

While the harpoon is deployed, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to activate the reel, pulling yourself to the location if the target is larger than you. A creature or object your size or smaller is pulled to you. Alternatively, you can opt to {@spell Release|sw5e-phb|release} the cable (no action required).
Once you've used this feature, you can't use your hand again until you recover and reinsert it as an action.
You can choose this modification multiple times.

entries.name: Integrated Subdermal Armor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} When you aren't wearing armor, your AC becomes 13 + your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Iridonian Grav-lev Hand
entries: This augmentation replaces a hand.

Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} with this arm deal 1d4 ion damage, and your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. Additionally, you deal double damage to energy-based structures with your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes}.
You can choose this modification multiple times.

entries.name: Magnetic Forearm Enhancement
entries: This augmentation replaces a forearm.
Unarmed strikes with this hand have the reach property.
You can choose this modification multiple times.

entries.name: Mighty Prowess Enabler
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, {@feat Brawny|sw5e-phb} Arm Prothesis} The Strength score of your {@feat Brawny|sw5e-phb} Arm Prosthesis increases by 2. Additionally, you are considered proficient with any weapon you wield with this arm. If the weapon requires two hands to use, and you are not already proficient with it, you only add half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} you make with it, unless you wield it with two of these arms.
You can choose this modification multiple times, but only once per arm.

entries.name: Nighthawk Ocular Implant
entries: This augmentation replaces your eyes.
You can activate or deactivate this implant as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. While active, you gain {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} to a range of 120 feet.

entries.name: Powered Harpoon Hand
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Harpoon Hand} While your harpoon hand is deployed, when you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} with a range of touch, your hand can deliver the power as if it had cast it.

entries.name: Rendcasting Inhibitor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your body as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Dexterity or Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Skills Enhancement Package
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level} When you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} using a skill you are proficient in, you can roll a {@dice d4} and add the result to your total.

entries.name: Sound Dampeners
entries: This augmentation replaces your ears.

You are immune to the {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened} condition, and you can enable or disable your ability to hear anytime. Additionally, your ears are equipped with a personal translator that allows you to understand up to 15 different languages, however, you cannot speak them. The languages can be changed out while interfaced with a protocol droid or appropriate computer.

entries.name: Surveillance Implant
entries: This augmentation replaces your face.
This implant includes a {@item Headcomm|sw5e-phb|headcomm} with a scrambler that automatically encodes messages sent to a specified recipient {@item Commlink|sw5e-phb|commlink} or receiver.

entries.name: Survival and Surveillance Implant
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} This augmentation replaces your eyes and face.

This implant contains several tools for long-term survival and reconnaissance. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can activate one of the below modes that enable you to use several of these tools at once. Activating a different mode deactivates any currently active mode.

items: {@b Communications Mode:} This communications suite includes a {@item Headcomm|sw5e-phb|headcomm} with a scrambler that automatically encodes messages sent to a specified recipient {@item Commlink|sw5e-phb|commlink} or receiver. While this mode is active, you cannot be {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened}.

{@b Interceptor Mode:} This is a jamming and electronic warfare suite that includes a {@item Comm jammer|sw5e-phb|comm jammer}, a {@item Holotrace device|sw5e-phb|holotrace device} and {@item Pocket scrambler|sw5e-phb|pocket scrambler}.

{@b Respirator Mode:} This includes a basic {@item Respirator|sw5e-phb|respirator} that grants {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid being {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} and {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage.

entries.name: Swift Gait Attuner
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level, Celerity Leg Prothesis} The Dexterity score of your Celerity Leg Prosthesis increases by 2. Additionally, you gain proficiency in Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.

entries.name: Vector Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your body as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to melee tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Vector Rangefinder
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your body as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to ranged tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

entries.name: Voice Synthesizer
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} This augmentation replaces your throat.

This augmentation allows you to synthesize and perfectly mimic any voice that you have heard in the last month, and the synthesizer can translate verbal communications between up to 5 languages. The languages can be changed out while interfaced with a protocol droid or appropriate computer. Additionally, you can add your Intelligence modifier to any Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) check made to lie to another creature.

entries.name: Weapon Integration
entries: This augmentation replaces a forearm.

You can integrate a single weapon that weighs no more than 8 lb. into your forearm. While integrated, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to hide or reveal the weapon, which can only be used while revealed. While hidden, the weapon has the hidden property. While revealed, the weapon has the fixed property.
You can choose this modification multiple times.

entries.name: Withercasting Inhibitor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} While using your body as a tech focus, you gain a +1 bonus to the tech save DC of powers you cast that requires a Wisdom or Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. This bonus increases to +2 at 9th level and +3 at 13th level.

subclassFeature.name: Bloodstorm Approach
entries: The Bloodstorm Approach is said to have originated from the ancient wookiee Hroufrasnooohn clan (which loosely translates to Bloodstorm in {@language Galactic Basic|sw5e-phb}), whose warriors performed gravity-defying feats with their flying vibroaxes through a combination of unorthodox techniques and a mystical belief in their own abilities. A berserker who follows this approach can hurl their devastating weapons at enemies with such power and skill that it completely blurs the line between melee and ranged combat.

subclassFeature.name: Furious Throw
entries: Your throwing techniques have become a perfect extension of your melee prowess. When you throw a weapon with which you are proficient, you can benefit from your class features that only apply to melee weapon attacks, such as Rage or Reckless Attack.

subclassFeature.name: Returning Attacks
entries: Any weapon you throw can ricochet back to you at your command. When you make a thrown {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you may have the weapon fly back to your hand immediately after the attack.

subclassFeature.name: Throw Anything
entries: Your strength and mastery of throwing techniques has allowed you to throw vibroaxes as easily as others hurl {@item Vibrodagger|sw5e-phb|vibrodaggers}. When you are wielding a light- or vibro-weapon with which you are proficient, it gains the thrown property (range 20/60).

subclassFeature.name: Fling People
entries: You learn to throw creatures as easily as you throw your weapons. When you successfully grapple a creature, you may immediately throw the creature.

entries.name: Throw Friend
entries: If the creature is a willing ally and volunteers to be {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled}, you throw the target into any unoccupied space within 60 feet. That creature may immediately use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, adding your Strength modifier to the attack's damage roll.

entries.name: Throw Foe
entries: If the creature is an opponent, you throw the target into any unoccupied space within 30 feet, where it takes damage equal to your Strength modifier and falls {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.

subclassFeature.name: Raging Whirlwind
entries: You can send your weapon spinning into a gravity-defying {@spell Whirlwind|sw5e-phb|whirlwind} of pain. Once per rage as an action, you may throw a weapon with the thrown property to a point you choose within 60 feet. The weapon fills the air as a cyclone in a 10 foot radius sphere centered on that point. A creature takes damage equal to the thrown weapon's damage + your Strength modifier + your Rage Damage when it enter's the {@spell Whirlwind|sw5e-phb|whirlwind}'s area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there. This effect ends when you command the weapon to return to you (no action required) or your rage ends.

subclassFeature.name: Bolstering Practice
entries: Those operatives who choose the Bolstering Practice use precise strikes and brilliant use of small unit tactics to overwhelm enemies through superior teamwork.

subclassFeature.name: Articulate Authority
entries: When you use your Cunning Action feature to take the {@action Dash|sw5e-phb}, {@action Disengage|sw5e-phb}, or {@action Hide|sw5e-phb} actions, a number of friendly creatures up to your Charisma modifier within 30 feet of you who can hear you and who can understand you can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to gain an effect, determined by the action you took:

items: {@b Dash:} The creature can move up to half their {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. They must end this movement within 30 feet of you.

{@b Disengage:} The creature can move up to 5 feet. If this movement would provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack}, the {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} is made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

{@b Hide:} The creature has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} they make before the end of their next turn against a creature you successfully hide from.

entries: You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries: When you use your Cunning Action feature to take the {@action Dash|sw5e-phb}, {@action Disengage|sw5e-phb}, or {@action Hide|sw5e-phb} actions, a number of friendly creatures up to your Charisma modifier within 30 feet of you who can hear you and who can understand you can use their {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to gain an effect, determined by the action you took:

items: {@b Dash:} The creature can move up to half their {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. They must end this movement within 30 feet of you.

{@b Disengage:} The creature can move up to 5 feet. If this movement would provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack}, the {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} is made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

{@b Hide:} The creature has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} they make before the end of their next turn against a creature you successfully hide from.

entries: You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries: You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Fireteam Commander
entries: You learn a number of squad {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} you can use to {@optfeature Assist|sw5e-phb|assist} allies or exploit enemies. When you deal Sneak Attack damage to a creature, you may choose to forgo two of your Sneak Attack dice to make the attack a squad {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}.

entries.name: Fortifying Strike
entries: You inspire a friendly creature within 60 feet of you who can see or hear you and roll two Sneak Attack dice. That ally immediately gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount of rolled.

entries.name: Reaffirming Strike
entries: You use the authority your attacks carry to help your ally focus on the task at hand. Choose a creature within 60 feet of you who can see or hear you and that is currently {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} or {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} by the creature you would deal Sneak Attack damage to. The condition immediately ends on that creature.

entries.name: Bolstering Strike
entries: You choose a friendly creature within 60 feet of you who can see or hear you. Once before the start of your next turn, if that creature hits the creature against which you forwent two Sneak Attack damage dice, they deal additional damage to the target equal to the maximum of the two Sneak Attack dice.

subclassFeature.name: Open Opportunity
entries: Once per turn, when you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action and hit a creature without applying your Sneak Attack damage to it, you can forgo your Sneak Attack damage for the turn and use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to throw the creature off balance. The next ally to hit that creature before the start of your next turn may add your Sneak Attack dice to the damage of their attack.

subclassFeature.name: Ambush Tactics
entries: When attempting to move stealthily as a group, you may choose a number of creatures equal to your Charisma modifier. Those creatures may add their proficiency to any Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) checks they make as long as they remain within 60 feet of you and they do not already add their {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

Additionally, each ally other than you that surprises a creature and hits it with an attack on their first turn in combat rolls two dice equal to the size of your Sneak Attack dice, dealing additional damage of the same type to the creature.

subclassFeature.name: Squad Goals
entries: You have such skill at maintaining the faith of your allies that the very sight of you in danger can spur them into action. When you are hit by an attack, up to six allies within 60 feet of you that can see or hear you and see the creature that hit you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against that creature (no action required).
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Brawling Approach
entries: Most berserkers require weapons. For berserkers of the Brawling Approach, however, everything is their weapon.

subclassFeature.name: Fists of Fury
entries: You've learned to hone your rage through your fists. Your unarmed strike damage increases by one step (from 1 to {@dice d4}, {@dice d4} to {@dice d6}, or {@dice d6} to {@dice d8}).

subclassFeature.name: Reckless Strikes
entries: While you are raging, not wearing {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}, and not wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}, when you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or improvised weapon, you can choose to forgo your rage damage to make the attack a reckless strike.

Some of your reckless strikes require your target to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist the reckless strike's effects. The {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC is calculated as follows:
{@b Reckless Strike save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Strength modifier

You can use these features a combined number of times equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, as shown in the berserker table. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Bracing Strike
entries: You gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your rage damage bonus. If the target is {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} by you, you instead gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to twice your rage damage bonus.

entries.name: Punishing Strike
entries: Your target must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the creature is {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened} until the start of its next turn. If the target is {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} by you, it is instead {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} until the start of its next turn.

entries.name: Staggering Strike
entries: Your target must make a Strength or Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (the target chooses the ability score to use). On a failed save, your target is pushed back 5 feet. If the target is {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} by you, it is instead knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.

subclassFeature.name: Shattering Strikes
entries: Your rage causes your strikes to overcome the hardest of materials. While raging, you gain the following benefits:

items: Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} and improved weapons count as enhanced for the purpose of overcoming {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} and immunity to unenhanced attacks and damage.
Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal double damage against structures.

subclassFeature.name: Stop Hitting Each Other
entries: You can grapple creatures two sizes larger than you, instead of one.

Additionally, you can use creatures you have {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} that are at least one size smaller than you as improvised weapons. When you do so, when you hit with an attack using a creature as a weapon, it takes damage equal to your Strength modifier. While raging, you can instead use creatures your size or smaller as improvised weapons.

subclassFeature.name: Enforcer
entries: When you would make an unarmed strike or attack with an improvised weapon with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}, you can choose to forgo the {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. If you do so, your {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} range increases by 1 for that attack, and on a hit, you deal maximum damage instead of rolling.

subclassFeature.name: Champion Approach
entries: Some berserkers revel in battle for battle's sake. For berserkers of the Champion Approach, this revelry is the goal to which they constantly strive.

subclassFeature.name: Champion Superiority
entries: You learn {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} that are fueled by special dice called {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers}. See {@book chapter 13|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} for the {@book maneuvers list|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}.

entries.name: Maneuvers Known
entries: You learn two {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} of your choice, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the Maneuvers Known column of the Champion Superiority table. Many {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} enhance an attack in some way. You can use only one {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} per attack, and you may only use each {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} once per turn.
Each time you learn new {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}, you can also replace one {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} you know with a different one.

entries.name: Superiority Dice
entries: You have two {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers}, which are d4s, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Superiority Dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} Quantity column of the Champion Superiority table. This die changes as you gain berserker levels, as shown in the {@book Superiority Dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} Size column of the Champion Superiority table. A superiority die is expended when you use it.
You regain all of your expended {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Maneuver Ability
entries: Your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} varies based on the type of the {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} you use. You use Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution for {@book physical maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Physical} (your choice), Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for {@book mental maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Mental} (your choice), and an ability of your choice for {@book general maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|General}. You use this ability whenever a {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} refers to your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers}. Additionally, you use this ability modifier when setting the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC for a {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} you use.
{@b Maneuver save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier

subclassFeature.name: Reckless Maneuvers
entries: When you use your Reckless Attack feature, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on superiority die rolls that would be added to the attack or damage rolls of your affected attacks.

subclassFeature.name: The Thrill
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid being {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} or {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened}, and creatures can't have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid being {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} or {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} by effects that you control.

subclassFeature.name: Battlefield Euphoria
entries: While raging, when you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, and when you reduce a hostile creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you recover an expended superiority die.

subclassFeature.name: Furious Influence
entries: While raging, you gain the following benefits:

items: You are resistant to psychic damage.
When you affect an ally with a {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}, they gain the benefit of one of your damage resistances until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Chef Pursuit
entries: Without it empires fall, armies dissolve into nothingness, and species are forgotten with the passage of time. A favored tool of assassins, crime lords, and moguls: food. Those scholars who choose the Chef Pursuit know the importance and power that food carries.

subclassFeature.name: Culinary Knowledge
entries: You gain proficiency with chef's kits and your choice of the {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skills. Additionally, you can't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on checks you make with them.

subclassFeature.name: Emergency Supplements
entries: You are prepared to {@optfeature Assist|sw5e-phb|assist} allies with specially prepared, instantly effective supplements. When an ally is the target of your Critical Analysis feature and within 5 feet of you, you may expend a superiority die and give that ally the benefits of any discovery that utilizes a superiority die and is exclusive to the Chef Pursuit, regardless of whether or not you've chosen it.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Balanced Diet
entries: Your cooking is so nutritionally balanced that it allows allies to stave off the effects of continued rigorous activity. Creatures of your choice who eat food prepared by you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion}, as described in chapter 8, until the end of their next {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Comfort Food
entries: If you or any friendly creatures who have consumed food you prepared during a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest} regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} by spending hit dice at the end of the {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, each of those creatures regains an extra 1d8 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.
The extra {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} increase when you reach certain levels in this class: to 1d10 at 11th level, and to 1d12 at 15th level.

subclassFeature.name: Heroes' Feast
entries: You have developed a signature feast that is the purest distillation of your knowledge and talent as a chef.

Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can expend rare culinary supplies worth 1,000 cr to create your feast, which can feed a number of creatures equal to twice your Critical Analysis ability modifer. Any creature partaking in the feast gains the following benefits:

items: It is cured of all poisons and disease, and becomes immune to {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} and disease.
It makes Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid being {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.
Its hit point maximum and current {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} increase by 2d10.

entries: These benefits last until the end of the creature's next {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} or 24 hours have passed. This feature has no effect on droids or constructs.

subclassFeature.name: Chef Discoveries
entries: When you select this pursuit, you gain access to new discoveries which reflect the progress of your studies into the culinary arts. Whenever you learn a new discovery, you can choose from any of the following as well. The discoveries are listed in alphabetical order.

entries.name: Allergens
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} while preparing or touching food, you may expend a superiority die and add to it an irritating allergen. At the start of each of its turns, a creature that consumes this food must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it subtracts half the result of your superiority die (minimum of one) from the first {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} it makes before the start of its next turn. The effect of this {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} ends when the creature completes its next {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} or 24 hours have passed. This {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} has no effect on droids or constructs.

entries.name: Alternative Fuel
entries: Any of your chef features, {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}, or discoveries can now affect droids and constructs.

entries.name: Banquet
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 17th level, Full Course} Over the course of a long or {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, you may utilize an additional {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} from this archetype (total of four).

entries.name: Brain Food
entries: At the end of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} you may expend a superiority die and choose a number of friendly creatures up to your {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} modifier (minimum of one), if they ate food you prepared. Each creature gains a number of temporary force or tech points (their choice) equal to the number you roll on the superiority die. When an affected creature casts a force or {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, the temporary force or tech points are spent first. An affected target can only benefit from one source of temporary force or tech points at a time, and they last until they're depleted or until the affected target completes their next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. This {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} has no effect on droids or constructs.

entries.name: Debilitants
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} when preparing or touching food, you may expend a superiority die and add to it a subtle {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}. Any creature that consumes this food must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, their hit point maximum is reduced by an amount equal to twice the number rolled on your superiority die + your {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} modifier. The effect of this {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} ends when the creature completes its next {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} or 24 hours have passed. This {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} has no effect on droids or constructs.

entries.name: Energizers
entries: At the end of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} you may expend a superiority die and choose a number of friendly creatures up to your {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} modifier (minimum of one), if they ate food you prepared. Each creature has their walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increased by 10 until the end of their next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. This {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} has no effect on droids or constructs.

entries.name: Enhancers
entries: At the end of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} you may expend a superiority die and choose a number of friendly creatures up to your {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} modifier (minimum of one), if they ate food you prepared. Once before the end of their next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, affected targets may add the result of the superiority die to a damage roll that would affect only one target. This {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} has no effect on droids or constructs.

entries.name: Filling Meal
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level} Over the course of a long or {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, you may utilize up to two different {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} from this archetype, rather than one.

entries.name: Full Course
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 12th level, Filling Meal} Over the course of a long or {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, you may utilize an additional {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} from this archetype (total of three).

entries.name: Health Food
entries: At the end of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} you may expend a superiority die and choose a number of friendly creatures up to your {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} modifier (minimum of one), if they ate food you prepared. Each creature gains a number of temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to twice the number you roll on the superiority die. This {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} has no effect on droids or constructs.

entries.name: Muscle Relaxants
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} while preparing or touching food, you may expend a superiority die and add to it a fast acting muscle relaxant. At the start of each of its turns, a creature that consumes this food must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it subtracts the result of your superiority die from the first damage roll it makes before the start of its next turn. The effect of this {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} ends when the creature completes its next {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} or 24 hours have passed. This {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} has no effect on droids or constructs.

entries.name: On the Rocks
entries: Any food you prepare over a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} carries with it an additional cooling effect. Creatures that consume it are considered adapted to hot climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide, until the end of the creature's next {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} or 24 hours have passed. Additionally, the first time a creature who eats your food takes fire damage before the end of their next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, they are considered resistant to the damage.

entries.name: Secret Ingredient
entries: If you or any friendly creature that has consumed food made by you during their last short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, the number of temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} they gain increases by an amount equal to your Critical Analysis ability modifer.

entries.name: Spice of Life
entries: Any food you prepare over a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} carries with it an additional warming effect. Creatures that consume it are considered adapted to cold climates, as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide, until the end of the creature's next {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} or 24 hours have passed. Additionally, the first time a creature who eats your food takes cold damage before the end of their next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, they are considered resistant to the damage.

entries.name: Supplements
entries: At the end of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} you may expend a superiority die and choose a number of friendly creatures up to your {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} modifier (minimum of one), if they ate food you prepared. Once before the end of their next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, affected targets may add the result of the superiority die to one {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. The creature can wait until after it rolls the {@dice d20} before deciding to use this feature, but must decide before the DM says whether the roll succeeds or fails. This {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} has no effect on droids or constructs.

entries.name: Vitamins
entries: At the end of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} you may expend a superiority die and choose a number of friendly creatures up to your {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} modifier (minimum of one), if they ate food you prepared. Each creature gains proficiency in Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} until the end of their next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. If a creature was already proficient in Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}, they instead become proficient in a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} of your choice. This {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} has no effect on droids or constructs.

subclassFeature.name: Construction Engineering
entries: Those engineers who choose the Construction Engineering discipline create portable, pre-built battlements that allow them to command the battlefield.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in constructor's implements. Additionally, when you engage in crafting with constructor's implements, the rate at which you craft doubles.

subclassFeature.name: Portable Structure
entries: You have constructed a set of malleable, portable fortifications that can elevate you and your allies. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you create a portable structure that travels with you.

Your portable structure can only be directed by you, and you must have a tech focus in order to direct it remotely. If you lack a tech focus, you can instead direct it while it is within 5 feet of you. Your portable structure has the following features:

items: Its AC equals your tech save DC.

It has a number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to 5 x your engineer level. If your structure is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, it collapses and can't be used again until you spend 1 hour repairing it, which can be done during a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

You can restore missing {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to your structure by casting the {@i mending} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} on it, or by completing a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Casting the {@i mending} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} restores a number of missing {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one), but it can't be repaired to more than half its hit point maximum in this way. Completing a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest} restores your structure to half its hit point maximum, and completing a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} restores it to its hit point maximum.

Your structure has two modes: dismantled and deployed. While dismantled, your structure's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equals your own, it hovers 5 feet off the ground, takes up the space of a 5-foot cube, and weighs 500 lbs. This increases to a 10-foot cube and 1,000 lbs. at 11th level, and a 15-foot cube and 2,000 lbs. at 17th level as you upgrade it. While deployed, your structure's {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is 0 and it takes up space dictated by how its deployed.

entries: As an action, you can remotely deploy your structure at a space you can see on the ground within 30 feet of you, provided there is sufficient space to support it. This range increases to 60 feet at 11th level and 120 feet at 17th level. Automatic dismantling of your structure takes 1 minute, and can be initiated on your turn (no action required).

You can deploy your choice from these structures a combined total of four times, and you gain more uses at higher levels, as shown in the Modification Slots column of the engineer table. Each time you use this feature in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1 until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Bridge
entries: You deploy a bridge up to 30 feet long, 10 feet wide, and 3 feet thick. The bridge starts from the point at which you deploy it, and extends in a direction of your choice. When you dismantle your bridge, it retracts to the point at which you initially deployed it. Both ends of the bridge must be supported in some fashion; one end cannot be suspended in the air or on unstable terrain. The bridge can hold up to 1,000 lbs., any weight above which causes the bridge to instantly drop to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, destroying it. If a creature is on the bridge when it is destroyed or dismantled, it must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC. On a successful {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, it reaches the closest part of the bridge that has stable support, or it maintains a grip on your bridge as it retracts, as appropriate. On a failed save, it falls.

When you reach 11th level, the bridge can now extend up to 45 feet long, 15 feet wide, and it can support up to 2,000 lbs. When you reach 17th level, the bridge can now extend up to 60 feet long, 20 feet wide, and it can support up to 4,000 lbs.

entries.name: Cage
entries: You create a cage that surrounds a cube up to 10 feet on each side centered on the target location. The cube is surrounded on all sides except the ground by 2-foot-thick walls. The walls and roof are completely opaque, and you choose whether the structure has a light source when you deploy it that provides bright light within the cube. Otherwise, the space within the cube is in complete {@spell Darkness|sw5e-phb|darkness}. The cage is permeable, allowing air, water, and sound to pass through it. You can attempt to trap unwilling Medium or smaller creatures inside the cage. When you deploy this structure in an unwilling creature's space, it must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC. On a successful save, it can immediately move to nearest unoccupied space outside of the cage. Otherwise, it is trapped within the structure when it is deployed.

When you reach 11th level, the cage can extend up to 15 feet on each side, and it can trap creatures of Large size or smaller. When you reach 17th level, the cage can extend up to 20 feet on each side, and it can trap creatures of Huge size or smaller.

entries.name: Shelter
entries: You erect a shelter up to 15 feet long, 10 feet wide, and 10 feet tall, with one-foot-thick walls, a roof, and a floor. It has a single door along its walls in a location of your choice. The building has temperature control and lighting systems, and can withstand harsh winds, heavy rain and snow. Any creature inside the shelter is protected from hazardous environmental effects outside the shelter such as extreme heat or cold. The structure does not provide additional breathing air for anyone inside if the environment it is placed in is not breathable. The shelter can comfortably support up to 5 Medium creatures. For each Medium creature, it can instead support 2 Small creatures. For each Small creature, it can instead support 2 Tiny creatures.

When you reach 11th level, the shelter can extend up to 30 feet long, 15 feet wide, 15 feet tall, and it can now comfortably support up to 10 Medium creatures. For each Medium creature, it can instead support 2 Small creatures. For each Small creature, it can instead support 2 Tiny creatures. Additionally, when a creature completes a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} while within your shelter, they regain all spent Hit Dice, instead of only half. When you reach 17th level, the shelter can extend up to 45 feet long, 20 feet wide, 20 feet tall, and it can now comfortably support up to 10 Large creatures. For each Large creature, it can instead support 2 Medium creatures. For each Medium creature, it can instead support 2 Small creatures. For each Small creature, it can instead support 2 Tiny creatures. Additionally, when a creature completes a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} while within your shelter, their {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} level is reduced by 2, instead of only 1.

entries.name: Tower
entries: You erect a tower from a 5-foot square platform centered on the target location that rises up to 30 feet. If the tower is created under a creature, that creature must succeed on a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be lifted by the tower. A creature can choose to fail the save. The tower comes equipped with a ladder that reaches from the ground to the platform.

When you reach 11th level, the tower's platform can extend 5 feet by 10 feet and rise up to 40 feet. When you reach 17th level, the tower's platform can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a 10-foot square, and rise up to 50 feet. Additionally, any creature on the tower's platform has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on sight.

entries.name: Wall
entries: You deploy a wall up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 3 feet thick, or a ringed wall up to 10 feet in diameter, 10 feet high, and 3 feet thick. The wall features ramparts deep enough to support creatures of Medium size or smaller, and provides one-quarter {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} to any creature on its ramparts. The wall includes a ladder on the side of your choice. You choose whether the wall contains any openings otherwise. Any openings chosen in this way can be seen through on both sides. The wall can be climbed, but requires a Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check against your tech save DC for any creature without a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. A creature can only make this check once per turn.

When you reach 11th level, the wall can deploy up to 45 feet long and 15 feet high, or a ringed wall up to 15 feet in diameter and 15 feet high. Additionally, the wall now provides {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|half cover} to any creature on its ramparts. When you reach 17th level, the wall can deploy up to 60 feet long and 20 feet high, or a ringed wall up to 20 feet in diameter and 20 feet high. Additionally, the wall now provides three-quarters {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} to any creature on its ramparts.
