entries: You craft a set of gloves with a powerful assisted grip. While wearing these gloves, you have a climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 20 feet, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} and Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) checks that involve climbing.

entries.name: Corrosive Amplifier
entries: You integrate a booster in your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} that enhances your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that deal acid damage. While wielding this amplifier, when a creature takes acid damage from a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast, you can choose to deal additional acid damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

You can use this amplifier a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Cryo Amplifier
entries: You integrate a booster in your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} that enhances your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that deal cold damage. While wielding this amplifier, when a creature takes cold damage from a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast, you can choose to deal additional cold damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

You can use this amplifier a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Darkvision Goggles
entries: You craft a pair of sight-enhancing goggles. While wearing these goggles, you have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} to a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision}, this modification increases its range by 30 feet.

entries.name: Explosive Amplifier
entries: You integrate a booster in your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} that enhances your {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that deal fire damage. While wielding this amplifier, when a creature takes fire damage from a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast, you can choose to deal additional fire damage equal to your Intelligence modifier.

You can use this amplifier a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Imaging Amplifier
entries: You integrate a booster in your {@item Wristpad|sw5e-phb|wristpad} that enhances your illusionary {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. While wielding this amplifier, when a creature attempts an Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) check against a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you cast to discern the illusion for what it is, you can force the creature to have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the roll (no action required). Alternatively, when you cast the {@i mirror image} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you create a fourth duplicate. While you have four duplicates, you must roll a 5 or higher on the {@dice d20} roll to change an attack's target to a duplicate.

You can use this amplifier a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier (a minimum of once). You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Jet Boots
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level} You find tune your augmented boots to give you temporary, limited flight. Activating or deactivating the boots requires a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and, while active, you have a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 30 feet.

The {@item Rocket boots|sw5e-phb|rocket boots} last for 1 minute before deactivating. Once the boots have been activated, they can't be activated again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Mechanical Arm
entries: You create a mechanical arm which mounts to your shoulder, which you can use independently. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time.
You can choose this modification twice.

entries.name: Prototype Biotic Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Biotic Amplifier} You fine tune your biotic amplifier. While wielding this amplifier, when a creature gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} from your biotic amplifier, it instead gains twice as many. This amount can't exceed the number of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} regained.

entries.name: Prototype Corrosive Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Corrosive Amplifier} You fine tune your Corrosive Amplifier. When you activate this amplifier, the next {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} made against that creature before the end of its next turn has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

entries.name: Prototype Cryo Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Cryo Amplifier} You fine tune your Cryo Amplifier. When you activate this amplifier, the creature gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level until the end of your next turn.

entries.name: Prototype Explosive Amplifier
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 7th level, Explosive Amplifier} You fine tune your Explosive Amplifier. When you activate this amplifier, the creature is also {@condition Ignited|sw5e-phb|ignited} for 1 minute. At the start of each of its turns, the creature takes additional fire damage equal to your Intelligence modifier and then makes a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC, ending this effect on a success. If the target or a creature within 5 feet of it uses an action to put out the flames, or if some other effect douses the flames, the effect ends.

entries.name: Powered Grappling Hook
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level, Wrist-Mounted {@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb|Grappling Hook}} While your wrist-mounted {@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb|grappling hook} is deployed, when you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} with a range of touch, your hook can deliver the power as if it had cast it.

entries.name: Sentry Turret
entries: You learn how to craft small sentry turrets shaped like globes that can adhere to any surface. As an action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} (your choice), you can throw a sentry to a point you can see within range (30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5). At the end of each of your turns, a deployed sentry automatically targets a hostile creature within 10 feet of it. If multiple targets are available, one is chosen at random. The target must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it takes 1d4 energy damage and gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level until the end of your next turn.

The sentries have 1 hit point, an {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class} of 10, and can be repaired over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. Each sentry lasts for 1 minute before deactivating. You can maintain a number of sentries equal to your Intelligence modifier. Once a sentry has been activated, it can't be activated again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Truesight Goggles
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 11th level, {@spell Darkvision|sw5e-phb} Goggles} You modify your goggles with a toggle allowing you to briefly gain enhanced sight. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can activate the {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight} feature of your goggles. When toggled on, for the next minute your goggles now automatically dispel illusions and can {@spell Detect Invisibility|sw5e-phb|detect invisibility}, as with {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight}.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

entries.name: Wrist-Mounted Grappling Hook
entries: You craft a wrist-mounted {@item Grappling hook|sw5e-phb|grappling hook} weapon attached to a tightly coiled cord. With this contraption, you can make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} with a range of 30/60. On a hit, it deals 1d4 kinetic damage. This attack can target a surface, object, or creature.

A creature struck by this attack is impaled by the hook. As an action, a creature can attempt to remove the hook. Removing the hook requires a Strength check. While the hook is stuck in the target, you are connected to the target by a 60 foot cable.

While the hook is deployed, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to activate the reel, pulling yourself to the location if the target is your size or larger. A creature or object smaller than you is pulled to you. Alternatively, you can opt to {@spell Release|sw5e-phb|release} the cable (no action required).
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you recover and reinsert the hook as an action.

subclassFeature.name: Deadeye Technique
entries: Some scouts become legends written in {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} burns. Followers of the Deadeye Technique perfect the art of the {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} shot and utilize their incredible focus to make shots that most would deem impossible. When everything depends on one shot, you want a Deadeye pulling the trigger.

Due to their uncanny focus, Deadeyes can make shots that other marksmen would never dare to attempt. Deadeyes know how to make the most of ranged weapons and can use them to greater effect than other Scouts.

subclassFeature.name: Deadeye Superiority
entries: You learn {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} that are fueled by special dice called {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers}. See {@book chapter 13|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} for the {@book maneuvers list|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}.

entries.name: Maneuvers Known
entries: You learn two {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} of your choice, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the Maneuvers Known column of the Deadeye Superiority table. Many {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} enhance an attack in some way. You can use only one {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} per attack, and you may only use each {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} once per turn.
Each time you learn new {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}, you can also replace one {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} you know with a different one.

entries.name: Superiority Dice
entries: You have two {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers}, which are d4s, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Superiority Dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} Quantity column of the Deadeye Superiority table. This die changes as you gain scout levels, as shown in the {@book Superiority Dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} Size column of the Deadeye Superiority table. A superiority die is expended when you use it.
You regain all of your expended {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Maneuver Ability
entries: Your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} varies based on the type of the {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} you use. You use Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution for {@book physical maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Physical} (your choice), Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for {@book mental maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Mental} (your choice), and an ability of your choice for {@book general maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|General}. You use this ability whenever a {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} refers to your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers}. Additionally, you use this ability modifier when setting the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC for a {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} you use.
{@b Maneuver save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your {@book maneuver ability|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} modifier

subclassFeature.name: Mark of the Deadeye
entries: The range of your Ranger's Quarry feature doubles. Additionally, when making ranged weapon attacks against the target of your Ranger's Quarry, the normal and long range of your {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} weapons double.

subclassFeature.name: Cover to Cover
entries: Attack rolls made against you on your turn are made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

subclassFeature.name: Shoot First
entries: You have learned that the person who shoots first is often the one who walks out alive. When you make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against a creature that has not yet acted during your first turn in combat and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll, you can reroll one of the dice once. Additionally, on a hit, you deal an extra 1d8 damage of the same type as the weapon. This damage increases to 1d10 at 13th level and 1d12 at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Shoot First
entries: You have learned that the person who shoots first is often the one who walks out alive. When you make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against a creature that has not yet acted during your first turn in combat and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll, you can reroll one of the dice once. Additionally, on a hit, you deal an extra 1d8 damage of the same type as the weapon. This damage increases to 1d10 at 13th level and 1d12 at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Shoot First
entries: You have learned that the person who shoots first is often the one who walks out alive. When you make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against a creature that has not yet acted during your first turn in combat and you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll, you can reroll one of the dice once. Additionally, on a hit, you deal an extra 1d8 damage of the same type as the weapon. This damage increases to 1d10 at 13th level and 1d12 at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Overwatch
entries: You have become a master at protecting your allies from afar. When a creature attempts to make an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} against an allied creature, or forces your ally to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against the enemy creature.

If your attack hits, either impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the enemy creature's {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} roll or grant {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} to any allies making the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

subclassFeature.name: Demolitions Specialist
entries: Those fighters who choose to become Demolitions Specialists are experts in using explosives in combat. They have an explosive for every situation, whether it be breaching a fortified bunker, taking down a walker, or simply demonstrating that in combat, standing too close to your squadmates can be fatal.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in {@item Demolitions kit|sw5e-phb|demolitions kit}. Additionally, when you would install a breaching {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge}, you can do so in half the time.

subclassFeature.name: Explosive Charge
entries: You learn to create a number of small explosives known as charges. Over the course of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can create a number of charges equal to your Intelligence modifier. You must have a {@item Demolitions kit|sw5e-phb|demolitions kit} in order to create these charges. Your charges can only be used by you, and they lose their potency at the end of your next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

Once per turn, when you would make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can instead throw one of your charges. Your charges have a range equal to 30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5. You can throw a {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} at a point you can see within range. Each creature within 5 feet must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Intelligence modifier). A creature takes 2d4 + your Intelligence modifier kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
The damage of your charges increases to 3d4 at 7th level and 4d4 at 15th level.

subclassFeature.name: Explosive Charge
entries: You learn to create a number of small explosives known as charges. Over the course of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can create a number of charges equal to your Intelligence modifier. You must have a {@item Demolitions kit|sw5e-phb|demolitions kit} in order to create these charges. Your charges can only be used by you, and they lose their potency at the end of your next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

Once per turn, when you would make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can instead throw one of your charges. Your charges have a range equal to 30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5. You can throw a {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} at a point you can see within range. Each creature within 5 feet must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Intelligence modifier). A creature takes 2d4 + your Intelligence modifier kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
The damage of your charges increases to 3d4 at 7th level and 4d4 at 15th level.

subclassFeature.name: Explosive Charge
entries: You learn to create a number of small explosives known as charges. Over the course of a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can create a number of charges equal to your Intelligence modifier. You must have a {@item Demolitions kit|sw5e-phb|demolitions kit} in order to create these charges. Your charges can only be used by you, and they lose their potency at the end of your next short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

Once per turn, when you would make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can instead throw one of your charges. Your charges have a range equal to 30 feet + your Strength modifier x 5. You can throw a {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} at a point you can see within range. Each creature within 5 feet must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Intelligence modifier). A creature takes 2d4 + your Intelligence modifier kinetic damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
The damage of your charges increases to 3d4 at 7th level and 4d4 at 15th level.

subclassFeature.name: Cause and Effect
entries: You learn to throw grenades as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. Additionally, when a creature fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} or grenade, you can expend a superiority die to apply one of your {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}. You can only use this feature once per grenade.

subclassFeature.name: Volatile Reflexes
entries: When a creature within 5 feet of you makes a melee attack against you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and throw a {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} behind the target. If the target fails its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against the {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge}, you impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} made against you.

subclassFeature.name: Backup Plans
entries: When you roll {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} and have no charges remaining, you can create 2 charges. Additionally, whenever you create a {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge}, you can change the damage type to acid, energy, fire, ion, lightning, or sonic.

subclassFeature.name: Bombard
entries: When a creature fails its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} or grenade thrown by you, it has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the next Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} it makes before the end of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Detective Pursuit
entries: Some individuals learn to hone their instincts to {@optfeature Investigate|sw5e-phb|investigate} and discover that which others can't see. Those scholars who choose the Detective Pursuit train themselves to see the things that others miss, gaining a unique—and powerful—perspective.

subclassFeature.name: Martial Training
entries: You gain proficiency in martial {@filter vibroweapons|items|type=martial weapon} and the {@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb} skill. Additionally, you can't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on checks you make with it.

subclassFeature.name: Intelligent Applications
entries: When you {@spell Analyze|sw5e-phb|analyze} a hostile creature with your Critical Analysis, you can use your Critical Analysis ability modifer with any weapon, as long as it does not have the heavy or special properties.

subclassFeature.name: Extra Attack
entries: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action on your turn.

subclassFeature.name: Sharp Instincts
entries: Once on each of your turns, when you hit the target of your Critical Analysis with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) check. If you win the contest, you deal an additional 1d8 damage to the target, which is the same type as the weapon's damage This die increases to {@dice d10} at 13th level and {@dice d12} at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Discombobulate
entries: When you use a scholar {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} on a hostile creature, you can force that target to make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} save DC. On a failed save, the target is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} for 1 minute. The target can repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Once you use this feature, you can't do so again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Detective Discoveries
entries: When you select this pursuit, you gain access to new discoveries which reflect your investigative prowess. Whenever you learn a new discovery, you can choose from any of the following as well. The discoveries are listed in alphabetical order.

entries.name: Athletic
entries: You gain your choice of a climbing, crawling, or swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.

entries.name: Brawler Adept
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} Your unarmed strike damage increases by one step (from 1 to {@dice d4}, {@dice d4} to {@dice d6}, or {@dice d6} to {@dice d8}). Additionally, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} and count as enhanced for the purpose of overcoming {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} and immunity to unenhanced attacks and damage.

entries.name: Eye for Attire
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} As an action, you can touch a suit of armor that isn't being worn or carried by a hostile creature and instantly don it, provided you aren't wearing armor already.

entries.name: Eye for Detail
entries: You take the {@action Search|sw5e-phb} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

entries.name: Ear for Deceit
entries: Whenever you make a Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check to determine whether a creature is lying, treat a roll of 7 or lower on the {@dice d20} as an 8.

entries.name: Fighting Style
entries: You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty. Choose one of the {@book fighting style options, detailed in chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6|Fighting Styles} of the Player's Handbook.

entries.name: Scrapper's Armor
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You gain proficiency in {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}. If you are already proficient in {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}, you instead gain proficiency in {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}.

entries.name: Steady Eye
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} On your turn, you can reduce your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} by half to gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) or Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) checks until the end of the turn. You can not use this feature if you have moved more than half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} this turn.

entries.name: Thirst for Justice
entries: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, but don't kill it outright, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your scholar level, which last for 1 minute.

entries.name: Unerring Eye
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 15th level} You can see the true form of any shapechanger or creature concealed by illusion while the creature is within 30 feet of you and within line of sight.

subclassFeature.name: Disabling Practice
entries: Those operatives who choose the Disabling Practice utilize a variety of pushes, pulls, weight shifts, and joint locks to immobilize their opponent. They use these techniques to manipulate their opponent, moving them across the battlefield before incapacitating them.

subclassFeature.name: Clinch Strike
entries: You learn how to discourage, debilitate, and harm your enemies. You gain the following benefits while you aren't wearing {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor} or wielding a medium or heavy {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}:

items: Your damage die for your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} and natural weapons increases by one step (from 1 to {@dice d4}, {@dice d4} to {@dice d6}, or {@dice d6} to {@dice d8}), and you can apply your Sneak Attack damage when you hit with an unarmed strike even if it doesn't have {@itemProperty SWF|sw5e-phb|the finesse property}.

You don't need {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on your {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} to use your Sneak Attack if the target of your Sneak Attack is a creature {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} by you. All the other rules for the Sneak Attack class feature still apply to you.
You can use the {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} granted by your Cunning Action to make an unarmed strike against a creature you are grappling.

subclassFeature.name: Skilled Grappler
entries: You learn a number of grappling techniques to subdue your opponents. When you hit a creature {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} by you with an unarmed strike and deal Sneak Attack damage, you may choose to forgo two of your Sneak Attack dice to make the attack a grappling technique.

Some of your grappling techniques require your target to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist the grappling technique's effects. The {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC is calculated as follows:
{@b Grapple Technique save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Strength modifier

entries.name: Constrict
entries: You attempt to choke the target into unconsciousness. The target must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained} until the end of your following turn.

If you maintain this technique for 1 minute, the target falls {@condition Unconscious|sw5e-phb|unconscious} for 1 hour. Droids and constructs can not be knocked {@condition Unconscious|sw5e-phb|unconscious} in this way.

entries.name: Disarm
entries: You attempt to disarm a weapon or other object the target is holding. The target must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it releases the object. If you have a free hand, you can catch the object. Otherwise, it lands at your feet.

entries.name: Hip Toss
entries: You attempt to throw your target to the ground. The target must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the target is pushed back 5 feet, knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}, and {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the start of your next turn. This ends the grapple.

subclassFeature.name: Human Shield
entries: You learn to manipulate the body of a {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} target to make attacks against you more difficult to land. Moving a {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} creature the same size as you or smaller no longer halves your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, and when a creature {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} by you would grant you {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|half cover}, you instead have three-quarters {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}. Additionally, when you are hit by an attack while grappling a creature, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to force that attack to instead hit the {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} creature.

subclassFeature.name: Kiss the Wall
entries: You can use your surroundings to further punish the target of your grapple. When you roll a 1 or 2 on a Sneak Attack damage die for an unarmed strike you make against a creature {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} by you, you can treat the result of the die as a 3.

subclassFeature.name: Neck Snap
entries: You learn how to immediately remove your {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} opponent from the fight. As an action, you can force a creature {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} by you to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, if the creature has 100 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} or fewer, it dies. If the target has more than 100 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, it immediately takes 10d10 true damage.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Enhancement Specialist
entries: Those fighters who choose to become Enhancement Specialists learn to apply their technological prowess to their {@filter blasters|items|firearm=true}. With their deep understanding of both their weapon and how to manipulate its ammunition on the fly, they can often turn the tides of a battle with a single shot.

subclassFeature.name: Studied Shooter
entries: You learn specialized theory typical for practitioners of the enhancement trade. You gain proficiency in your choice of the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skills. Additionally, you learn your choice of the {@i encrypted message} or {@i minor hologram} {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}. Intelligence is your {@book techcasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Techcasting Ability} for these powers.

subclassFeature.name: Special Ammunition
entries: You learn ammunition enhancements that are fueled by amplified shots to unleash special enhanced effects.

entries.name: Ammunition Enhancements
entries: You know two ammunition enhancements of your choice, which are detailed under "Ammunition Enhancements" below, and you earn more at higher levels. Many ammunition enhancements boost an attack in some way. Once per turn when you fire a shot from a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} as part of the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action, you can apply one of your Ammunition Enhancement options to that shot, You gain an additional Ammunition Enhancement option of your choice when you reach certain levels in this class: 7th, 10th, 15th, and 18th level. Each option also improves when you become an 18th-level fighter.
Each time you learn new ammunition enhancements, you can also replace one ammunition enhancement you know with a different one.

entries.name: Amplified Shots
entries: You have two amplified shots, which you use to activate your ammunition enhancements. An amplified shot is expended when you use it. When you fire an amplified shot, your weapon is treated as enhanced for overcoming {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} and immunity to unenhanced attacks and damage. You decide to use the option when the shot hits a creature, unless the option doesn't involve an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}. You regain all of your amplified shots when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Saving Throws
entries: Some of your ammunition enhancements require your target to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to resist the {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}'s effects. The {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} DC is calculated as follows:
{@b Ammunition save DC} = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Dexterity modifier

subclassFeature.name: Ammunition Enhancements
entries: The ammunition enhancements are presented in alphabetical order.

entries.name: Carbonite Shot
entries: When this shot strikes its target, shards of {@spell Carbonite|sw5e-phb|carbonite} wrap around the target. The creature hit by the shot takes an extra 2d6 cold damage, it gains 1 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level, and it takes 2d6 kinetic damage the first time on each turn it moves 1 foot or more without teleporting. The target or any creature that can reach it can use its action to remove the {@spell Carbonite|sw5e-phb|carbonite} with a successful Strength ({@skill Athletics|sw5e-phb}) check against your Special Ammunition save DC. Otherwise, the {@spell Carbonite|sw5e-phb|carbonite} lasts for 1 minute or until you use this option again.
The cold damage and kinetic damage both increase to 4d6 when you reach 18th level in this class.

entries.name: Coercing Shot
entries: You enhance your shot with chemicals that confuse the target. The creature hit by the shot takes an extra 2d6 {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage, and choose one of your allies within 30 feet of the target. The target must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, or it is {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} by the chosen ally until the start of your next turn. This effect ends early if the chosen ally attacks the {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} target, deals damage to it, or forces it to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.
The {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage increases to 4d6 when you reach 18th level in this class.

entries.name: Explosive Shot
entries: You fire a shot set to explode on impact. The shot detonates after your attack. Immediately after the shot hits the creature, the target and all other creatures within 10 feet of it take 2d6 fire damage each.
The fire damage increases to 4d6 when you reach 18th level in this class.

entries.name: Hallucinogen Shot
entries: You enhance your shot with hallucinogenic chemicals. The creature hit by the shot takes an extra 2d6 psychic damage, and it must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be unable to see anything farther than 5 feet away until the start of your next turn.
The psychic damage increases to 4d6 when you reach 18th level in this class.

entries.name: Piercing Shot
entries: You enhance your shot with armor-piercing properties. When you use this option, you don't make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} for the attack. Instead, the shot shoots forward in a line, which is 1 foot wide and 30 feet long, before disappearing. The shot passes through objects, ignoring {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}. Each creature in that line must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, a creature takes damage as if it were hit by the shot, plus an extra 1d6 damage of the weapon's type. On a successful save, a target takes half as much damage.
The extra damage increases to 2d6 when you reach 18th level in this class.

entries.name: Quell Shot
entries: You fire a shot enhanced with a debilitating {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison}. The creature hit by the shot takes an extra 2d6 {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage. The target must also succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, or the damage dealt by its weapon attacks is halved until the start of your next turn.
The {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage increases to 4d6 when you reach 18th level in this class.

entries.name: Seeking Shot
entries: You apply a tracing signal to your shot. When you use this option, you don't make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} for the attack. Instead, choose one creature you have seen in the past minute. The shot flies toward that creature, moving around corners if necessary and ignoring three-quarters {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} and {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|half cover}. If the target is within the weapon's range and there is a path large enough for the shot to travel to the target, the target must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. Otherwise, the shot disappears after traveling as far as it can. On a failed save, the target takes damage as if it were hit by the shot, plus an extra 1d6 kinetic damage, and you learn the target's current location. On a successful save, the target takes half as much damage, and you don't learn its location.
The kinetic damage increases to 2d6 when you reach 18th level in this class.

subclassFeature.name: Enhanced Shot
entries: You gain the ability to enhance your shots. Whenever you fire an unenhanced shot from a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true}, you can make it enhanced for the purpose of overcoming {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} and immunity to unenhanced attacks and damage.

subclassFeature.name: Redirected Shot
entries: You learn how to direct an errant shot toward a new target. When you make an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with an enhanced shot and miss, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to reroll the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against a different target within 60 feet of the original target.

subclassFeature.name: Ever-Ready Shot
entries: Your enhanced ammunition is available whenever battle starts. If you roll {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} and have no uses of Special Ammunition remaining, you regain one use of it.

subclassFeature.name: Ammunition Upgrades
entries: Your ammunition enhancements improve.

subclassFeature.name: Exhibition Specialist
entries: Those fighters who choose to become Exhibition Specialists can't help but show off. Even where there isn't an audience, these warriors take command of the battlefield as though it were a stage.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in one Charisma skill of your choice.

subclassFeature.name: In The Spotlight
entries: You can overwhelm an opponent with your unique blend of skill and style. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can choose one creature you can see within 30 feet of you. The target is marked for 1 minute. While the target is marked, you gain the following benefits:

items: You can add half your Charisma modifier (minimum of one) to any weapon damage roll you make against the marked target that doesn't already include that modifier.
Your {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} range against the marked target increases by 1.

If the marked target is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your fighter level + your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1).

entries: This effect ends early if you're {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Showoff
entries: You're a master at dazzling your friends and enemies alike. When you would make a Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, or Charisma  check, you can roll a {@dice d4} and add it to the roll. On a success, you can immediately choose a number of creatures within 30 feet of you that can see you up to your Charisma modifier (no action required, minimum of one). Each creature must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Charisma modifier) or be {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} by you. This effects ends on a target after 1 minute, if it takes any damage, if you attack it, or if it witnesses you attacking or damaging any of its allies. If a target succeeds on this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the target has no hint you tried to charm it.
This die increases to 1d6 at 5th level, 1d8 at 9th level, 1d10 at 13th level, and 1d12 at 17th level.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

If a target succeeds on this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the target has no hint you tried to charm it.
This die increases to 1d6 at 5th level, 1d8 at 9th level, 1d10 at 13th level, and 1d12 at 17th level.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Glory Kill
entries: As you defeat your enemies in combat, you can weaken the morale of other foes or bolster the resolve of your allies alike. When you score a {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} or reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can choose one or more creatures that you can see within 30 feet of you, up to a number equal to your Charisma modifier (minimum of one creature). Each of the chosen creatures are affected by one of the following effects of your choice:

items: The creature gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to 1d6 + your Charisma modifier (minimum of 1 temporary hit point).

The creature must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Charisma modifier) or be {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} of you until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Relentless Competitor
entries: Once on each of your turns, you can regain a use of your Action Surge (no action required). If you do so, you immediately suffer one level of {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion}.

subclassFeature.name: Glorious Defense
entries: Your glory on the battlefront can misdirect attacks. When a creature you can see hits you with an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to gain a bonus to AC against that attack, potentially causing it to miss you. The bonus equals your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1). If the attack misses, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} against the attacker as part of this {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}.

subclassFeature.name: The Beauty of Violence
entries: You've perfected a fighting style that allows you to stylishly dominate the field of battle. When you mark a creature with your In The Spotlight feature, you can enhance it. For the duration of the mark, you gain the following additional benefits:

items: You can add your full Charisma modifier, instead of half, to any weapon damage roll you make against the marked target that doesn't already include that modifier.
You can add half your Charisma modifier (minimum of one) to any {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} roll you make against the marked target that doesn't already include that modifier.

If the marked target is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to mark a new creature within 30 feet of you. The duration of the new mark is equal to the remaining duration of the existing mark.

entries: This effect ends early if you're {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Explorer Pursuit
entries: The explorer strives to navigate past the known to discover new planets, forgotten ruins, or forbidden locations. Those scholars who choose the Explorer Pursuit spend their time studying maps, landmarks, architecture blue prints, or even history books, using them to effectively lead the way for their companions.

subclassFeature.name: Focused Navigator
entries: You gain proficiency in two of the {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb}, {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}, and {@skill Acrobatics|sw5e-phb} skills. Additionally, you can't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on checks you make with them.

subclassFeature.name: Surveyed Area
entries: You can now use your Critical Analysis feature on a 15-foot cube area within 60 feet of you that you can see. You can treat any creatures inside this cube as if they are the target of your Critical Analysis feature, and when a creature ends your Critical Analysis feature on themself, it does not end this effect for other creatures in your Surveyed Area.

subclassFeature.name: Field Advantage
entries: You learn to quickly convey spatial information in the midst of combat about the area you analyzed, giving them an edge at maneuvering in the area. While moving through your Surveyed Area, you and friendly creatures of your choice ignore unenhanced {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}, and {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} against them are made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

subclassFeature.name: Unstoppable Adventurer
entries: You learn to swim and scale vertical surfaces with ease. You gain swimming and climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.

Additionally, your Sage Advice feature can be used to give friendly creatures knowledge on how to swim or climb, provided you have a swimming or climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. Chosen creatures have a swimming {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} or climbing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} for the entire duration.

subclassFeature.name: Survey Master
entries: When you use the Surveyed Area feature, the area affected is a 30-foot cube instead of a 15-foot cube.

subclassFeature.name: Explorer Discoveries
entries: When you select this pursuit, you gain access to new discoveries which reflect your studies in maps and hidden routes. Whenever you learn a new discovery, you can choose from any of the following as well. The discoveries are listed in alphabetical order.

entries.name: Cover Adept
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 12th level} You treat one-quarter {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} as {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|half cover}, {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|half cover} as three-quarters {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}, and three-quarters {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} as full {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}. Additionally, while you are in {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}, Dexterity ({@skill Stealth|sw5e-phb}) checks you make gain a bonus equal to your Critical Analysis ability modifer (minimum of +1).

entries.name: Dungeon Explorer
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks and Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) checks to locate any secret doors or traps, and you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to damage dealt by traps.

Additionally, you can use your Sage Advice feature to teach friendly creatures about various types of traps, following the same rules of that feature. When you do so, the chosen creatures have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to damage dealt by traps.

entries.name: Galactic Explorer
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} When you make an Intelligence ({@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb}) check and add your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to the check, treat any roll of 9 or lower as if you had rolled a 10.

entries.name: Grappling Hunter
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} Attack rolls that you make against creatures that you are grappling have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

entries.name: High Ground
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} Once per turn, when you or a friendly creature hits a creature that is a target of your Critical Analysis feature, it takes additional damage equal to half your Critical Analysis ability modifer (minimum of +1).

entries.name: No Stone Left Unturned
entries: When you make a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) or Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) check to find a hidden creature that is inside the area that is targeted by your Critical Analysis feature, you do so with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

entries.name: Versatile Explorer
entries: You can hold your breath twice as long as you are normally able to, and take half as much damage from fall damage.

subclassFeature.name: Fireteam Specialist
entries: When charging onto the frontlines of the galaxy's harshest conflicts, it pays to have people you can trust at your side. Those fighters who choose to become Fireteam Specialists command the respect and loyalty of those beside them by guiding their squad through thick and thin.

subclassFeature.name: Improved Combat Superiority
entries: Your tactical skill in combat improves, granting bonuses to your Combat Superiority.

entries.name: Improved Maneuvers
entries: You know four {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} of your choice, instead of two, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the Maneuvers Known column of the Fireteam Superiority table.

entries.name: Improved Superiority Dice
entries: You have four {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers}, instead of two, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Superiority Dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} Quantity column of the Fireteam Superiority table.

subclassFeature.name: Lead By Example
entries: Once per turn, when an ally that can see or hear you attacks a creature that you can see, you can expend a superiority die and enhance that ally's attack, using one of the {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} that you know.

subclassFeature.name: Rally the Troops
entries: When you use your Second Wind feature, you can choose up to three allies within 60 feet of you that can see or hear you. Each ally gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your fighter level.
You can choose an additional ally at 9th, 13th, and 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: On Your Six
entries: You can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to begin a coordinated {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} with an ally who is within 5 feet of you. For the next minute, while you and the chosen ally are within 5 feet of each other and neither of you are wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}, you each gain a bonus to AC equal to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

When the chosen ally moves on their turn, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to move with them. You must end this movement within 5 feet of the ally, and this movement can't exceed your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.

This effect ends early if either you or your ally are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Tactical Advice
entries: Over the course of one minute, you can share knowledge with up to five allies. For the next hour, the chosen creatures gain all of your weapon and armor proficiencies, and a single use of your Indomitable feature.
You can choose an additional ally at 17th level.
Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: No Soldier Left Behind
entries: While under the effects of On Your Six, if either you or your ally are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can end On Your Six to have them drop to 1 hit point instead. When you do so, the effects of On Your Six persist until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Fireteam Specialist (Companion)
entries: When charging onto the frontlines of the galaxy's harshest conflicts, it pays to have people you can trust at your side. Those fighters who choose to become Fireteam Specialists work in tandem with a companion, becoming more than either could be on their own.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in your choice of the {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} skill.

subclassFeature.name: Improved Combat Superiority
entries: Your tactical skill in combat improves, granting bonuses to your Combat Superiority.

entries.name: Improved Maneuvers
entries: You know four {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} of your choice, instead of two, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the Maneuvers Known column of the Fireteam Superiority table.

entries.name: Improved Superiority Dice
entries: You have four {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers}, instead of two, and you earn more at higher levels, as shown in the {@book Superiority Dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} Quantity column of the Fireteam Superiority table.

subclassFeature.name: Humanoid Companion
entries: You've been assigned a squadmate who is under your command, gaining a humanoid companion.
Create your humanoid companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content.
In addition to its traits and features, your companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

items: Your companion gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your number of Hit Dice that can be spent to restore hitpoints is reduced by 1.

entries: Lastly, while your companion is bonded to you and within 10 feet of you, your companion can uses your {@book superiority dice|sw5e-phb|13|Superiority and Maneuvers} and {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} as if it knows them.
This radius increases to 30 feet at 11th level, and 60 feet at 17th level.

Create your humanoid companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content.
In addition to its traits and features, your companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

This radius increases to 30 feet at 11th level, and 60 feet at 17th level.

This radius increases to 30 feet at 11th level, and 60 feet at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Rally the Troops
entries: When you use your Second Wind feature while your companion is within 10 feet of you, your companion regains {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} and gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your fighter level.
This radius increases to 30 feet at 11th level, and 60 feet at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: On Your Six
entries: While your companion is within 5 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to begin a coordinated

entries.name: Fireteam Superiority
entries: {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}. For the next minute, while you and your companion are within 5 feet of each other and neither of you are wielding a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}, you each gain a bonus to AC equal to half your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.

This effect ends early if either you or your companion are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Indomitable in Tandem
entries: When you and your companion are both forced to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against the same effect, and one—but not both—of you fails, you can expend a use of your Indomitable feature to instead have you both succeed.

subclassFeature.name: No Soldier Left Behind
entries: While under the effects of On Your Six, if either you or your companion are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can end On Your Six to have them drop to 1 hit point instead. When you do so, the effects of On Your Six persist until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Frenzied Approach
entries: For some berserkers, rage is a means to an end—that end being violence. The Frenzied Approach is that of untrammeled fury, slick with blood. As you enter the berserker's rage, you thrill in the chaos of battle, heedless of your own health or well-being.

subclassFeature.name: Frenzy
entries: You can go into a frenzy when you enter your rage. If you do so, for the duration of your rage you can make a single {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each of your turns after this one.

The first time you use this feature, you suffer no ill effect. If you use this feature again before you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you suffer one level of {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} when your rage ends each time you use it.

When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you reduce your {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} level by 2, instead of 1. Additionally, any effect that removes {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} reduces your {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion} by 1 additional level.

subclassFeature.name: Maniacal Rage
entries: While raging, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}) checks.

subclassFeature.name: Mindless Rage
entries: You can't be {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} or {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} while raging. If you are {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} or {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} when you enter your rage, the effect is suspended for the duration of the rage.

subclassFeature.name: Intimidating Presence
entries: You can use your action to frighten someone with your menacing presence. When you do so, choose one creature that you can see within 30 feet of you. If the creature can see or hear you, it must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Charisma modifier) or be {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} of you until the end of your next turn. On subsequent turns, you can use your action to extend the duration of this effect on the {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} creature until the end of your next turn. This effect ends if the creature ends its turn out of line of sight or more than 60 feet away from you. While raging, you add double your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to the save DC, instead of your normal {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}.
If the creature succeeds on its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, it becomes immune to this feature for 24 hours.

subclassFeature.name: Retaliation
entries: When you take damage from a creature that is within 5 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against that creature.

subclassFeature.name: Geneticist Pursuit
entries: Throughout the galaxy there exists scientists who focus on unraveling the mysteries contained within the bodies of the divese sentients of the galaxy. Those scholars who choose the Geneticist Pursuit put their knowledge into practice, splicing their own genetic material to become superior beings... or monsters.

subclassFeature.name: Genesplicer's Methods
entries: You gain proficiency with geneticist's implements and your choice of {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Survival|sw5e-phb} skills. Additionally, you can't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on checks you make with them.

subclassFeature.name: Mutagenic Analysis
entries: While you are the target of your Critical Analysis feature, you can add half your Critical Analysis ability modifer (minimum of one) to any {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} you make that doesn't already include that modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Mutagenic Transformation
entries: When you target yourself with your Critical Analysis feature, you can choose to undergo a mutagenic transformation. Your form shifts, exaggerating and strengthening your geneticist discoveries for 1 hour. You gain the following benefits:

items: You can attack twice, instead of once, whenever you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action on your turn.
Your Strength score becomes equal to your Critical Analysis score.
You gain a bonus to your AC equal to half your Critical Analysis ability modifer (minimum of +1) if it doesn't already include that modifier.

entries: You can end this effect early on your turn as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. You can use this feature twice. You regain all expended uses of it when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Geneticist's Resilience
entries: Your genetic alterations make you immune to {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} and disease. Additionally, you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage.

subclassFeature.name: Chimeric Adaptation
entries: Your genetic modifications have reached new heights. When you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can choose one of the following features. When you undergo your mutagenic transformation, you also gain the benefits of the chosen feature for the duration. You can only have one of these features at a time.

entries.name: Aspect of the Terentatek
entries: You gain proficiency in Wisdom and Charisma {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, and when a creature within 30 feet of you casts a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to move up to half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} towards the creature. You must end this movement closer to the creature than you started. If you end this movement within 5 feet of the creature, you can make one melee attack against the creature (no action required).

entries.name: Aspect of the Rancor
entries: You gain proficiency in Strength and Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. Additionally, you gain immunity to the {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened} condition, and when you deal damage with a weapon or unarmed strike, you can deal an additional 1d8 damage of the same type as the weapon's damage.

entries.name: Aspect of the Varactyl
entries: You gain proficiency in Dexterity and Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}. Additionally, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 10 feet, your {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} can't suffer from {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, creatures can't have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} against you, and each {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level only reduces your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} by 5 feet, unless it would reduce your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} to 0.

subclassFeature.name: Geneticist Discoveries
entries: When you select this pursuit, you gain access to new discoveries which reflect the changes you have caused your own body to undergo. Whenever you learn a new discovery, you can choose from any of the following as well. The discoveries are listed in alphabetical order.

entries.name: Adapted Hide
entries: When you aren't wearing armor, your AC is 13 + your Dexterity modifier. Additionally, you are adapted to hot or cold climates (your choice), as described in {@book chapter 5|sw5e-phb|5} of the Dungeon Master's Guide. When you undergo your mutagenic transformation, you add your full Critical Analysis ability modifer, instead of half, to your AC for the duration.

entries.name: Atmospheric Adaptation
entries: You can breathe air and water. When you undergo your mutagenic transformation, you no longer need to breathe, and you can {@optfeature Survive|sw5e-phb|survive} up to one hour within the vacuum of space for the duration.

entries.name: Enhanced Musculature
entries: Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples. Additionally, when you make a long jump, you can {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} a number of feet up to twice your Strength score. When you make a high jump, you can leap a number of feet up into the air equal to 3 + twice your Strength modifier. When you undergo your mutagenic transformation, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength checks and Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} for the duration.

entries.name: Icarian Mutation
entries: You sprout a pair of winged arms. You gain a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to half your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}. You can only gain the benefit of items held by two of your arms at any given time, and once per round you can switch which arms you are benefiting from (no action required). When you undergo your mutagenic transformation, your flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases to your full walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, and you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to take the {@action Dash|sw5e-phb} action for the duration.

entries.name: Mutagenic Hardiness
entries: Your hit point maximum increases by a number equal to your level, and it increases by 1 every time you gain a level. When you undergo your mutagenic transformation, and at the beginning of each of your turns, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your half your scholar level + your Critical Analysis ability modifer for the duration.

entries.name: Predatory Senses
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} out to 60 feet. If you already have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision}, its range instead increases by 30 feet. When you undergo your mutagenic transformation, you gain {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) checks that rely on smell for the duration. Additionally, you can track creatures that have left a scent in the last 24 hours.

entries.name: Underground Adaptation
entries: You gain a burrowing {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} and you can tunnel through solid rock at a rate of 1 foot per round. In order to use this {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, you must have two free hands. When you undergo your mutagenic transformation, you gain {@sense Tremorsense|sw5e-phb|tremorsense} out to 30 feet for the duration. You can detect and pinpoint the origin of vibrations within a specific radius, provided that monster and the source of the vibrations are in contact with the same ground or substance. {@sense Tremorsense|sw5e-phb} can't be used to detect flying or incorporeal creatures.

entries.name: Unnatural Weaponry
entries: You sprout claws or some other natural weapon. Your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} deal 1d4 kinetic damage, and you can use your choice of your Strength, Dexterity, or Critical Analysis ability modifer for the attack and damage rolls. You must use the same modifier for both rolls. When you undergo your mutagenic transformation, your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} increase to a {@dice d6} and are considered enhanced for the duration. Additionally, you deal an additional 1d4 acid, lightning, or {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage when you hit with them.

subclassFeature.name: Gunslinger Practice
entries: Those operatives who choose the Gunslinger Practice are the masters of the trick shot. The Gunslinger and his {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} are the perfect team, utilizing knowledge of their enemies' vulnerabilities to take {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} of every opportunity.

subclassFeature.name: Dive For Cover
entries: You learn to quickly move into {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} when under fire. Once per round, when you are the target of a ranged attack, or you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and there is {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} within 10 feet of you, you can move up to 10 feet (no action required). You must end this movement in {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

Once per round, when you are the target of a ranged attack, or you are subjected to an effect that allows you to make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and there is {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover} within 10 feet of you, you can move up to 10 feet (no action required). You must end this movement in {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

You must end this movement in {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

You must end this movement in {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|cover}.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
