When you sense a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} in this way, you learn what the power is. At 11th level, your tracker droid companion must be within 30 feet of you or your target to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, your tracker droid companion must be within 60 feet. You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Tracker Droid Companion
entries: You learn to employ all the knowledge you've accumulated to create and customize your own tracker droid companion.

Create your tracker droid companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content. You must have {@item Astrotech's implements|sw5e-phb|astrotech's implements} in order to create your droid.
In addition to its traits and features, your tracker droid companion gains an additional benefit while it is bonded to you:

items: Your tracker droid gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each droid trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your tech point maximum is reduced by 1. Over the course of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can install, replace, or remove a number of droid traits equal to half your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one).

entries: Lastly, while your tracker droid companion is bonded and within 10 feet of you, you can use your action to learn the location of any droid or construct, tech focus, {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or enhanced item within 60 feet of you or your tracker droid that isn't behind {@variantrule Cover|sw5e-phb|total cover}. When you sense a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} in this way, you learn what the power is. subclassFeature.name: Mark of the Mechanist
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can cause the target of your Ranger's Quarry to emit an ion pulse, as long as the target is within 60 feet of you. The target, and any creatures within 5 feet of it, must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC. On a failed save, roll your Ranger's Quarry die; each creature takes ion damage equal to the amount rolled.

subclassFeature.name: High Voltage
entries: You are used to working with electronics and have learned to increase their potency, while becoming inured to their dangers. You gain {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to ion and lightning damage.

Additionally, whenever you deal ion damage to a creature, you can spend a tech point to force the creature to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, it is {@condition Stunned|sw5e-phb|stunned} until the end of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Command Droid
entries: You can reprogram a droid and bring it under your control. As an action, you can touch one droid that you can see that is the target of your Ranger's Quarry. That creature must make a Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC. If it succeeds, you can't use this feature on it again for 24 hours. If it fails, it becomes friendly to you and obeys your commands until you use this feature again.

Intelligent droids are harder to control in this way. If the target has an Intelligence of 8 or higher, it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If it fails the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} and has an Intelligence of 12 or higher, it can repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} at the end of every hour until it succeeds and breaks free.

subclassFeature.name: Mounted Specialist
entries: Those fighters who choose to become Mounted Specialists excel at mounted combat. Mounted Specialists are most dangerous from the seat of a speeder or saddle of a varactyl, though they can hold their own from the ground. Their versatility often has them leading the {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} or protecting the team.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in {@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Piloting|sw5e-phb}.

subclassFeature.name: Born to the Saddle
entries: Your mastery as a rider becomes apparent. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid falling off your mount. If you fall off your mount and descend no more than 10 feet, you can land on your feet if you're not {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}.
Finally, mounting or dismounting a creature or vehicle costs you only 5 feet of movement, rather than half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.

subclassFeature.name: Unwavering Mark
entries: You can menace your foes, foiling their attacks and punishing them for harming others. When you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can mark the creature until the end of your next turn. This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or you die, or if someone else marks the creature. While it is within 5 feet of you, a creature marked by you has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on any {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} that doesn't target you.

Additionally, if a creature marked by you deals damage to anyone other than you, you can make a special {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against the marked creature as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on your next turn. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, and if it hits, the attacks weapon deals extra damage to the target equal to half your fighter level.

Regardless of the number of creatures you mark, you can make this special attack a number of times equal to your Strength modifier (minimum of once), and you regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Warding Maneuver
entries: You learn to fend off strikes directed at you, your mount, or other creatures nearby. If you or a creature you can see within 5 feet of you is dealt damage by an attack, you can roll 1d8 as a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} if you're wielding a melee weapon or a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}. Roll the die, and add the number rolled to the target's AC against that attack. If the attack still hits, the target has {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against the attack's damage.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses of it when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Hold the Line
entries: You become a master of locking down your enemies. Creatures provoke an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} from you when they move 5 feet or more while within your reach, and if you hit a creature with an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack}, the target gains 4 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} levels until the end of the current turn.

subclassFeature.name: Ferocious Charger
entries: You can run down your foes, whether you're mounted or not. If you move at least 10 feet in a straight line right before attacking a creature and you hit it with the attack, that target must succeed on a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Strength modifier) or be knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}. You can use this feature only once on each of your turns.

subclassFeature.name: Vigilant Defender
entries: You respond to danger with extraordinary vigilance. In combat, you get a special {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} that you can take once on every creature's turn, except your turn. You can use this special {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} only to make an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack}, and you can't use it on the same turn that you take your normal {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}.

subclassFeature.name: Occultist Pursuit
entries: Occultists research the obscure practitioners of mystical arts, from witches to shamans to sorcerers. Those scholars who choose the Occultist Pursuit learn to harness these magics to bewitch and confound their enemies.

subclassFeature.name: Theurgic Research
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} and {@skill Nature|sw5e-phb} skills. Additionally, you can't have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on checks you make with them.

subclassFeature.name: Curse of Objurgation
entries: When you target a creature with your Critical Analysis, you can choose one ability. While it can see you, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} made with the chosen ability.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Curse of Objurgation

You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries: When you target a creature with your Critical Analysis, you can choose one ability. While it can see you, the target has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} made with the chosen ability.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Heightened Hex
entries: When you use your Curse of Objurgation feature, each time the cursed creature deals damage to you or an allied creature you can see within 5 feet of you, the creature takes psychic damage equal to twice your Critical Analysis ability modifer (minimum of 2).

subclassFeature.name: Voodoo Doll
entries: Over the course of an hour, which can be done during a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest}, you can perform a ritual to construct an effigy of a creature. In order to do so, you must have at least heard of or seen the creature before, and the target must be in the same system as you. At the end of the hour, the creature must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} save DC. This {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} is modified by how well you know the target and the sort of physical connection you have to it, as shown in the Knowledge Save Modifier and Connection Save Modifier tables below.

rows: Secondhand (you have heard of the target)
entries.caption: Knowledge Save Modifier

rows: Body part, lock of hair, bit of nail, or the like
entries.caption: Connection Save Modifier

entries: On a successful save, the target isn't affected, and you can't use this ritual against it again for 24 hours. On a failed save, the ritual creates a Tiny doll that is linked to the target. The doll remains linked for 24 hours, or for 10 minutes after you first use it. It disintegrates at the end of this duration. For the duration, you can see and hear the target through the doll as if you were within 5 feet of the creature.
Additionally, as action while the doll is in your possession, you can expend a Hit Die to torment the target, choosing an effect from the following options:

items: {@b Burn:} The target must succeed on a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. On a failed save, the target believes it is burning. While burning in this way, the target has has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} made with Strength or Dexterity. This effect lasts for 1 hour.

{@b Pain:} The target must succeed on a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be wracked with pain for 1 hour. While in pain in this way, the target takes an additional 1d4 psychic damage whenever it takes damage.

{@b Stab:} The target must succeed on a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or gain 2 {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} levels and fall {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}. The {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} levels effect lasts for 1 hour.

entries: The target can only be under 1 effect at a time. When you use a new effect, any existing effects end. Placing an effect on a target requires maintaining your {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}, as if concentrating on a power.
You can use this feature twice. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Toil and Trouble
entries: You perfect your control of your curses, granting them unmatched potency. When the target of your Curse of Objurgation fails a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against one of your {@book maneuvers|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers}, you can choose to amplify that {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} by expending a number of Hit Dice of your choice. The target immediately takes 1d8 psychic damage for every Hit Die spent in this way.

Additionally, when a creature attempts to use a power like {@i remove curse} or other similar abilities to remove a curse you set, they must roll a Wisdom or Charisma check (their choice) against your {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} save DC. On a failed save, their attempt fails, and any force or tech points spent in this way are wasted.

subclassFeature.name: Occultist Discoveries
entries: When you select this pursuit, you gain access to new discoveries which reflect your research on the occult. Whenever you learn a new discovery, you can choose from any of the following as well. The discoveries are listed in alphabetical order.

entries.name: Arcane Membrane
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Lore|sw5e-phb}) or Intelligence ({@skill Nature|sw5e-phb}) checks.

entries.name: Evil Eye
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 5th level} You can cast the {@i bestow curse} and {@i remove curse} {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} without spending force points. Wisdom or Charisma (your choice) is your {@book forcecasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} modifier for these powers.
Once you've cast a power using this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can cast it again.

entries.name: Exsanguination
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 9th level} When a creature marked by your Curse of Objurgation is reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can use a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a Hit Die to immediately regain a use of your Curse of Objurgation.

entries.name: Hexes and Superstitions
entries: When you roll a 13 on an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, you treat it as if you rolled a 20.

entries.name: Natural Karma
entries: Before you use a {@book maneuver|sw5e-phb|13|Maneuvers} or power to set a curse on a target you can see, you can make a contested Dexterity ({@skill Sleight Of Hand|sw5e-phb}) check against the target's Wisdom ({@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}) check. On a success, the target is unaware you set the curse on them.

entries.name: Savage Sortilege
entries: {@i {@b Prerequisite:} 13th level} You ignore {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to psychic damage, and you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to psychic damage.

entries.name: Supernatural Vigor
entries: At the end of a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can choose one creature you can see within 30 feet (this includes you) to imbue with unnatural power. The creature's hit point maximum and current {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} increase by an amount equal to your scholar level, and it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} made to avoid {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion}. Both effects end after 8 hours.

subclassFeature.name: Path of Aggression
entries: From the murky depths of the dark side comes seething fury. Those sentinels who follow the Path of Aggression {@optfeature Charge|sw5e-phb|charge} their weapon with lightning, culminating in a massive discharge that can ravage their opponents.

subclassFeature.name: Voltaic Slash
entries: Starting when you choose this calling at 3rd level, you learn the {@i lightning charge} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, which does not count against your total powers known. Additionally, you can use Wisdom or Charisma as your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for it, and when you deal lightning damage with the {@i lightning charge} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you deal additional lightning damage equal to half your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one) if it doesn't already include that modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Thunderous Momentum
entries: Your stride becomes nigh unbreakable. You are immune to the {@condition Shocked|sw5e-phb|shocked} condition, and each {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} level only reduces your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} by 5 feet, unless it would reduce your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} to 0.

subclassFeature.name: Entropic Rush
entries: You've learned to move with {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} and precision, discharging your lightning in a massive burst. When you move at least half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} before casting {@i lightning charge}, you make the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. Additionally, on a hit, the lightning can leap a second time, to a third creature within range or back to the first creature.

subclassFeature.name: Living Current
entries: You've learned to channel the damage done to you to enhance your strikes. The first time you deal damage on your turn, if you took damage since the start of your last turn, you can deal additional lightning damage equal to your Kinetic Combat die + half the amount of damage taken.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Retaliatory Strike
entries: When a creature hits you with an attack while within 5 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to cast the {@i lightning charge} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, targeting them.

subclassFeature.name: Path of Communion
entries: Those who master the Force can transcend death, persisting beyond their natural experation. Those sentinels who follow the Path of Communion bond with a Force ghost, developing a symbiotic relationship which alters the way they {@optfeature Perceive|sw5e-phb|perceive} their surroundings.

subclassFeature.name: Mystical Connection
entries: You learn the {@i feedback} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, which does not count against your total powers known. Additionally, you can use Wisdom or Charisma as your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for it, and you can use the Double Strike Force-Empowered Self option when you cast it as your action and the target fails its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. Finally, when you deal psychic damage with the {@i feedback} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you deal additional psychic damage equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one) if it doesn't already include that modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Symbiot Spirit
entries: You attract the attention of the spirit of a Force ghost. Over the course of one hour, you can attune to the spirit, forging a lasting connection. While attuned to a spirit, you gain the following benefits:

items: Your spirit is always audible and visible to you. Your spirit can choose to make itself audible and visible or inaudible and {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} to other creatures (no action required), but it is always visible to beings with {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight}.
Your spirit can not interact with the corporeal world, but it is also not impeded by unenhanced walls or barriers.

Your spirit acts independently of you, and it only obeys your commands if it chooses to. In combat, it rolls its own {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb|initiative} and acts on its own turn. Your spirit can't attack, but it can take other actions as normal.

While your spirit is within 100 feet of you, you can telepathically communicate with it. Additionally, as an action, you can see through your spirit's vision and hear what it hears until the start of your next turn. During this time, you are deaf and blind with regard to your own senses.

When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} with a range of touch, your spirit can deliver the power as if it had cast it. Your spirit must be within 100 feet of you, and it must use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to deliver the power when you cast it. If the power requires an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you use your attack modifier for the roll.

entries: You can only attune to one spirit at a time. If you attempt to attune to another spirit, you immediately break the bond with your current spirit.

entries.name: Generating Your Spirit
entries: Your spirit might be the ghost of a benevolent Jedi, discovered in the ruins of a Jedi temple, or a powerful Sith spirit lingering in an ancient artifact. It might be the spirit of a Nightsister sorceress, or a paragon of a long-forgotten monastic order. Work with your GM to determine the nature of your spirit.

Additionally, your spirit can briefly interact with the physical world. When you would make a melee attack, your spirit can deliver the attack as if it had made it. Your spirit must be within 100 feet of you, and it must use its {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to deliver the attack. It uses your modifiers for the attack and damage rolls. You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Invasive Presence
entries: Your spirit can invade another creature's being. As an action, your spirit can touch a creature within 5 feet of it, forcing it to make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC. If you or creatures that are friendly to you are fighting it, it has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

On a failed save, your spirit moves into that creatures space, inhabiting its body, for 1 minute. The affected creature has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} it makes each turn. At the end of each its turns, the creature repeats this save. On a success, it repels the spirit from its body, and it becomes immune to this feature for 24 hours.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Ethereal Vision
entries: You and your guiding spirit both gain {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight} out to 60 feet as long as your spirit is within 100 feet of you.

Additionally, when you use your action to see through your spirit's senses, you are no longer deaf and blind with regard to your own senses, able to comprehend what happens in both perspectives simultaneously.

subclassFeature.name: Assuming Direct Control
entries: When a creature fails its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your Invasive Presence feature, the target becomes {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} by you for as long as Invasive Presence is active.

While the target is {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed}, you and your spirit have a telepathic link with it as long as you are within 100 feet of it. You and your spirit can use this telepathic link to issue commands to the creature while you are conscious (no action required), which it does its best to obey. You can specify a simple and general course of action, such as "Attack that creature," "Run over there," or "Fetch that object." If the creature completes the order and doesn't receive further direction from you, it defends and preserves itself to the best of its ability.

You can use your action to take total and precise control of the target. Until the end of your next turn, the creature takes only the actions you choose, and doesn't do anything that you don't allow it to do. During this time you can also cause the creature to use a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}, but this requires you to use your own {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} as well.

subclassFeature.name: Path of Ethereality
entries: In the distant reaches of the galaxy obscure knowledge and forgotten secrets of the Force can sometimes be found. While other {@feat Force-Sensitive|sw5e-phb|Force-sensitive} may find themselves touched by this secret knowledge of the Force, those sentinels who follow the Path of Ethereality instead find themselves grabbed. Held onto by mysterious aspects of the Force that refuse to let go, these sentinels find themselves able to manipulate the universe around them.

subclassFeature.name: Aberrant Resilience
entries: You learn the {@i resistance} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, which does not count against your total powers known. Additionally, this power no longer requires {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} for you when you target yourself with it.

subclassFeature.name: Force-Empowered Kinesis
entries: Your connection to the Force allows you to briefly become incorporeal. When you use a Force-Empowered Self option, until the end of your turn, you can move through other creatures and objects as if they are {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}. If you end this movement inside a solid object or creature, you are immediately shunted to the nearest unoccupied space that you can occupy and take true damage equal to twice the number of feet you are moved.

subclassFeature.name: Out of Touch
entries: As an action, you can step out of sync with the rest of the universe for 1 minute. At the start of each of your turns, roll a {@dice d20}. If you roll 11 or higher, you and everything your are wearing or carrying are completely {@condition Invisible|sw5e-phb|invisible} to all beings, except for those with {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight}. On a roll of 10 or lower, you instead appear as an indistinguishably blurred form roughly your normal height and weight, though a being with {@sense Truesight|sw5e-phb|truesight} sees you normally. Regardless of your appearance, for the duration, your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} doubles, you gain a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}, and you can move through creatures and objects willingly though you can not affect them and they can not affect you. You can end this feature early on your turn (no action required). When this effect ends, if you are inside a solid object or creature, you are immediately shunted to the nearest unoccupied space that you can occupy and take force damage equal to twice the number of feet you are moved.

This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Event Cascade
entries: You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} you make against creatures if you haven't dealt damage to them or affected them with a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} since the start of your previous turn.

subclassFeature.name: Aberrant Self
entries: You no longer suffer the frailty of old age, and you can't be aged abnormally. You can still die of old age, however. Additionally, you no longer need food or water, and you no longer need to sleep. Lastly, the first time you take damage on each of your turns, you can roll your Kinetic Combat die and reduce the damage by that amount.

subclassFeature.name: Path of Iron
entries: Many sentinels choose to focus on a discipline that demands physical strength, reflexes, and fortitude. Those sentinels who follow the Path of Iron train their bodies to their physical peak, able to withstand nigh intolerable punishment and bolster their physical combat capabilities.

subclassFeature.name: Form Combat Training
entries: You learn one {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}, as detailed in the Customization Options document for Expanded Content.
Additionally, you gain proficiency in all martial light- and vibro- weapons.

subclassFeature.name: Physical Conditioning
entries: You've undergone special training, increasing your physical capabilities. You gain the following benefits:

items: You gain proficiency in {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}. If you are already proficient in {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}, you then gain proficiency in {@filter heavy armor|items|type=heavy armor}. While you are wearing light or {@filter medium armor|items|type=medium armor}, you can use your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice) instead of your Dexterity modifier when determining your AC.
Your hit point maximum increases by 3, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level in this class.

subclassFeature.name: Enhanced Force-Empowered Self
entries: Through intense physical training, you've improved your body's ability to access and channel the force flowing within you.
When you would use a Force-Empowered Self option, you can choose to bolster the option, gaining an additional effect as listed below. You can only bolster a Force-Empowered Self option once per turn.

You can use these features a combined three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain any expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
While you have no remaining uses of this feature, you can instead expend 1 force point to use it.

entries.name: Aegis
entries: When you bolster Deflection, when an attack would hit you before the start of your next turn, you subtract the same value rolled for Deflection from the damage taken.

entries.name: Cleave
entries: When you bolster Double Strike, you choose another creature within 5 feet of your target. They take damage of the same type equal to the result of the die rolled for Double Strike.

entries.name: Momentum
entries: When you bolster Slow Time, until the end of your turn you ignore {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}, and can move along vertical surfaces and across liquids without falling during the move.

subclassFeature.name: Follow Through
entries: When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action on your turn, you can spend 2 force points and forgo one of your attacks to cast an at-will {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} which requires you to make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}.

subclassFeature.name: Kinetic Mastery
entries: Choose a {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms} you know. Once on each of your turns, you can use the chosen form without using your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.
You can do so six times. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
While you have no remaining uses of this feature, you can instead expend 1 force point to use it.

subclassFeature.name: Path of Meditation
entries: Throughout the Force, there is both symphonic harmony, and discordant chaos. Those sentinels who follow the Path of Meditation embody these concepts, empowering their allies and hindering their enemies through the use of the ancient {@spell Force Technique|sw5e-phb|Force technique} of {@spell Battle Meditation|sw5e-phb|battle meditation}.

subclassFeature.name: Sage Counsel
entries: You learn the {@i guidance} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, which does not count against your total powers known. Additionally, this power's die increases by one step (from {@dice d4} to {@dice d6}, {@dice d6} to {@dice d8}, {@dice d8} to {@dice d10}, or {@dice d10} to {@dice d12}).

subclassFeature.name: Force-Empowered Allies
entries: While you are concentrating on a power that benefits a friendly creature other than you, you gain new ways to utilize your Force-Empowered Self features. Each option costs 1 force point, and you can only target a creature that is benefiting from a power you cast.

entries.name: Deflection
entries: When an ally is hit with an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and roll a Kinetic Combat die to add it to your ally's AC, potentially causing the attack to miss.

entries.name: Double Strike
entries: When an ally hits with an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and roll a Kinetic Combat die to deal additional damage of the same type as the attack.

entries.name: Slow Time
entries: When an ally moves on their turn, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and roll a Kinetic Combat die to increase their {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} by 5 x the amount rolled until the end of the turn.

subclassFeature.name: Unbreakable Focus
entries: Once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can cast the {@i battle meditation} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at its base level without expending force points. While concentrating on {@i battle meditation}, at the start of each of your turns, the power's die increases by one step (from {@dice d4} to {@dice d6}, {@dice d6} to {@dice d8}, {@dice d8} to {@dice d10}, or {@dice d10} to {@dice d12}).

Additionally, whenever you make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can treat a {@dice d20} roll of 9 or lower as a 10.

subclassFeature.name: Turbulent Presence
entries: Once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can cast the {@i improved battle meditation} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at its base level without expending force points. While concentrating on {@i improved battle meditation}, at the start of each of your turns, the power's die increases by one step (from {@dice d6} to {@dice d8}, {@dice d8} to {@dice d10}, or {@dice d10} to {@dice d12}).

Additionally, once per round, when a creature rolls a bonus or penalty die from an effect you control, you can have them roll the die with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} or {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} (your choice).

subclassFeature.name: Legendary Battle Meditation
entries: Once per {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can cast the {@i master battle meditation} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} without expending force points. While concentrating on {@i master battle meditation}, at the start of each of your turns, the power's die increases by one step (from {@dice d8} to {@dice d10}, or {@dice d10} to {@dice d12}).

Additionally, you gain a second {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} each round that you can only use for your Force-Empowered Allies feature. You can only take one {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} per turn.

subclassFeature.name: Path of Synthesis
entries: There is power in diversity unknown to those of narrow mind. Those sentinels who follow the Path of Synthesis blend their intricate mastery of the Force with their understanding of technology, creating unique effects to overcome their obstacles.

subclassFeature.name: Techcasting Secrets
entries: You have learned to intersperse your training with an aptitude for technology. Choose two {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 1st level or lower. The chosen powers count as universal {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} for you, but are not included in the number in the Powers Known column of the sentinel table.

At 7th level, you learn two {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 2nd level or lower. At 13th level, you learn two {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 3rd level or lower. At 17th level, you learn two {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 4th level or lower. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you know and replace it with another {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of no higher than the level determined by this feature.

subclassFeature.name: Synthetic Understanding
entries: You've applied your newfound knowledge to broader pursuits. You gain proficiency in {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} or one tool of your choice.

Additionally, when you make an Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check, or a check with a tool, you may use your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice) instead of your Intelligence modifier.
Finally, when you deal damage with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or your Double Strike Force Empowered Self option, you can choose to substitute the damage dealt as ion.

subclassFeature.name: Force-Empowered Tech
entries: You learn to fully blend your technological aptitude with your use of the Force. You have three such effects: Disruption Pulse, Force Override, and {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}. When you use your Force-Empowered Tech, you choose which effect to create.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries.name: Disruption Pulse
entries: As an action, you can send out a 30 foot cone of electromagnetically-charged energy to {@spell Overload|sw5e-phb|overload} enemy weapons. Each creature within the cone that is wearing or carrying a weapon with electric components must make an Intelligence {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. If the weapon is being worn, this save is made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}. On a failed save, the first attack they attempt to make with that weapon has {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}. A creature with multiple weapons must make a separate save for each weapon.

entries.name: Forced Override
entries: When you cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that requires a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the save (no action required).

entries.name: Techcasting Insight
entries: As an action, you can attempt to determine another creature's experience with {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting}. When you do so, you make an Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check contested by the target's Intelligence ({@skill Technology|sw5e-phb}) check. If you succeed, you immediately learn the target's {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} Max Power Level, as well as any {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} currently affecting the target.

subclassFeature.name: Force-Empowered Tech
entries: You learn to fully blend your technological aptitude with your use of the Force. You have three such effects: Disruption Pulse, Force Override, and {@book techcasting|sw5e-phb|10|Force- and Tech-casting} {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb}. When you use your Force-Empowered Tech, you choose which effect to create.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries: As an action, you can send out a 30 foot cone of electromagnetically-charged energy to {@spell Overload|sw5e-phb|overload} enemy weapons. If the weapon is being worn, this save is made with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}. subclassFeature.name: Improved Force-Empowered Tech
entries: You've gained access to two additional Force-Empowered Tech effects: Harmonic Synthesis and Conservation of Energy.

entries.name: Harmonic Synthesis
entries: When you use your action to cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to gain {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to damage dealt by {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} until the start of your next turn. If you use your action to cast a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you can instead gain {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to damage dealt by {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

entries.name: Conservation of Energy
entries: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers}, you can reduce the force point cost of the {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} to 0 (no action required).

subclassFeature.name: Reflective Shield
entries: When you use your Force-Empowered Tech features, a barrier for energy shimmers into existence, surrounding you until the end of your next turn. When you take damage, you can mitigate the incoming energy and potentially reflect it back at your attacker. You use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against the triggering damage, and if the source of the damage is within 5 feet of you, they take half of the total damage dealt as ion.

subclassFeature.name: Path of Tenacity
entries: The tenacious are ever mindful that the Force ebbs and flows, and uses this knowledge to great {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}. Those sentinels who follow the Path of {@optfeature Tenacity|sw5e-phb} use their connection to the Force to draw the opposition's attention while also warding off their attacks, serving as an effective bulwark against even the most implacable of foes.

subclassFeature.name: Protector
entries: You learn the {@i saber ward} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, which does not count against your total powers known. Additionally, when you cast it, you can spend 2 force points to extend the benefits to creatures of your choice within 5 feet of you while the power is active. The creatures immediately lose this benefit if they move more than 5 feet away from you.

subclassFeature.name: Kinetic Ward
entries: You can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to deflect a strike when you are dealt damage by a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}. When you do so, the damage you take from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + your Dexterity modifier + your sentinel level. If you reduce the damage to 0, you can redirect it at another target if you have a weapon capable of doing so. You can spend 1 force point to make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} at a target within 5 feet of you with the weapon, as part of the same {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb}. You make this attack with proficiency, regardless of your weapon proficiencies, and if the attack hits it uses your Kinetic Combat die for its damage roll. If {@i saber ward} is active, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}.

subclassFeature.name: Kinetic Bulwark
entries: You can extend your Kinetic Ward to a creature within 5 feet of you when they are hit by a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}. If this damage is not reduced to 0, the warded creature takes any remaining damage.

subclassFeature.name: Indomitable
entries: The Force flowing through you makes it harder for movement to be forced upon you. You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} and {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} to avoid being {@condition Grappled|sw5e-phb|grappled} or moved. If you fail the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, you can spend 1 force point to reroll one of the dice once. You must use the new roll.
Additionally, if allies within 5 feet of you are gaining the benefit of your {@i saber ward} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, they also gain the benefit of this feature.

subclassFeature.name: Kinetic Bastion
entries: You can protect allies even further from you. When a creature within 30 feet of you is hit by a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to teleport to them and extend your Kinetic Ward. If this damage is not reduced to 0, the warded creature takes any remaining damage.
You can use this feature six times. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Path of Witchcraft
entries: The Force connects all living things. Those sentinels who follow the Path of Witchcraft use that connection to summon the aid of nature, both spirits and the elements, adapting them to their will.

subclassFeature.name: Wild Power
entries: You learn the {@i enfeeble} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, which does not count against your total powers known. Additionally, you can use Wisdom or Charisma as your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} for it, and you can use the Double Strike Force-Empowered Self option when you cast it as your action and the target fails its save. Finally, you add your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one) to damage rolls with it.

subclassFeature.name: Ichor Conjuring
entries: You learn to call on the spirits of beasts and grant them ichorous form. Once on each of your turns, when you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and deal necrotic damage to a creature, you can conjure a familiar within 5 feet of it (no action required). The familiar takes the form of a humanoid or beast made of green, glowing smoke, and it lasts for 1 minute, until you dismiss it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, until you manifest another spirit, or until you're {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die.

Your familiar has an AC equal to your universal force save DC, 1 hit point, and immunity to all conditions. If it has to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, it uses your {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} bonus for the roll. It is the same size as you regardless of its appearance, and it occupies its own space. On your turn, you can mentally command the familiar to move up to 30 feet in any direction (no action required). If your familiar is ever more than 30 feet from you at the end of your turn, it is destroyed. While you have a familiar, you gain the following benefits:

items: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can use your magicks to teleport, swapping places with your familiar at a cost of 15 feet of your movement, regardless of the distance between the two of you.
When you take the {@action Attack|sw5e-phb} action on your turn, any attack you make with that action can originate from your space or the familiar's space. You make this choice for each attack.

When a creature that you can see within 5 feet of your familiar moves at least 5 feet away from it, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to make an {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attack} against that creature as if you were in the familiar's space.

entries: Starting at 11th level, you can summon your familiar when you deal damage with any {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, instead of just necrotic. Additionally, you can summon your familiar when you use a Force-Empowered Self option on your turn.

subclassFeature.name: Nature's Vigor
entries: You've learned to attune your senses with nature. If you spend at least 1 minute meditating while in nature, you gain the following benefits for 1 hour:

items: You ignore {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain} caused by nature.
You can understand plants within 30 feet of you. They can telepathically communicate simple ideas to you, including memories from within the past day.
You can command plants within 30 feet of you to create {@variantrule Difficult Terrain|sw5e-phb|difficult terrain}, or other tasks at the GM's discretion (no action required).

entries: Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Waters of Life
entries: You've learned to absorb the fleeting magicks of your familiar. When your familiar is destroyed by taking damage, you can choose to grant temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to 2d8 + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice) to one friendly creature of your choice you can see within 30 feet.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Stormcaller
entries: You've learned to command the elements to summon a fierce storm in a 30-foot radius around you. As an action, you can gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You gain a flying {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} equal to your walking {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.
You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to energy, lightning, and necrotic damage.
Whenever a hostile creature enters this radius for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it takes 10 lightning damage.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

entries: The Force connects all living things. Those sentinels who follow the Path of Witchcraft use that connection to summon the aid of nature, both beasts and the elements, adapting them to their will.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency in {@skill Animal Handling|sw5e-phb}.

subclassFeature.name: Beast Companion
entries: You learn to create a powerful bond through the Force with your own  beast companion.
Create your beast companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content.
In addition to its traits and features, your beast companion gains an additional benefit while it is bonded to you:

items: Your beast gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each beast trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your force point maximum is reduced by 2.

entries: Lastly, while bonded and within 10 feet of you, your beast companion gains the following benefits:

items: When you use a Force-Empowered Self option to increase your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} or {@variantrule Armor Class|sw5e-phb|armor class}, you can instead grant this bonus to your beast companion.
You and your beast companion can communicate telepathically, though your beast companion can only communicate in and understand simple concepts.

entries: This radius increases to 30 feet at 11th level, and 60 feet at 17th level.

entries: Your bond with your beast companion strengthens, granting the following benefits while your beast companion is within 30 feet of you:

items: When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that targets only yourself, and your beast companion is within range, you can also target your beast companion with that power.

If you or your beast have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} and the other doesn't, the other gains it with the same radius. If you both have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision}, you both use the larger radius of the two, which then increases by 30 feet.

If you or your beast have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} checks and the other doesn't, the other gains {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} checks. If you both have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} checks, when either of you makes a {@skill Perception|sw5e-phb} check with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}, you can reroll one of the dice once.

entries: This radius increases to 60 feet at 17th level.
