subclassFeature.name: Personal Teleporter
entries: You can use portable teleporters as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, instead of an action.

Additionally, while you are wielding a tech focus, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to create a pair of linked portals: one portal appears in a space within 5 feet of you, and the other portal appears in an unoccupied space you can see up to 30 feet away. These portals last until the start of your next turn, and they are large enough to accommodate Medium and smaller creatures and objects. Portals take the appearance of an elongated, shimmering {@item Mirror|sw5e-phb|mirror}, and looking through a portal, a creature can see through the linked portal as if looking through a window. A creature or object who passes through a portal immediately appears in a space within 5 feet of the linked portal. You can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to end your portals early. If a creature is partially within your portals, it is shunted back to the space it previously occupied and it must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your a tech save DC. On a failed save, it takes energy damage equal to your scout level + your Intelligence modifier. You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. At the beginning of each of your turns while you have a pair of portals active, you can expend a use of this feature to extend the duration of the portals until the start of your next turn (no action required). The distance at which you can create portals increases at higher levels. It increases to 60 feet at 5th level, 90 feet at 9th level, 150 feet at 13th level, 300 feet at 17th level, and 1,000 feet at 20th level.

subclassFeature.name: Mark of the Teleporter
entries: On your turn, when you deal damage to the target of your Ranger's Quarry, and either you, your weapon, or the source of your damage have passed through your portals on this turn, when you roll below half the maximum on a damage die, you can treat the roll as if you'd rolled half the maximum on the damage die. You can only affect a number of dice up to half your Intelligence modifier (minimum of one) in this way.

subclassFeature.name: Residual Warp
entries: When you use your Personal Teleporter feature, you can place your portal in a place you've visited in the last 10 minutes, provided you can remember it, as opposed to a place you can see. That place must still be within range of your teleporter.

subclassFeature.name: Quantum Entanglement
entries: When you use your Personal Teleporter feature, you can place the portal that you would normally place within 5 feet of you in a place you can see within your Personal Teleporter's range. If that space is occupied by a Huge or smaller creature or a Medium or smaller unsecured object, it must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC. An object automatically fails this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, and a creature can choose to fail. On a failed save, a Medium or smaller creature or object falls through the portal, immediately appearing in a space within 5 feet of the linked portal and falling {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}. A Large or Huge creature instead falls {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone} without moving.

subclassFeature.name: Reprisal
entries: When you would be affected by a weapon or {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} that requires a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} and would affect only you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to instantaneously create a pair of portals to redirect that power to another target within 30 feet. If the weapon or power required a melee or ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, make a melee or ranged tech {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against the new target, as appropriate. If it required a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the new target must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Teras Kasi Order
entries: Monks of the Teras Kasi Order are the ultimate masters of unarmed martial arts combat. They learn techniques to draw focus from the defeat of their enemies, resist the mental assaults of the Force, and unleash powerful rushes of strikes to subdue their foes.

subclassFeature.name: Forredari Stance
entries: Your honed focus allows you to enter a stance of mental fortification and power. You can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to enter this stance. When you do so, you unleash a flurry of blows on creatures of your choice that you can see within 10 feet of you. Each creature in the area must make a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} (DC = 8 + your bonus to attacks with the weapon) or take the weapon's normal damage.
This stance lasts for 1 minute. While you are in this stance, you gain the following benefits:

items: {@b Death Weave.} When you reduce a creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your focus ability modifier + half your monk level.
{@b Gundark Slap.} Once on each of your turns, when you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or a monk weapon, you can choose to make it unable to take reactions until the end of your next turn.

{@b Sleeping Krayt.} You can use your focus ability modifier instead of Strength whenever you would make a Strength check or a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}. Additionally, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against being {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} or {@condition Frightened|sw5e-phb|frightened}.

entries: These effects end early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

While you have no remaining uses of this feature, you can instead expend 1 focus point to use it. When you do so, your maximum focus points are reduced by 1 until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Steel Hands Form
entries: You can draw upon your focus to utilize an array of {@feat Practiced|sw5e-phb|practiced} techniques to strike your opponents with precision and power. You can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to enter this stance, and when you do so, you can also enter your Forredari Stance as a part of this same {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. This form lasts for 1 minute. While you are in this stance, you gain the following benefits:

items: {@b Charging Wampa.} Once per round, when you are forced to make a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, your movement {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 10 feet until the end of your next turn.

{@b Nexu Grin.} When a creature you can see within 10 feet of you casts a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that requires a force {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against you or an an allied creature, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend 1 focus point to impose {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on the {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}. If the attack misses, and the higher of the two {@dice d20} rolls would also miss, the creature cannot cast that {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} again until it completes a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

{@b Screaming Squill.} Once per turn, when you hit a creature that is concentrating on a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and it makes a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}, the DC for the check equals your focus save DC, unless the DC for the Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} would be higher.

entries: These effects end early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

While you have no remaining uses of this feature, you can instead expend 1 focus point to use it. When you do so, your maximum focus points are reduced by 1 until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Matter Over Mind
entries: You tap into the greater power of your focus. While both your Forredari Stance and your Steel Hands Form are active, you gain the following benefits:

items: {@b Dancing Dragonsnake.} When you take force, lightning, or necrotic damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to deflect it. When you do so, the damage you take is reduced by 1d10 + your focus ability modifier + your monk level.

{@b Aryx Slash.} Once on each of your turns, when you hit a target with an unarmed strike or monk weapon, you can roll a Martial Arts die and deal additional psychic damage equal to the amount rolled.

{@b Piercing Gaze.} When you would make an {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} check against a creature you know to wield the Force, you can use your focus ability modifier for the roll, and you are considered to have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the {@skill Insight|sw5e-phb} skill. If you would already have {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in the check, you instead have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the roll.

subclassFeature.name: Spitting Rawl
entries: You have learned to harness your strikes in a blistering fury. On your turn, when a creature takes damage from you three times, you can make up to three additional {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|sw5e-phb|unarmed strikes} against the creature (no action required). The first additional unarmed strike costs 1 focus point and deals 1d12 additional psychic damage on a hit, and each unarmed strike after the first costs 1 additional focus point and deals 1d12 additional psychic damage on a hit, cumulatively.

subclassFeature.name: Totem Specialist
entries: Those fighters who become Totem Specialists tap into a primal attunement to the Force, applying tribal ceremony to create powerful talismans that enhance their abilities.

subclassFeature.name: Bonus Proficiencies
entries: You gain proficiency with your choice of artist's implements or jeweler's implements.

subclassFeature.name: Totem Creation
entries: You've learned to create powerful talismans infused with the Force. Your totems can take the form of sigils painted directly onto your equipment, or adornments attached to it, as you see fit. Regardless of the form they take, only you can benefit from them. You learn two totems of your choice, which are detailed under "Totems" below. When you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can replace one totem you know with a different one.

When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you can touch a number of weapons, armor, or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shields} equal to the number of totems you know, affixing a different totem to each object. Your totem remains affixed until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, and an object can only bear one totem at a time. You must be wielding or wearing the object to benefit from a totem affixed to it.
Each totem can be invoked to grant an effect. Once you've invoked a totem in this way, you can't do so again until you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Totem Options
entries: The totems are listed in alphabetical order. If a totem requires a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, the DC = 8 + your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice).

entries.name: Totem of the Acklay
entries: This totem evokes the ferocity of an acklay, granting you {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Nature|sw5e-phb}) checks and Charisma ({@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}) checks.

Additionally, you can invoke the totem as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}. For 10 minutes, your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles, and your Strength score increases by 2. This increase can cause your score to exceed 20.

entries.name: Totem of the Hawk
entries: This totem is inspired by the visage of a hawk, granting you {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Intelligence ({@skill Investigation|sw5e-phb}) checks, and {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision} out to a range of 60 feet. If you already have {@sense Darkvision|sw5e-phb|darkvision}, its range increases by 30 feet.

Additionally, when a creature you can see ends its turn within 30 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to invoke the totem and force the creature to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} by emitting a powerful sound. Unless the save succeeds, the creature is dazed, suffering from the {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} condition, for 1 minute. While {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} in this way, the creature has a {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} of 0 and is {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}. The effect ends if the {@condition Charmed|sw5e-phb|charmed} creature takes any damage or if someone else uses an action to shake the creature out of its haze. Once you invoke the totem, you can't do so again until you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. A deaf creature automatically succeeds on its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

entries.name: Totem of the Loth-wolf
entries: This totem emulates the near etherealness of a loth-wolf, granting you {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Dexterity ({@skill Sleight Of Hand|sw5e-phb}) checks and Charisma ({@skill Deception|sw5e-phb}) checks.

Additionally, when you or a creature you can see within 30 feet of you is hit by an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to invoke the totem and cause that attack to target a different creature within 30 feet of you (other than the attacker) that you can see, using the same roll. This ability can transfer the attack regardless of the attack's range.

entries.name: Totem of the Rancor
entries: This totem bestows a resilience reminiscent of a mighty rancor, granting you {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws} against being {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned} and {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to {@item Poison|sw5e-phb|poison} damage.
Additionally, you can invoke the totem as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, gaining {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to energy and kinetic damage for 1 minute.

entries.name: Totem of the Sarlacc
entries: This totem channels the experience of an ancient sarlacc, granting you {@variantrule Expertise|sw5e-phb|expertise} in any one tool in which you are proficient.

Additionally, when you hit a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}, you can invoke the totem to summon the tentacles of the creature: The target must succeed on a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} or be {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained} for 1 minute. While {@condition Restrained|sw5e-phb|restrained} by the tentacles, the target takes 2d6 acid damage at the start of each of its turns. The target can repeat the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} at the end of each of its turns, tearing free on a success.

entries.name: Totem of the Vornskr
entries: With this totem you are able to access the Force-enhanced senses of the vornskr, granting you {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Survival|sw5e-phb}) checks, and you can't be surprised as long as you are not {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}.

Additionally, you can invoke the totem as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to enter a state of hyper awareness for 1 minute or until you're {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}. Until the state ends, when you or another creature you can see within 60 feet of you makes an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, or an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to cause the roll to have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} or {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.

subclassFeature.name: Totemic Might
entries: You can channel the power of your Force awareness temporarily. As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can gain the following benefits for 1 minute. You can invoke a totem as a part of this same {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

items: Your carrying capacity and the weight you can push, drag, or lift doubles. If it would already double, it instead triples.
You have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Strength checks and Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.
Your weapon attacks deal an extra 1d6 damage.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. You can use this feature twice. You regain all expended uses of it when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Guardian Spirit
entries: You learn to invoke your totems to protect your allies. When another creature you can see within 60 feet of you is hit by an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to grant a bonus to the creature's AC against that attack. The bonus equals 1 + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of +2).

subclassFeature.name: Primal Avatar
entries: You learn a third totem. Additionally, the bonus damage of your Totemic Might feature increases to 1d8. Lastly, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on {@skill Lore|sw5e-phb} checks you make about tribal cultures.

subclassFeature.name: Spirit Guide
entries: You can invoke each of your totems twice, instead of once. You regain all expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Blessing of the Tree of Light
entries: You learn how to share your totem's power with your allies. When you use your Totemic Might feature, you can choose one willing creature you can see within 60 feet of you. The chosen creature also gains the benefits of your Totemic Might feature. If you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or killed, this effect immediately ends for both of you.

subclassFeature.name: Trakata Form
entries: {@optfeature Trakata Form|sw5e-phb}, also known as {@skill Deception|sw5e-phb} Form, capitalizes on a {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}'s ability to quickly be toggled on and off. Those guardians who focus on {@optfeature Trakata Form|sw5e-phb} perform dazzling tricks with their {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon}, confusing their opponents before dispatching them.

subclassFeature.name: Form Basics
entries: You gain the Trakata {@book lightsaber form, detailed in chapter 6|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms} of the Player's Handbook. If you already know this form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

subclassFeature.name: The Way of the Monkey-Lizard
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can enter a confusing stance for one minute. As a part of this {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, and as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} on each of your turns, when you take the {@action Dodge|sw5e-phb} action, you can make one {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} against a creature within range. Additionally, when you make this {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can {@optfeature Flourish|sw5e-phb|flourish} your weapon to attempt to distract your target. Make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight Of Hand|sw5e-phb}) check contested by a Wisdom ({@skill Perception|sw5e-phb}) check of the target of your attack. On a success, you make this {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} with {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage}.

This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Channel the Force
entries: You gain the following Channel the Force option.

entries.name: Unbalancing Block
entries: When you are hit with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, and you are wielding a {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} with which you are proficient, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a use of your Channel the Force to add your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of +1) to your AC for that attack, potentially causing the attack to miss you.

subclassFeature.name: Duplicitous Force
entries: When you make a Dexterity ({@skill Sleight Of Hand|sw5e-phb}) check, you gain a bonus to that check equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one).

subclassFeature.name: Pass the Blade
entries: When a creature misses you with an attack, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one), and you add your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one) to the first {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} and damage rolls you make against that creature before the end of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Master of Deception
entries: Your skill with a {@filter lightweapon|items|type=martial weapon|category=lightweapon} is both mesmerizing and confounding. Your Dexterity and Wisdom or Charisma scores (your choice) increase by 2. Your maximum for these scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to kinetic, energy, and ion damage from weapons.
Your {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} can't suffer from {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}.
Whenever a creature misses you with a melee attack, it takes 5 energy damage.
Whenever a creature hits you with a melee attack, it takes damage equal to half of the damage you take from the attack.

entries: This effect ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die. Once you use this feature, you can't use it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Triage Technique
entries: With every conflict comes death and destruction. Followers of the Triage Technique excel at keeping their comrades in the fight with quick thinking and fast-acting medicine.

subclassFeature.name: Triage Training
entries: You gain proficiency in the {@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb} skill.

Additionally, when you would use your action to make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} to stabilize a creature, expend a use of a {@item Traumakit|sw5e-phb|traumakit}, or use a {@item Medpac|sw5e-phb|medpac}, you can instead use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

subclassFeature.name: Mark of Triage
entries: You learn new ways to use your Ranger's Quarry.

items: While a hostile creature is the target of your Ranger's Quarry, you always know any conditions it is suffering from, and you know at roughly what percentage its current {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} is relative to its maximum. Additionally, if the target is within 60 feet of you, when it is forced to make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to force it to make the roll with {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}. Once you've used this feature, you must complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

While a friendly creature is the target of your Ranger's Quarry, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on Wisdom ({@skill Medicine|sw5e-phb}) checks made to stabilize it. Additionally, if the target is within 60 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} and roll your Ranger's Quarry and either restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount rolled, or grant temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount rolled. Once a friendly creature has benefited from this ability, they can not do so again until they complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Double Dose
entries: Your application of medicine does not interfere with your own ability to recover from injuries. When you restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} or grant temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to another creature with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature, you recover the same amount of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} or gain the same number of temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Double Dose
entries: Your application of medicine does not interfere with your own ability to recover from injuries. When you restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} or grant temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to another creature with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature, you recover the same amount of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} or gain the same number of temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Double Dose
entries: Your application of medicine does not interfere with your own ability to recover from injuries. When you restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} or grant temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to another creature with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature, you recover the same amount of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} or gain the same number of temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Double Dose
entries: Your application of medicine does not interfere with your own ability to recover from injuries. When you restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} or grant temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to another creature with a {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} or class feature, you recover the same amount of {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} or gain the same number of temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Experimental Infusion
entries: When you target a creature with your Ranger's Quarry, you can grant one of the following additional effects of your choice:

items: {@b {@i Adrenaline/Tranquilizer.}} The creature's movement {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} is doubled until the end of its next turn. Alternatively, it gains a level of {@condition Slowed|sw5e-phb|slowed} until the end of its next turn.

{@b {@i Focus/Dizziness.}} The creature has either {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} or {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} (your choice) on the first {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} it makes within the next minute.

{@b {@i Toughen/Weaken.}} The creature gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your scout level, which last for 1 minute. Alternatively, the creature must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your tech save DC. On a failure, it takes psychic damage equal to your scout level and it can't regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} until the start of your next turn.

entries: You can use each feature once. You regain any expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Cure-All
entries: Your healing becomes even more potent. When you restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} or grant temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a creature as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} using your Mark of Triage feature, you can also end one of the following conditions afflicting it: {@condition Blinded|sw5e-phb|blinded}, {@condition Deafened|sw5e-phb|deafened}, {@condition Diseased|sw5e-phb|diseased}, {@condition Paralyzed|sw5e-phb|paralyzed}, or {@condition Poisoned|sw5e-phb|poisoned}.

subclassFeature.name: Trickster Order
entries: Monks of the Trickster Order embody the archetypal role of the "trickster"— one who seemingly bumbles their way into good fortune. They employ a unique fighting style composed of slips, trips, and falls to confuse and frustrate their enemies to no end. Whether your movements are actual foibles on your part or calculated strokes, they will surely leave others guessing long after your time is past.

subclassFeature.name: Bumbling Technique
entries: Your martial arts technique mixes combat training with the precision of a dancer and the antics of a jester. You gain proficiency in {@skill Performance|sw5e-phb}.

Additionally, you learn how to twist and turn quickly. Whenever you use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to make an unarmed strike, creatures you hit can't make {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks} against you, and your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} increases by 10 feet until the end of your turn.

subclassFeature.name: Clumsy Sway
entries: You can move in sudden, swaying ways. You gain the following benefits.
{@b {@i Leap to Your Feet.}} When you're prone, you can stand up by spending 5 feet of movement, rather than half your {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed}.

{@b {@i Redirect Attack.}} When a creature misses you with a melee {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, you can spend 1 focus point as a {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to cause that attack to hit one creature of your choice, other than the attacker, that you can see within 5 feet of you.

subclassFeature.name: Luck of the Fool
entries: You always seem to get a lucky bounce at the right moment. When you make an {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check}, an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, or a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} and have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage}, you can spend 2 focus points to instead have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} for that roll.

subclassFeature.name: Comic Frenzy
entries: You gain the ability to make an overwhelming number of attacks against a group of enemies. When you use your Flurry of Blows, you can make up to three additional attacks with it (up to a total of five Flurry of Blows attacks), provided that each Flurry of Blows attack targets a different creature this turn.

subclassFeature.name: Vonil/Ishu Form
entries: Vonil/{@optfeature Ishu Form|sw5e-phb}, also known as Unity Form, focuses on fighting in tandem with your allies. Those guardians who focus on Vonil/{@optfeature Ishu Form|sw5e-phb} utilize teamwork to move swiftly, strike quickly, and protect each other from harm.

subclassFeature.name: Form Basics
entries: You gain your choice of the Vonil or Ishu {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}, detailed in the {@item Lightsaber|sw5e-phb} Forms section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content. If you already know the chosen form, you can instead choose another {@book lightsaber form|sw5e-phb|6|Lightsaber Forms}.

subclassFeature.name: The Way of the Hydra
entries: As a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you can enter a synchronized stance with one ally of your choice within 10 feet of you for 1 minute. While in this stance, once per turn, when you hit a creature with an attack, the chosen ally has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next attack it makes against the same target before the end of your next turn. Additionally, once per turn, when the chosen ally hits a creature with an attack, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next attack you make against the same target before the end of your next turn.

This effect ends early if either you or the chosen ally are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated} or die, or if the chosen ally is ever more than 10 feet away from you. Once you've used this feature, you can't use it again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
At 11th level, the chosen ally must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, the chosen ally must be within 60 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Channel the Force
entries: You gain one of the following Channel the Force options. Choose Smite for Vonil or {@item Shield|sw5e-phb} for Ishu.

entries.name: Smite
entries: Once per turn, when an ally is within 10 feet of you and it hits a creature with a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, you can expend a use of your Channel the Force and expend force points to have the chosen ally deal additional damage to the target, which is the same type as the weapon's damage. The additional damage is 1d8 for each point spent in this way. You can't deal more additional damage than the amount shown in the Focused Strikes column of the guardian table.
At 11th level, the chosen ally must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, the chosen ally must be within 60 feet.

entries.name: Shield
entries: When an ally is hit by a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack} while within 10 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a use of your Channel the Force to attempt to divert the attack. When you do so, the damage the chosen ally takes from the attack is reduced by 1d10 + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice) + your guardian level.
At 11th level, the chosen ally must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, the chosen ally must be within 60 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Amplified Auras
entries: Once on each of your turns, you can choose an ally within 10 feet of you. While the chosen ally is within 10 feet of you, your auras emit from that ally as if you were standing in that ally's space. A creature in the area of more than one instance of your auras is affected only once.
At 11th level, the chosen ally must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, the chosen ally must be within 60 feet.

entries.name: Takedown
entries: When an ally within 30 feet of you takes the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action and helps you, you have {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next two {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} you make before the start of their next turn, instead of only one. When you take the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action and help an ally within 30 feet of you, the chosen ally has {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} on the next two {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability checks} or {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls} it makes before the start of your next turn, instead of only one.

entries.name: Rebuttal

When you take the {@action Help|sw5e-phb} action and help an ally within 30 feet of you, it gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to your guardian level that last until the start of your next turn.

subclassFeature.name: Master of Unity
entries: You and your allies are a paragon of harmony. Your Strength or Dexterity (your choice) and Constitution scores increase by 2. Your maximum for those scores increases by 2. Additionally, you can use your action and choose an ally within 60 feet of you to gain the following benefits for 1 minute:

items: You and the chosen ally have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to kinetic and energy damage.
Neither you nor the chosen ally can have {@variantrule Disadvantage|sw5e-phb|disadvantage} on {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack rolls}.
Both you and the chosen ally's {@variantrule Critical Hit|sw5e-phb|critical hit} ranges increase by 1.

entries: You gain proficiency in your choice of {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb}.

subclassFeature.name: Humanoid Companion
entries: You've adopted a partner, gaining the services of your own humanoid companion.
Create your humanoid companion as detailed in the Companions section of the Customization Options document for Expanded Content.
In addition to its traits and features, your companion gains additional benefits while it is bonded to you:

items: Your companion gains two additional traits. It gains one more additional trait when you reach 11th level in this class. For each trait in excess of your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus}, your force point maximum is reduced by 2.

entries: Lastly, while bonded and within 10 feet of you, when you or your companion are dealt damage by an external effect, you can choose to have you or your companion gain {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to that damage. If you do so, the other of the two takes the same damage as true damage.
At 11th level, your companion must be within 30 feet of you to benefit from this feature. At 17th level, your companion must be within 60 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Warchief Approach
entries: For some berserkers, it is their duty or birthright to lead their tribe and kin to battle and victory. The Warchief Approach is one forged from alliances, bonds, and strategy. In combat, your rages are less mindless, and more focused. Ignoring the distractions of unimportant events, your attention hones in on the battlefield and how best to direct and control it. You guide your allies' strikes, and your presence is enough to wash away their fatigue.

subclassFeature.name: Savage Diplomat
entries: Your path necessitates that you build relationships with others, for the betterment of your tribe or yourself. You gain proficiency in one of the following skills of your choice: {@skill Persuasion|sw5e-phb} or {@skill Intimidation|sw5e-phb}. You can choose to learn one language in place of the skill proficiency.

subclassFeature.name: Commanding Rage
entries: You become more aware of your allies, and their intent when fighting at your side. While you are raging, when an ally within 10 feet of you makes an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against an enemy, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to grant {@variantrule Advantage|sw5e-phb|advantage} to that attack and add your rage damage bonus to the damage roll, if the attack hits.
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Inspiring Presence
entries: Your mere presence on the battlefield rallies your allies. When you rage, choose up to 3 allies that you can see within 30 feet of you. Each creature gains temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to half your berserker level + your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1).

subclassFeature.name: Raid Planning
entries: You learn to flare up your allies' drive for combat, urging them to follow you into the fray. During a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you tell sagas, sing battle songs, and give inspiring speeches. At the end of the {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} choose up to 5 creatures that can hear and understand you (which can include yourself) to add your Charisma modifier (minimum of +1) to their next {@variantrule Initiative|sw5e-phb} check, and a 10 foot bonus to their {@variantrule Speed|sw5e-phb|speed} on their first turn of combat.

subclassFeature.name: War Chant
entries: You have memorized the litanies, songs, and chants of your people and their dedication to war. When you enter a rage on your turn, you can enter a commanding rage for one minute. When you do so, during this turn and at the start of each of your turns, you have a number of special reactions equal to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} you can only use for your Commanding Rage feature. When you use Commanding Rage with these special reactions, they do not count against your uses of that feature. You can only use one {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} per turn. Additionally, during this rage, when an enemy within 10 feet of you makes an {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} against an ally, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to reduce the attack by an amount equal to your Charisma modifier.
Once you've used this feature, you must complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest} before you can use it again.

subclassFeature.name: Way of Confluence
entries: The Force binds us, creating an intangible bridge connecting all living things. Those consulars who follow the Way of Confluence master this power, manipulating those connections to both sustain and torment.

subclassFeature.name: Manipulate Life Force
entries: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, or restore {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to a creature with 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} with a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you gain temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to half your consular level + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one).

subclassFeature.name: Empowered Connection
entries: While you have temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you can add half your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one) to any damage or healing you do with {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that doesn't already include that modifier.

subclassFeature.name: Life Eternal
entries: You can use your powerful connection to the Force to keep fighting when others would fall. When you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright, you can spend 5 force points to drop to 1 hit point instead.

subclassFeature.name: Interconnectedness
entries: When you cast a 5th level or lower {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that deals damage or restores {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} and targets only one creature, the power can instead target two creatures within range and within 5 feet of each other.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Interconnectedness
entries: When you cast a 5th level or lower {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that deals damage or restores {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} and targets only one creature, the power can instead target two creatures within range and within 5 feet of each other.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Dynamic Attachment
entries: While you have temporary {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points}, you have {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} against the damage of {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, and your {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} ignore resistances.

subclassFeature.name: Way of Endurance
entries: The Force manifests in myriad ways; while some use the Force to manipulate the world around them, others use it to enhance themselves. Those consulars who follow the Way of Endurance channel the Force to allow them to overcome and reflect the most grievous of injuries.

subclassFeature.name: Upheld by the Force
entries: The Force flowing through your body strengthens you, granting the following benefits:

items: Your hit point maximum increases by 3, and it increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level in this class.
Your base AC becomes 13 + your Constitution modifier.

When you make a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack} as a part of a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you cast, you can use Wisdom or Charisma (your choice) instead of Strength for the attack and damage rolls.

entries: Additionally, as an action, you can gain {@spell Resistance|sw5e-phb|resistance} to kinetic and energy damage for 1 minute. This effect lasts until you end it as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}, you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}, or you don armor other than a {@item Shield|sw5e-phb|shield}. You can use this feature twice. You regain all expended uses of it when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Retaliation Strike
entries: You learn to turn an opponent's aggression back on them. When you deal damage with a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, if you took damage since the start of your last turn, you deal an extra 1d6 damage. The damage is the same type as the power or weapon's damage.
This die increases when you reach certain levels in this class: to 1d8 at 9th level, to 1d10 at 13th level, and to 1d12 at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Retaliation Strike
entries: You learn to turn an opponent's aggression back on them. When you deal damage with a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, if you took damage since the start of your last turn, you deal an extra 1d6 damage. The damage is the same type as the power or weapon's damage.
This die increases when you reach certain levels in this class: to 1d8 at 9th level, to 1d10 at 13th level, and to 1d12 at 17th level.

The damage is the same type as the power or weapon's damage.
This die increases when you reach certain levels in this class: to 1d8 at 9th level, to 1d10 at 13th level, and to 1d12 at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Boundless Vitality
entries: When you take damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} and expend a force point to regain health equal to 1d8 + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one) as long as the damage would not reduce your {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} to 0.
This die increases when you reach certain levels in this class: to 1d10 at 13th level, and to 1d12 at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Unrelenting Resilience
entries: When you use your Boundless Vitality feature while concentrating on a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can add the result of the roll to the Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} made to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration}.

Additionally, when you are reduced to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} but not killed outright while Upheld by the Force is active, you can drop to 1 hit point instead. You can't use this feature again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: The Force Unleashed
entries: As an action, you can choose a point within 60 feet. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of that point must make a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC. On a failed save, a creature takes 5d10 force damage and suffers 1 level of {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion}. On a successful save, a creature takes half damage and does not suffer {@condition Exhaustion|sw5e-phb|exhaustion}.

For each creature that fails this {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, a friendly creature within 30 feet of them can regain {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} equal to the amount of damage dealt. A friendly creature can only gain this benefit once per turn.
You can use this feature six times. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Way of Manipulation
entries: The power of the Force is both vast and diverse, with uses varying drastically based on their wielder. Those consulars who follow the Way of Manipulation learn to control their weapons with the Force, maneuvering them across the battlefield.

subclassFeature.name: Saber Storm
entries: You learn to deftly control your weapons utilizing the Force. As an action, you can initiate your Saber Storm. When you do so, select a light- or vibro-weapon within 5 feet that is not worn or carried by a conscious creature other than you, and use the Force to cause it to levitate, acting as an extension of your will for 1 minute. When you activate this feature, you can cause the weapon to move up to 10 feet and make a melee force attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 + your {@book forcecasting ability|sw5e-phb|10|Forcecasting Ability} modifier damage. The type is of the normal damage dealt by the weapon. The weapon then returns to your side.

Your weapon moves with you, and while Saber Storm is active and you have a weapon animated, on each of your turns you can use an action to move a weapon up to 10 feet and repeat the attack against a creature within 5 feet of it. The weapon then returns to your side. Your Saber Storm ends early if you are {@condition Incapacitated|sw5e-phb|incapacitated}. At any time, you can end this feature and return the animated weapon to your hand.
Additionally, while your Saber Storm is active, and at least one animated weapon is within 5 feet of you, you gain the following benefits:

items: You gain a bonus to your AC equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of +1) if it doesn't already include that modifier.

You gain a bonus to any Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} you make to maintain your {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on a power. The bonus equals your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of +1).

entries: This feature can animate more than one weapon when you reach higher levels: two weapons at 5th level, three weapons at 11th level, and four weapons at 17th level. When you use your action to attack with your weapons, you can direct them at the same target or at different ones. Make a separate {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll} for each weapon.
At 5th level, the distance your weapon can travel increases to 20 feet. This distance increases to 30 feet at 11th level, and 40 feet at 17th level.
You can use this feature twice. You regain all expended uses of it when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Deceptive Strike
entries: When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} with a range of touch while Saber Storm is active, your animated weapon can move up to its range and deliver the power as if it had cast it.

subclassFeature.name: Guarding Weapon
entries: You can direct your animated weapons to absorb damage while your Saber Storm is activate. When you take damage, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to expend a number of force points up to your {@variantrule Proficiency|sw5e-phb|Proficiency Bonus} to have your animated weapon intercept it, and reduce that damage to you by an amount equal to five times the number of points spent.

subclassFeature.name: Isolate
entries: When you deal damage to a creature while Saber Storm is active, and that creature fails a Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} to maintain {@variantrule Concentration|sw5e-phb|concentration} on a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can steal and redirect the power. Until the end of your next turn, either you or the creature who failed the Constitution {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} gain the effects of the power (your choice).

subclassFeature.name: Sapping Storm
entries: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 {@variantrule Hit Points|sw5e-phb|hit points} while Saber Storm is active, you gain temporary force points equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one). These temporary force points can not exceed your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice), and when you would spend a force point while you have temporary force points, the temporary force points are spent first. When Saber Storm ends, you lose any remaining temporary force points.

subclassFeature.name: Way of Negation
entries: Some force users seek mastery over the fundamentals of energy manipulation, known as tutaminis. Those consulars who follow the Way of Negation harness this power to limit the havoc that other force-wielders might wreak.

subclassFeature.name: Force Deflection
entries: When you fail a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to gain a bonus to that {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of +1).
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Force Deflection
entries: When you fail a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to gain a bonus to that {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of +1).
You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Power Surge
entries: You learn to simultaneously limit a creature's {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and store that power within yourself to later strengthen your damaging {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}.

You can store a maximum number of power surges equal to your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of one). Whenever you successfully end a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} with a power such as {@i force suppression} or {@i sever force}, or use your Force {@item Shield|sw5e-phb} or Force Deflection features to successfully avoid an attack or succeed on a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you gain one power surge, as you redirect the flow of the Force into yourself.

Once per turn, when you deal damage to a creature or object with a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can spend one power surge to deal extra damage to that target. The extra damage is of the same type as the power's damage, and it equals half your consular level.

Whenever you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, your number of power surges resets to one. If you end a {@variantrule Short Rest|sw5e-phb|short rest} with no power surges, you gain one power surge.

subclassFeature.name: Enduring Focus
entries: You can casually deflect attacks while channeling your power. While you are concentrating on a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you have a +2 bonus to your AC and all {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throws}.
Additionally, you can extend your Force Deflection to a creature within 5 feet of you when they fail a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

subclassFeature.name: Conflux
entries: When you use your Force Deflection feature, you can cause a ripple in the Force to expand from you. Up to three creatures of your choice that you can see within 60 feet of you each take force damage equal to half your consular level.

subclassFeature.name: Tutaminis Mastery
entries: When you use a Force-Empowered Casting option, you can spend a power surge to use it without spending additional force points.

subclassFeature.name: Way of Technology
entries: While many Forcewielders eschew the use of technology, other choose to embrace it. Those consulars who follow the Way of {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} pair their mastery of the Force with the versatility of technology, applying the knowledge in tandem to perform unseen feats.

subclassFeature.name: Fundamentals of Mechu-deru
entries: You've dabbled in adapting your use of the Force, melding it with technology. You gain proficiency in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill, as well as {@filter simple blasters|items|firearm=true|weaponcategory=simple}. When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that calls for a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, and you are wielding a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} with which you are proficient, you can instead make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}.

Additionally, you've learned to manipulate the Force to be able to manipulate technology when it couldn't previously. When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that could not affect droids or constructs, you can choose to have it affect droids or constructs. If it would affect multiple targets, you must expend additional uses of this feature for each additional target. You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

You gain proficiency in the {@skill Technology|sw5e-phb} skill, as well as {@filter simple blasters|items|firearm=true|weaponcategory=simple}. When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that calls for a {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|melee weapon attack}, and you are wielding a {@filter blaster|items|firearm=true} with which you are proficient, you can instead make a ranged {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|weapon attack}.

Additionally, you've learned to manipulate the Force to be able to manipulate technology when it couldn't previously. When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that could not affect droids or constructs, you can choose to have it affect droids or constructs. If it would affect multiple targets, you must expend additional uses of this feature for each additional target. You can use this feature twice. You gain an additional use at 5th, 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Techcasting Secrets
entries: You've learned to mimic technological effects. Choose two {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 1st level. The chosen powers count as universal {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} for you, but are not included in the number in the Powers Known column of the consular table.

At 7th level, you learn two additional {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 1st or 2nd level. At 13th level, you learn two {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 1st-3rd level, and at 17th level, you learn two {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of 1st-4th level. Whenever you gain a level in this class, you can choose one of the {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you know and replace it with another {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of the same level.

subclassFeature.name: Ionized Weave
entries: When you cast a damage-dealing {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} that requires a force attack or {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can spend force points to cause that power to instead deal ion damage. The number of force points equals half the power's level (round down, minimum of one). If the power would call for a {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} other than Dexterity, it instead calls for a Dexterity {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}.

subclassFeature.name: Force Circuitry
entries: When you use your action to cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, and you use your Fundamentals of Mechu-deru feature as a part of that casting, you can use your {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to cast one of the {@book tech powers|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} you know, as long as that power has a casting time of 1 action or {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb}.

subclassFeature.name: Mechu-deru Mastery
entries: You can cast one 5th-level {@book tech power|sw5e-phb|12|Tech Powers} of your choice at its base level. The power counts as a universal {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} for you, and you do not require force points to cast this power. Once you've done so, you can't do so again until you complete a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Way of Telekinetics
entries: The consular knows how to manipulate the essence of the surrounding elements with the power of the Force. Those consulars who follow the Way of Telekinetics create torrential gusts of telekinetic energy, forming a potent combination that can pummel even the toughest adversaries into submission.

subclassFeature.name: Staggering Stratagem
entries: Your potency with the telekinetic power of the Force heightens. You can manipulate creatures of Large size or smaller with your {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and Way of Telekinetics features. Additionally, once per turn, when you deal force or kinetic damage to a Large or smaller creature with a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} or class feature, you can choose to either push it up to 10 feet away from you or pull it up to 10 feet closer to you.

subclassFeature.name: Mighty Blast
entries: Your {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} batter and blast your enemies with the strength of a hurricane. When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st level or higher that deals force or kinetic damage, one creature of your choice damaged by that power must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC or be knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.
This feature can affect additional creatures when you reach higher levels: two creatures at 11th level and three creatures at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Mighty Blast
entries: Your {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} batter and blast your enemies with the strength of a hurricane. When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st level or higher that deals force or kinetic damage, one creature of your choice damaged by that power must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC or be knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.
This feature can affect additional creatures when you reach higher levels: two creatures at 11th level and three creatures at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Mighty Blast
entries: Your {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} batter and blast your enemies with the strength of a hurricane. When you cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} of 1st level or higher that deals force or kinetic damage, one creature of your choice damaged by that power must make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC or be knocked {@condition Prone|sw5e-phb|prone}.
This feature can affect additional creatures when you reach higher levels: two creatures at 11th level and three creatures at 17th level.

subclassFeature.name: Size Matters Not
entries: You can manipulate creatures of Huge size or smaller with your {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and Way of Telekinetics features.

Additionally, when you use your action to cast a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers}, you can use a {@variantrule Bonus Action|sw5e-phb} to fly up to 10 feet without provoking {@action Opportunity Attack|sw5e-phb|opportunity attacks}.

subclassFeature.name: Repulsing Wave
entries: When you are dealt damage by a creature within 5 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to deal force damage to the creature equal to your consular level + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of +1). If the attacker is Huge or smaller, it must also make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC. On a failed save, the attacker is pushed in a straight line up to 20 feet away from you.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: Repulsing Wave
entries: When you are dealt damage by a creature within 5 feet of you, you can use your {@variantrule Reaction|sw5e-phb} to deal force damage to the creature equal to your consular level + your Wisdom or Charisma modifier (your choice, minimum of +1). If the attacker is Huge or smaller, it must also make a Strength {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC. On a failed save, the attacker is pushed in a straight line up to 20 feet away from you.
You can use this feature five times. You gain an additional use at 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a short or {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.

subclassFeature.name: My Ally is the Force
entries: You can manipulate creatures of Gargantuan size or smaller with your {@book force powers|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} and Way of Telekinetics features.
Additionally, whenever a {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} you cast pushes or pulls a creature, you can increase the distance of that push or pull by an additional 20 feet.

subclassFeature.name: Way of the Seer
entries: The Force guides us in innumerable ways, often manifesting as visions. Those consulars who follow the Way of Seer attempt to harness these visions in an attempt to work towards the best possible future, as they see it.

subclassFeature.name: Force Visions
entries: Glimpses of the future begin to press in on your awareness. When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, roll two d20s and record the numbers rolled. You can replace any {@variantrule Attack Roll|sw5e-phb|attack roll}, {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, or {@variantrule Ability Check|sw5e-phb|ability check} made by you or a creature that you can see with one of these foretelling rolls. You must choose to do so before the roll, and you can replace a roll in this way only once per turn. Each foretelling roll can be used only once. When you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}, you lose any unused foretelling rolls.

subclassFeature.name: Powerful Mind
entries: You can use your force abilities to read a creature's thoughts. You can then use your access to the creature's mind to command it.

As an action, choose one creature that you can see within 60 feet of you. That creature must make a Wisdom {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against your universal force save DC. If the creature succeeds on the {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw}, you can't use this feature on it again until you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}. If the creature fails its save, you can read its surface thoughts (those foremost in its mind, reflecting its current emotions and what it is actively thinking about) when it is within 60 feet of you. This effect lasts for 1 minute. During that time, you can use your action to end this effect and cast the {@i coerce mind} {@book force power|sw5e-phb|11|Force Powers} at its base level on the creature without expending force points. The target automatically fails its {@variantrule Saving Throw|sw5e-phb|saving throw} against the power.
You can use this feature three times. You gain an additional use at 9th, 13th, and 17th level. You regain all expended uses when you finish a {@variantrule Long Rest|sw5e-phb|long rest}.
